text:
Qiyamat Se Ghafil Insan Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal logon ko mutanbih farha raha hai ki qiyamat kareeb agayi hai phir bhi logon ki ghaflat mein kami nahi ayi na woh is ke liye koi taiyari kar rahe hain jo unhein kaam aaye. Balki duniya mein phanse hue hain aur aise mashghool aur munhamik ho rahe hain ki qiyamat se bilkul ghafil ho gaye hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Ata amru Allahi fala tasta'jiluhu) Amr-e-Rabi agaya ab kyun jaldi macha rahe ho? Dusri ayat mein farmaya gaya hai (Iqtarabati s-sa'atu wa anshaqqa al-qamar) (Al-Qamar: 1) Qiyamat kareeb agayi aur chand phat gaya al-akh. Abu Nawas shair ka ek shair thik isi maani ka yeh hai. Shair (An-nasu fi ghaflatihim wa rahyu l-minyyati tatḥanu) "Maut ki chakki zor zor se chal rahi hai aur log ghaflaton mein pade hue hain."

Hazrat Amir bin Rabee'ah R.A ke haan ek sahib mehman ban kar aaye. Unhone bade ikram aur ehtram se unhein apne haan utara aur un ke bare mein Rasul ﷺ se bhi sifarish ki. Ek din yeh buzurg mehman un ke paas aaye aur kahne lage Rasul Allah ﷺ ne mujhe falan wadi ata farma di hai main chahta hoon ki is behtareen zameen ka ek tukda main aap ke naam kar dun ki aap ko bhi farigh-ul-bali rahe aur aap ke baad aap ke baal bachche bhi asudgi se basar karein. Hazrat Amir R.A ne jawab diya ki bhai mujhe is ki koi zarurat nahi aaj ek aisi surat nazil hui hai ki humein to duniya kadwi maloom hone lagi hai. Phir aap ne yahi Iqtaraba lil-nasi ki tilawat farmai. 

Is ke baad kuffar-e-Quraish aur unhi jaise aur kafaron ki babat farmata hai ki yeh log Kalamullah aur Wahi-e-Ilahi ki taraf kaan hi nahi lagate. Yeh taza aur naya aaya hua zikr dil laga kar sunte hi nahi. Is kaan sunte hain us kaan uda dete hain. Dil hansi khel mein mashghool hain. 

Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A farmate hain tumhein Ahl-e-Kitab ki kitabon ki baaton ke poochne ki kya zarurat hai? Unhone to Kitabullah mein bahut kuch rad-o-badal kar liya tahrif aur tabdili kar li, kami ziyadti kar li aur tumhare paas to Allah ki utari hui khalis kitab maujood hai jis mein milawat nahi hone pai. Yeh log Kitabullah se be-parwahi kar rahe hain apne dilon ko is ke asar se khali rakhna chahte hain. Balki yeh zalim auron ko bhi behkate hain kahte hain ki apne jaise ek insan ki mat-hati to hum nahi kar sakte. Tum kaise log ho ki dekhte bhalte jadoo ko maan rahe ho? Yeh namumkin hai ki hum jaise aadmi ko Allah Ta'ala risalat aur wahi ke sath mukhtas kar de, phir tajjub hai ki log bawajood ilm ke is ke jadoo mein aa jate hain? 

In bad-kirdaron ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ki yeh jo buhtan bandhte hain un se kahiye ki jo Allah asman aur zameen ki tamam baatein janta hai jis par koi baat bhi poshida nahi. Us ne is pak kalam Quran Kareem ko nazil farmaya is mein agli pichli tamam khabaron ka maujood hona hi daleel hai is baat ki ki is ka utarne wala Alim-ul-Ghaib hai.

Woh tumhari sab baaton ka sunne wala aur tumhare tamam halaat ka ilm rakhne wala hai. Pas tumhein is ka dar rakhna chahiye. Phir kuffar ki zid, nasamjhi aur kat-hujti bayaan farma raha hai jis se saaf zahir hai ki woh khud hairan hain kisi baat par jam nahi sakte. Kabhi Kalamullah ko jadoo kehte hain toh kabhi shayari kehte hain kabhi praganda aur be-mani baatein kehte hain aur kabhi An-Hazrat ﷺ ka az-khud gadh-liya hua batate hain. Khayal karo ki apne kisi qaul par bharosa na rakhne wala jo zuban par chadhe bak dene wala bhi mustaqil mizaj kehlanane ka mustahiq hai? Kabhi kehte the achha agar yeh sachha nabi hai toh Hazrat Salih A.S ki tarah koi untni le aata ya Hazrat Musa A.S ki tarah ka koi mojiza dikhata ya Hazrat Isa A.S ka koi mojiza zahir karta. Beshak Allah in cheezon par qadir toh zaroor hai lekin agar zahir huin aur phir bhi yeh apne kufr se na hate toh adat-e-ilahi ki tarah azab-e-ilahi mein pakad liye jayenge aur pees diye jayenge. Umuman agle logon ne yehi kaha aur iman naseeb na hua aur gharat kar liye gaye. Isi tarah yeh bhi aise mojize talab kar rahe hain agar zahir hue toh iman na layenge aur tabah ho jayenge. Jaise farman hai ayat (Innal-lazina haqqat ‘alaihim kalimatur-rabbi la yu’minun - 10. (Yunus: 96) Jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh go tamam tar mojize dekh lein, iman qabul na karenge. Haan Azab-e-Aleem ke muainah ke baad toh foran tasleem kar lenge lekin woh mahz be-sood hai baat bhi yehi hai ki unhein iman lana hi na tha aur na Huzoor ﷺ ke beshumar mojizat roz-marah in ki nigahon ke samne the. Balkih Aap ke yeh mojize digar Anbiya A.S se bahut zyada zahir aur khule hue the. Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek bahut hi ghareeb riwayat mein Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A ka ek majma masjid mein tha. Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A tilawat-e-Quran kar rahe the itne mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul munafiq aaya apni gaddi bichha kar apna takiya laga kar wajahat se baith gaya. Tha bhi gora chitta badh badh kar fasahat ke sath baatein banane wala kehne laga Abu Bakr tum Huzoor ﷺ se kaho ki Aap koi nishan hamein dikhayen jaise ki Aap se pehle ke Anbiya nishanat laye the masalan Musa A.S takhtiyan laye, Dawud A.S untni laye (aur Musa A.S par asha aur aza-e-bayza zahir hue aur Dawud A.S par zabor nazil hui, aur Isa A.S injeel laye aur aasmani dastarkhwan) Hazrat Siddiq R.A yeh sun kar rone lage. Itne mein Huzoor ﷺ ghar se nikle toh Aap ne doosre Sahaba se farmaya aur is munafiq ki faryad darbar-e-risalat mein pahunchai. Aap ne irshad farmaya suno mere liye khade na hua karo. Sirf Allah hi ke liye khade hua karo. Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ hamein is munafiq se badi eeza pahunchi hai. Aap ne farmaya abhi abhi Jibrael A.S mere paas aaye the aur mujh se farmaya ki bahar jao aur logon ke samne apne fazail zahir karo aur un nematon ka bayaan karo jo Allah ne Aap ko ata farmai hain main sari duniya ki taraf rasul bana kar bheja gaya hu mujhe hukm hua hai ki main jinnaat ko bhi paigham-e-ilahi pahuncha dun.

Mujhe mere Rabb ne apni paak kitab inayat farmai hai halanki mahz be-parha hoon. Mere tamam agle pichle gunah maaf farma diye hain. Mera naam azan mein rakha hai, meri madad farishton se karai hai. Mujhe apni imdad-o-nusrat ata farmai hai. Roob mera mere aage aage kar diya hai. Mujhe Hauz-e-Kausar ata farmaya hai jo roz-e-qayamat tamam hauzon se bara hoga. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne Maqam-e-Mahmoud ka wada diya hai us waqt jab ke sab log hairan-o-pareshan sar jhukaye hue honge, mujhe Allah ne us pehle giroh mein chuna hai jo logon se nikle ga. Meri shafaat se meri ummat ke sattar hazaar shakhs baghair hisab-o-kitab ke jannat mein jayenge. Mujhe ghalba aur saltanat ata farmai hai, mujhe Jannat-e-Naeem ka woh buland-o-bala aala bala-khana milega ke us se aala manzil kisi ki na hogi. Mere upar sirf woh farishte honge jo Allah Ta'ala ke arsh ko uthaye hue honge. Mere aur meri ummat ke liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye halanki mujh se pehle woh kisi ke liye halal na the.)

Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne Maqam-e-Mahmoud ka wada diya hai us waqt jab ke sab log hairan-o-pareshan sar jhukaye hue honge, mujhe Allah ne us pehle giroh mein chuna hai jo logon se nikle ga. Meri shafaat se meri ummat ke sattar hazaar shakhs baghair hisab-o-kitab ke jannat mein jayenge. Mujhe ghalba aur saltanat ata farmai hai, mujhe Jannat-e-Naeem ka woh buland-o-bala aala bala-khana milega ke us se aala manzil kisi ki na hogi. Mere upar sirf woh farishte honge jo Allah Ta'ala ke arsh ko uthaye hue honge. Mere aur meri ummat ke liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye halanki mujh se pehle woh kisi ke liye halal na the.)

Qiyamat Se Ghafil Insan Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal logon ko mutanbih farha raha hai ki qiyamat kareeb agayi hai phir bhi logon ki ghaflat mein kami nahi ayi na woh is ke liye koi taiyari kar rahe hain jo unhein kaam aaye. Balki duniya mein phanse hue hain aur aise mashghool aur munhamik ho rahe hain ki qiyamat se bilkul ghafil ho gaye hain. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Ata amru Allahi fala tasta'jiluhu) Amr-e-Rabi agaya ab kyun jaldi macha rahe ho? Dusri ayat mein farmaya gaya hai (Iqtarabati s-sa'atu wa anshaqqa al-qamar) (Al-Qamar: 1) Qiyamat kareeb agayi aur chand phat gaya al-akh. Abu Nawas shair ka ek shair thik isi maani ka yeh hai. Shair (An-nasu fi ghaflatihim wa rahyu l-minyyati tatḥanu) "Maut ki chakki zor zor se chal rahi hai aur log ghaflaton mein pade hue hain."

Hazrat Amir bin Rabee'ah R.A ke haan ek sahib mehman ban kar aaye. Unhone bade ikram aur ehtram se unhein apne haan utara aur un ke bare mein Rasul ﷺ se bhi sifarish ki. Ek din yeh buzurg mehman un ke paas aaye aur kahne lage Rasul Allah ﷺ ne mujhe falan wadi ata farma di hai main chahta hoon ki is behtareen zameen ka ek tukda main aap ke naam kar dun ki aap ko bhi farigh-ul-bali rahe aur aap ke baad aap ke baal bachche bhi asudgi se basar karein. Hazrat Amir R.A ne jawab diya ki bhai mujhe is ki koi zarurat nahi aaj ek aisi surat nazil hui hai ki humein to duniya kadwi maloom hone lagi hai. Phir aap ne yahi Iqtaraba lil-nasi ki tilawat farmai. 

Is ke baad kuffar-e-Quraish aur unhi jaise aur kafaron ki babat farmata hai ki yeh log Kalamullah aur Wahi-e-Ilahi ki taraf kaan hi nahi lagate. Yeh taza aur naya aaya hua zikr dil laga kar sunte hi nahi. Is kaan sunte hain us kaan uda dete hain. Dil hansi khel mein mashghool hain. 

Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A farmate hain tumhein Ahl-e-Kitab ki kitabon ki baaton ke poochne ki kya zarurat hai? Unhone to Kitabullah mein bahut kuch rad-o-badal kar liya tahrif aur tabdili kar li, kami ziyadti kar li aur tumhare paas to Allah ki utari hui khalis kitab maujood hai jis mein milawat nahi hone pai. Yeh log Kitabullah se be-parwahi kar rahe hain apne dilon ko is ke asar se khali rakhna chahte hain. Balki yeh zalim auron ko bhi behkate hain kahte hain ki apne jaise ek insan ki mat-hati to hum nahi kar sakte. Tum kaise log ho ki dekhte bhalte jadoo ko maan rahe ho? Yeh namumkin hai ki hum jaise aadmi ko Allah Ta'ala risalat aur wahi ke sath mukhtas kar de, phir tajjub hai ki log bawajood ilm ke is ke jadoo mein aa jate hain? 

In bad-kirdaron ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ki yeh jo buhtan bandhte hain un se kahiye ki jo Allah asman aur zameen ki tamam baatein janta hai jis par koi baat bhi poshida nahi. Us ne is pak kalam Quran Kareem ko nazil farmaya is mein agli pichli tamam khabaron ka maujood hona hi daleel hai is baat ki ki is ka utarne wala Alim-ul-Ghaib hai.

Woh tumhari sab baaton ka sunne wala aur tumhare tamam halaat ka ilm rakhne wala hai. Pas tumhein is ka dar rakhna chahiye. Phir kuffar ki zid, nasamjhi aur kat-hujti bayaan farma raha hai jis se saaf zahir hai ki woh khud hairan hain kisi baat par jam nahi sakte. Kabhi Kalamullah ko jadoo kehte hain toh kabhi shayari kehte hain kabhi praganda aur be-mani baatein kehte hain aur kabhi An-Hazrat ﷺ ka az-khud gadh-liya hua batate hain. Khayal karo ki apne kisi qaul par bharosa na rakhne wala jo zuban par chadhe bak dene wala bhi mustaqil mizaj kehlanane ka mustahiq hai? Kabhi kehte the achha agar yeh sachha nabi hai toh Hazrat Salih A.S ki tarah koi untni le aata ya Hazrat Musa A.S ki tarah ka koi mojiza dikhata ya Hazrat Isa A.S ka koi mojiza zahir karta. Beshak Allah in cheezon par qadir toh zaroor hai lekin agar zahir huin aur phir bhi yeh apne kufr se na hate toh adat-e-ilahi ki tarah azab-e-ilahi mein pakad liye jayenge aur pees diye jayenge. Umuman agle logon ne yehi kaha aur iman naseeb na hua aur gharat kar liye gaye. Isi tarah yeh bhi aise mojize talab kar rahe hain agar zahir hue toh iman na layenge aur tabah ho jayenge. Jaise farman hai ayat (Innal-lazina haqqat ‘alaihim kalimatur-rabbi la yu’minun - 10. (Yunus: 96) Jin par tere Rab ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh go tamam tar mojize dekh lein, iman qabul na karenge. Haan Azab-e-Aleem ke muainah ke baad toh foran tasleem kar lenge lekin woh mahz be-sood hai baat bhi yehi hai ki unhein iman lana hi na tha aur na Huzoor ﷺ ke beshumar mojizat roz-marah in ki nigahon ke samne the. Balkih Aap ke yeh mojize digar Anbiya A.S se bahut zyada zahir aur khule hue the. Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek bahut hi ghareeb riwayat mein Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A ka ek majma masjid mein tha. Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A tilawat-e-Quran kar rahe the itne mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul munafiq aaya apni gaddi bichha kar apna takiya laga kar wajahat se baith gaya. Tha bhi gora chitta badh badh kar fasahat ke sath baatein banane wala kehne laga Abu Bakr tum Huzoor ﷺ se kaho ki Aap koi nishan hamein dikhayen jaise ki Aap se pehle ke Anbiya nishanat laye the masalan Musa A.S takhtiyan laye, Dawud A.S untni laye (aur Musa A.S par asha aur aza-e-bayza zahir hue aur Dawud A.S par zabor nazil hui, aur Isa A.S injeel laye aur aasmani dastarkhwan) Hazrat Siddiq R.A yeh sun kar rone lage. Itne mein Huzoor ﷺ ghar se nikle toh Aap ne doosre Sahaba se farmaya aur is munafiq ki faryad darbar-e-risalat mein pahunchai. Aap ne irshad farmaya suno mere liye khade na hua karo. Sirf Allah hi ke liye khade hua karo. Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ hamein is munafiq se badi eeza pahunchi hai. Aap ne farmaya abhi abhi Jibrael A.S mere paas aaye the aur mujh se farmaya ki bahar jao aur logon ke samne apne fazail zahir karo aur un nematon ka bayaan karo jo Allah ne Aap ko ata farmai hain main sari duniya ki taraf rasul bana kar bheja gaya hu mujhe hukm hua hai ki main jinnaat ko bhi paigham-e-ilahi pahuncha dun.

Tha bhi gora chitta badh badh kar fasahat ke sath baatein banane wala kehne laga Abu Bakr tum Huzoor ﷺ se kaho ki Aap koi nishan hamein dikhayen jaise ki Aap se pehle ke Anbiya nishanat laye the masalan Musa A.S takhtiyan laye, Dawud A.S untni laye (aur Musa A.S par asha aur aza-e-bayza zahir hue aur Dawud A.S par zabor nazil hui, aur Isa A.S injeel laye aur aasmani dastarkhwan) Hazrat Siddiq R.A yeh sun kar rone lage. Itne mein Huzoor ﷺ ghar se nikle toh Aap ne doosre Sahaba se farmaya aur is munafiq ki faryad darbar-e-risalat mein pahunchai. Aap ne irshad farmaya suno mere liye khade na hua karo. Sirf Allah hi ke liye khade hua karo. Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ hamein is munafiq se badi eeza pahunchi hai. Aap ne farmaya abhi abhi Jibrael A.S mere paas aaye the aur mujh se farmaya ki bahar jao aur logon ke samne apne fazail zahir karo aur un nematon ka bayaan karo jo Allah ne Aap ko ata farmai hain main sari duniya ki taraf rasul bana kar bheja gaya hu mujhe hukm hua hai ki main jinnaat ko bhi paigham-e-ilahi pahuncha dun.

Mujhe mere Rabb ne apni paak kitab inayat farmai hai halanki mahz be-parha hoon. Mere tamam agle pichle gunah maaf farma diye hain. Mera naam azan mein rakha hai, meri madad farishton se karai hai. Mujhe apni imdad-o-nusrat ata farmai hai. Roob mera mere aage aage kar diya hai. Mujhe Hauz-e-Kausar ata farmaya hai jo roz-e-qayamat tamam hauzon se bara hoga. Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne Maqam-e-Mahmoud ka wada diya hai us waqt jab ke sab log hairan-o-pareshan sar jhukaye hue honge, mujhe Allah ne us pehle giroh mein chuna hai jo logon se nikle ga. Meri shafaat se meri ummat ke sattar hazaar shakhs baghair hisab-o-kitab ke jannat mein jayenge. Mujhe ghalba aur saltanat ata farmai hai, mujhe Jannat-e-Naeem ka woh buland-o-bala aala bala-khana milega ke us se aala manzil kisi ki na hogi. Mere upar sirf woh farishte honge jo Allah Ta'ala ke arsh ko uthaye hue honge. Mere aur meri ummat ke liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye halanki mujh se pehle woh kisi ke liye halal na the.)

Mushrikin-e-Makkah Rasoolullah ﷺ ki bashariyat ke munkar thay, chunke mushrikin is ke munkar thay ke insano mein se koi insan Allah ka Rasool ﷺ ho, is liye Allah Ta'ala un ke is aqeedah ki tardeed karta hai farmata hai tujh se pehle jitne rasool aaye sab insan hi thay aik bhi farishta na tha jaise doosri ayat mein hai (Wa ma arsalna qablaka illa rijalan nuhi ilaihim fas'alu ahla zikri in kuntum la ta'lamun) (Al-Anbiya: 7) yani tujh se pehle hum ne jitne rasool bheje aur un ki taraf wahi nazil farmayi sab shahron ke rehne wale insan hi thay. Aur ayat mein hai (Qul ma kuntu bid'an minar rusuli wa ma adri ma yuf'alu bi wa la bikum) (Al-Ahqaf: 9) yani keh de ke main koi naya aur anokha aur sab se pehla rasool to hoon hi nahi. In kafaron se pehle ke kuffar ne bhi nabiyon ke na manne ka yehi hila uthaya tha jise Quran ne bayan farmaya ke unhon ne kaha tha ayat (Abasharun yahdoonana) kya aik insan hamara rahbar hoga? Allah Ta'ala is ayat mein farmata hai ke acha tum ahl-e-ilm se yani yahudiyon aur nasraniyon se aur doosre giroh se pooch lo ke un ke paas insan hi rasool bana kar bheje gaye thay ya farishte? Ye bhi Allah ka ehsan hai ke inano ke paas unhi jaise insano ko rasool bana kar bhejta hai taake log un ke paas baith uth saken, un ki taleem hasil kar saken aur un ki baatein sun samajh saken. Kya woh agle paighambar sab ke sab aise jism ke na thay jo khane peene ki hajat na rakhte hon. Balkah woh khane peene ke muhtaj thay jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma arsalna qablaka minal mursaleena illa innahum layakoonat ta'aama wa yamshoona fil aswaqi wa ja'alna ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan atasbiroon wa kana rabbuka baseera) (Al-Furqan: 20) yani tujh se pehle jitne rasool hum ne bheje woh sab khana khaya karte thay aur bazaron mein amad-o-raft bhi karte thay yani woh sab insan thay insano ki tarah khate peete thay aur kaam kaaj beyopar tijarat ke liye bazaron mein bhi aana jaana rakhte thay. Pas ye baat un ki paighambari ke manafi nahi. Jaise mushrikin ka qool tha ayat (Wa qaloo ma hazar rasooli ya'akulut ta'aama wa yamshi fil aswaqi lawla unzila ilaihi malakun fayakoona ma'ahu nazeera) (Al-Furqan: 7), yani ye rasool kaisa hai? Jo khata peeta hai aur bazaron mein aata jaata hai is ke paas koi farishta kyun nahi utarta ke woh bhi us ke sath us ke deen ki tableeg karta acha ye nahi to use kisi khazane ka malik kyun nahi kar diya jata ya use koi baagh hi de diya jata jis se ye ba-faraghat kha pi leta. Al-ikh. Isi tarah agle paighambar bhi duniya mein na rahe aaye aur gaye jaise farman hai ayat (Wa ma ja'alna libasharin min qablikal khulda afa-in mitta fahumul khalidoon) (Al-Anbiya: 34)

(Al-Anbiya: 34) Yani tujh se pehle bhi hum ne kisi insan ko dawam nahi bakhsha. Un ke paas albatta wahi-e-ilahi aati rahi, farishta Allah ke hukm-o-ahkaam pohancha diya karta tha. Phir Rab ka jo wada un se tha woh sacha ho kar raha, yani un ke mukhalifin wajah apne zulm ke tabaah ho gaye aur woh nijat pa gaye. Un ke tabaidar bhi kamyab hue aur hadd se guzar jaane walon ko, yani nabiyon ke jhutlane walon ko Allah ne halak kar diya.

Qadr Na-shinas Log

Allah Ta'ala apne Kalam-e-Pak ki fazilat bayan karte hue us ki qadr-o-manzalat par raghib dilane ke liye farmata hai ke hum ne yeh Kitab tumhari taraf utari hai jis mein tumhari buzurgi hai, tumhara deen, tumhari shariat aur tumhari baatein hain. Phir taajjub hai ke tum is ahem naemat ki qadr nahi karte? Aur is itni badi sharafat wali Kitab se ghaflat barat rahe ho? Jaise aur ayat mein hai: (Wa innahu la-zikrun laka wa li-qawmika wa sawfa tus-alun) (Al-Zukhruf: 44). Tere liye aur teri qaum ke liye yeh naseehat hai aur tum is ke bare mein abhi abhi sawal kiye jaoge.

Phir farmata hai hum ne bahut si bastiyon ke zalimon ko pees kar rakh diya hai. Aur ayat mein hai hum ne Nuh (A.S) ke baad bhi bahut si bastiyan halak kar diin. Aur ayat mein hai kitni ek bastiyan hain jo pehle bahut urooj par aur intehai raunaq par thin lekin phir wahan ke logon ke zulm ki bina par hum ne un ka chura kar diya, bhas uda diya, abadi veerani se aur raunaq sunsaan sannate mein badal gayi. Un ki halakat ke baad aur logon ko un ka jaanasheen bana diya, ek qaum ke baad doosri

Aasman-o-Zamin koi khel tamasha nahin. Aasman-o-Zamin ko Allah Ta'ala ne adl se paida kiya hai taake buron ko saza aur nekon ko jaza de. Us ne unhein bekar aur khel tamashe ke taur par paida nahi kiya. Aur aayat mein is mazmoon ke sath hi bayaan hai ki yeh guman to kuffaar ka hai jin ke liye jahannam ki aag tayyar hai. Doosri aayat ke ek maana to yeh hain ki agar hum khel tamasha hi chahte to ise bana lete. Ek maana yeh hain ki agar hum aurat karna chahte. Lahoo ke maana Ahl-e-Yaman ke nazdeek biwi ke bhi aate hain. Yaani yeh dono maane hain agar biwi banana chahte to hoor-ul-ain mein se jo hamare paas hai kisi ko bana lete. Ek maana yeh bhi hain ki agar hum aulaad chahte. Lekin yeh dono maane aapas mein lazim malzoom hain. Biwi ke sath hi aulaad hai. Jaise farmaan hai aayat (Lau aradal-lahu an yattakhiza waladal las-tafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar) (Az-Zumar: 4), yaani agar Allah ko yehi manzoor hota ki uski aulaad ho to makhlooq mein kisi aala darje ki makhlooq ko yeh mansab ata farmata lekin woh is baat se paak aur bahut door hai. Uske tauheed aur ghalbe ke khilaf hai ki uski aulaad ho. Pas woh mutlaq aulaad se paak hai na Isa uska beta hai na Uzair. Na farishte uski larkiyan hain. In Eesaiyon, Yahoodiyon aur kuffaar-e-Makkah ki lagwiyat aur tuhmat se Allah Wahid Qahhar paak hai aur buland hai. Aayat (In kunna failin) mein in ko nafiya kaha gaya hai yaani hum yeh karne wale hi na the. Balke Mujahid (R.H) ka qaul hai ki Quran-e-Majeed mein har jagah in nafi ke liye hi hai. Farishton ka tazkira hum haq ko wazeh karte hain, ise khol kar bayaan karte hain jis se baatil dab jata hai, toot kar choora ho jata hai aur foran hat jata hai. Woh hai bhi laayq, woh thehar nahi sakta na jam sakta hai na dair tak qaim reh sakta hai. Allah ke liye jo log aulaadein thehra rahe hain un ke is wahi qaul ki wajah se un ke liye weil hai unhein poori kharabi hai. Farishte uski ibadat mein mashghool hain. Kisi mein ya sab mein mil kar bhi yeh قدرت nahi phir unhein is qudrat wale ke barabar manna ya un ki bhi ibadat karna kis qadr na-insafi hai? Phir farmata hai suno agar maan liya jaye ke fi-waqia bahut se Ilah hain toh lazim aayega ke zameen o asman tabaq o barbad ho jayein jaise farman hai ayat (Ma-ttakhazallahu minw-waladiw-wa ma kana ma'ahu min ilahin izal-lazahaba) (Al-Mu'minun: 91) Allah ki aulad nahi, na us ke sath aur koi mabood hai agar aisa hota hai toh har mabood apni apni makhluqat ko liye phirta aur ek dusre par ghalib aane ki koshish karta Allah Ta'ala un ke bayan karda ausaf se mubra aur munazzah hai. Yahan farmaya Allah Ta'ala malik-e-arsh un ke kahe hue radi ausaf se yaani larke larkiyon se pak hai. Isi tarah shareek aur sajhi se, misl aur sathi se bhi buland o bala hai. In ki yeh sab tuhmaten hain jin se Allah ki zat bartar hai. Us ki shan toh yeh hai ke woh ala-itlali shehenshah-e-haqiqi hai, is par koi hakim nahi. Sab us ke ghalbe aur kahar tale hain. Na toh us ke hukm ka koi ta'qub kar sake na us ke farman ko koi tal sake. Isi tarah kubriyi aur azmat jalal aur hukumat ilm aur hikmat lutf aur rahmat be-payan hai. Kisi ko us ke aage dam marne ki majal nahi. Sab past aur aajiz hain lachar aur be-bas hain. Koi nahi jo choo kare koi nahi jo us ke samne bol sake koi nahi jise choo chira ka ikhtiyar ho jo us ka pooch sake ke yeh kaam kyun kiya aisa kyun hua? Woh kyunki tamam makhluq ka khaliq hai sab ka malik hai use ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sawal kare ke har ek ke aamal ki woh baz-purs karega. Jaise farman hai ayat (Fa-warabbika lanas'alannahum ajma'in) (Al-Hijr: 92), Tere Rab ki qasam hum un sab se sawal karenge har us fel se jo unhon ne kiya. Wahi hai jo us ki panah mein aa gaya sab shar se bach gaya aur koi nahi jo us ke mujrim ko panah de sake.

Phir farmata hai suno agar maan liya jaye ke fi-waqia bahut se Ilah hain toh lazim aayega ke zameen o asman tabaq o barbad ho jayein jaise farman hai ayat (Ma-ttakhazallahu minw-waladiw-wa ma kana ma'ahu min ilahin izal-lazahaba) (Al-Mu'minun: 91) Allah ki aulad nahi, na us ke sath aur koi mabood hai agar aisa hota hai toh har mabood apni apni makhluqat ko liye phirta aur ek dusre par ghalib aane ki koshish karta Allah Ta'ala un ke bayan karda ausaf se mubra aur munazzah hai. Yahan farmaya Allah Ta'ala malik-e-arsh un ke kahe hue radi ausaf se yaani larke larkiyon se pak hai. Isi tarah shareek aur sajhi se, misl aur sathi se bhi buland o bala hai. In ki yeh sab tuhmaten hain jin se Allah ki zat bartar hai. Us ki shan toh yeh hai ke woh ala-itlali shehenshah-e-haqiqi hai, is par koi hakim nahi. Sab us ke ghalbe aur kahar tale hain. Na toh us ke hukm ka koi ta'qub kar sake na us ke farman ko koi tal sake. Isi tarah kubriyi aur azmat jalal aur hukumat ilm aur hikmat lutf aur rahmat be-payan hai. Kisi ko us ke aage dam marne ki majal nahi. Sab past aur aajiz hain lachar aur be-bas hain. Koi nahi jo choo kare koi nahi jo us ke samne bol sake koi nahi jise choo chira ka ikhtiyar ho jo us ka pooch sake ke yeh kaam kyun kiya aisa kyun hua? Woh kyunki tamam makhluq ka khaliq hai sab ka malik hai use ikhtiyar hai jis se jo chahe sawal kare ke har ek ke aamal ki woh baz-purs karega. Jaise farman hai ayat (Fa-warabbika lanas'alannahum ajma'in) (Al-Hijr: 92), Tere Rab ki qasam hum un sab se sawal karenge har us fel se jo unhon ne kiya. Wahi hai jo us ki panah mein aa gaya sab shar se bach gaya aur koi nahi jo us ke mujrim ko panah de sake.

Haq se ghafil mushrik un logon ne Allah ke sifa jin jin ko mabood bana rakha hai un ki ibadat par un ke paas koi daleel nahi aur hum jis Allah ki ibadat kar rahe hain us mein sache hain hamare haathon mein aala-tar daleel Kalamullah mojood hai aur is se pehle ki tamam ilhami kitabein usi ki daleel mein ba-aawaz buland shahadat deti hain jo tauheed ki muwafiqat mein aur kafiron ke khud-parasti ke khilaf mein hain. Jo kitab jis paighambar par utri us mein yeh bayan mojood raha ke Allah ke siba koi laaiq-e-ibadat nahi lekin aksar mushrik haq se ghafil hain aur Allah ki baaton se munkar hain. Tamam rasoolon ko tauheed-e-Ilahi ki hi talqeen hoti rahi. Farman hai ayat (Wa s'al man arsalna min qablika min rusulina aj'alna min dunir-Rahmani alihatan yu'budoon) (Az-Zukhruf: 45) Tujh se pehle jo anbiya guzre hain tu khud pooch le ke hum ne un ke liye apne siba aur koi mabood muqarrar kiya tha ke woh us ki ibadat karte hon? Aur ayat mein hai (Wa laqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatin rasoolan ani'budulla-ha wajtanibut-taghoot) (An-Nahl: 36) Hum ne har ummat mein apna paighambar bheja jis ne logon mein elan kiya ke tum sab ek Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siba har ek ki ibadat se alag raho. Pas anbiya ki shahadat bhi yahi hai aur khud fitratullah bhi usi ki shahid hai. Aur mushrikeen ki koi daleel nahi. Un ki sari hujetein bekaar hain aur un par Allah ka ghazab hai aur un ke liye sakht azab hai.

Khashiyat-e-Ilahi. Kuffar-e-Makkah ka khayal tha ke farishte Allah ki larkiyan hain. Unke is khayal ki tardeed karte hue Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh bilkul ghalat hai, farishte Allah Ta'ala ke buzurg bande hain, bare baraiyon wale hain aur zi-izzat hain qoulan aur fe'lan har waqt ita'at-e-Ilahi mein mashghool hain. Na toh kisi amr mein is se aage barhein, na kisi baat mein iske farman ka khilaf karein balke jo woh farmaye daur kar iski baja-awari karte hain. Allah ke ilm mein ghire hue hain is par koi baat poshida nahi aage peeche dahine bayen ka use ilm hai zarre zarre ka woh dana hai. Yeh pak farishte bhi itni majal nahi rakhte ke Allah ke kisi mujrim ke Allah ke samne iski marzi ke khilaf sifarish ke liye lab hila saken. Jaise farman hai ayat (Man zallazi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-iznih) (Al-Baqarah: 255) Woh kaun hai jo iski ijazat ke baghair kisi ki sifarish iske paas le jasake? Aur ayat mein hai (Wa la tanfa'u-sh-shafa'atu 'indahu illa li-man azina lahu) (Saba: 23). Yaani iske paas kisi ki shafa'at iski apni ijazat ke baghair chal nahi sakti. Isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si aayatein Quran-e-Kareem mein mojood hain. Farishte aur Allah ke muqarrab bande kul ke kul khashiyat-e-Ilahi se, haibat-e-Rab se larzan wa tarsan raha karte hain. Unmein se jo bhi khudai ka dawa kare hum use Jahannam wasil kar denge zalimon se hum zaroor intiqam le liya karte hain. Yeh baat ba-taur shart hai aur shart ke liye yeh zaroori nahi ke iska waqoo bhi ho. Yaani yeh zaroori nahi ke khas bandgan-e-Allah mein se koi aisa napak dawa kare aur aisi sakht saza bhugte. Isi tarah ki ayat (Qul in kana li-r-rahmani waladun fa-ana awwalu-l-'abidin) (Az-Zukhruf: 81) aur (Wa la-in ashrakta la-yahbatanna 'amaluka wa la-takunanna mina-l-khasirin) (Az-Zumar: 65) hai. Pas na toh Rahman ki aulaad na Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se shirk mumkin.

Zabardast Ghalib Allah Ta'ala is baat ko bayaan farmata hai hai ke uski qudrat poori hai aur uska ghalba zabardast hai. Farmata hai ke jo kafir Allah ke siwa auron ki pooja paat karte hain kya unhein itna bhi ilm nahi ke tamam makhlooq ka paida karne wala Allah hi hai aur sab cheez ka nigehban bhi wahi hai phir uske sath doosron ki ibaadat tum kyun karte ho? Ibtada mein zameen-o-asman mile jule ek doosre se paiwast tah ba tah the, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein alag alag kiya, zameenein paida kin aur saat hi asman banaye. Zameen aur pehle asman ke darmiyan jauf aur khala rakha. Asman se pani barsaya aur zameen se paidawar ugayi. Har zinda cheez pani se paida ki. Kya yeh tamam cheezein jin mein se har ek sani-e-khud-mukhtari, qudrat aur wahdat par dalalat karti hai apne samne mojood pate hue bhi yeh log Allah ke azmat ke qail ho kar shirk ko nahi chhodte? Fafi kulli shayin lahu ayatun tadullu 'ala annahu wahid yaani har cheez mein Allah ki hukmarani aur uski wahdaniyat ka nishaan mojood hai. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se sawal hua ke pehle raat thi ya din? To Aap ne farmaya ke pehle zameen-o-asman mile jule tah ba tah the to zahir hai ke un mein andhera hoga aur andhere ka naam hi raat hai to sabit hua ke raat pehle thi. Ibn Umar (R.A) se jab is ayat ki tafseer poochhi gayi to Aap ne farmaya tum Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se sawal karo aur jo woh jawab dein mujh se bhi kaho, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya zameen-o-asman sab ek sath the, na barish barsti thi, na paidawar ugti. Jab Allah Ta'ala ne zi-rooh makhlooq paida ki to asman ko phaad kar us se pani barsaya aur zameen ko cheer kar us mein paidawar ugayi. Jab sail ne Hazrat Ibn Umar (R.A) se yeh jawab bayaan kiya to Aap bahut khush hue aur farmane lage aaj mujhe aur bhi yaqeen ho gaya ke Quran ke ilm mein Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) bahut hi badhe hue hain. Mere jee mein kabhi khyal aata tha ke aisa to nahi Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki jurrat badh gayi ho? Lek

Aap ne farmaya logon ko salam kiya karo aur khana khilaya karo aur silah-rahmi karte raho aur raat ko jab log sote hue hon to tum tahajjud ki namaz padha karo taake salamati ke sath jannat mein dakhil hojao. Zameen ko Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ne pahadoN ki meexoN se mazboot kardiya taake woh hil-jul kar logon ko pareshan na kare makhlooq ko zalzale mein na dale. Zameen ki teen chothaiyan to pani mein hain aur sirf chotha hissa sooraj aur hawa ke liye khula hua hai. Taake asman ko aur uske ajaibat ko ba-chashm-e-khud mulahiza kar saken. Phir zameen mein Allah Ta'ala ne apni rahmat-e-kamila se raahein banadin ke log ba-asani apne safar tay kar saken aur door-daraz mulkoN mein bhi pahunch saken. Shan-e-Ilahi dekhiye is hisse aur iske tukde ke darmiyan buland pahadi hail hai yahan se wahan pahunchna ba-zahir sakht dushwar maloom hota hai lekin qudrat-e-Ilahi khud is pahad mein rasta banaditi hai ke yahan ke log wahan aur wahan ke yahan pahunch jayen aur apne kaam-kaj poore kar len. Asman ko zameen par misl-e-qubbe ke banadiya jaise farman hai ke humne asman ko apne hathon se banaya aur hum wus'at aur kushaadgi wale hain farmata hai qasam asman ki aur uski banawat ki. Irshad hai kya unhoN ne nahi dekha ke humne unke saron par asman ko kis kaifiyat ka banaya hai aur kis tarah zeenat de rakhi hai aur lutf yeh hai ke itne bade asman mein koi sorakh tak nahi. Bana kehte hain qubbe ya kheme ke khada karne ko jaise Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke islam ki banayeN paanch hain jaise paanch suton par koi qubba ya khema khada hua ho. Phir asman jo misl-e-chhat ke hai. Yeh hai bhi mehfooz buland pehre chauki wala ke kahin se ise koi nuqsan nahi pahunchata. Buland-o-bala uncha aur saf hai jaise hadith mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke yeh asman kya hai? Aap ne farmaya ruki hui mauj hai. Yeh riwayat sanad-e-gharib hai lekin log Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon se bhi be-parwah hain. Jaise farman hai asman-o-zameen ki bahut si nishaniyan hain jo logon ki nigahon tale hain lekin phir bhi woh un se munh mode hue hain. Koi ghaur-o-fikr hi nahi karte kabhi nahi sochte ke kitna phela hua kitna buland kis qadar azeem-ush-shan yeh asman hamare saron par baghair suton ke Allah Ta'ala ne qaim kar rakha hai. Phir is mein kis khoobsurati se sitaron ka jadaw ho raha hai. In mein bhi koi thehra hua hai koi chalta phirta hai. Phir sooraj ki chaal muqarrar hai. Uski maujudgi din hai uska nazar na ana raat hai. Poore asman ka chakkar sirf ek din raat mein sooraj poora kar leta hai. Uski chaal ko uski tezi ko bajuz Allah ke koi nahi janta. Yun qiyas-araiyan aur andaze karna aur baat hai. Bani Israel ke abidon mein se ek ne apni tees saal ki muddat-e-ibadat poori karli magar jis tarah aur abidon par tees saal ki ibadat ke baad abr ka saya hojaya karta tha us par na hua to us ne apni walida se yeh haal bayan kiya. Us ne kaha bete tum ne apni is ibadat ke zamane mein koi gunah karliya hoga?

Us ne kaha amma ek bhi nahi. Kaha phir tum ne kisi gunah ka poora qasd kiya hoga jawab diya ke aisa bhi mutlaqan nahi hua. Maan ne kaha bohat mumkin hai ke tum ne asman ki taraf nazar ki ho aur ghor-o-tadabbur ke baghair hi hata li ho. Aahid ne jawab diya aisa to barabar hota raha farmaya bas yehi sabab hai. Phir apni qudrat-e-kamilah ki baaz nishaniyan bayan farmata hai ke raat aur us ke andhere ko dekho, din aur us ki roshni par nazar dalo, phir ek ke baad dusre ka barhna dekho, suraj chand ko dekho. Suraj ka noor ek makhsoos noor hai aur uska asman uska zamana uski harkat uski chaal alag hai. Chand ka noor alag hai, falak alag hai, chaal alag hai, andaaz aur hai. Aap ne farmaya logon ko salam kiya karo aur khana khilaya karo aur silah-rahmi karte raho aur raat ko jab log sote hue hon to tum tahajjud ki namaz padha karo taake salamati ke sath jannat mein dakhil hojao. Zameen ko Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ne pahadoN ki meexoN se mazboot kardiya taake woh hil-jul kar logon ko pareshan na kare makhlooq ko zalzale mein na dale. Zameen ki teen chothaiyan to pani mein hain aur sirf chotha hissa sooraj aur hawa ke liye khula hua hai. Taake asman ko aur uske ajaibat ko ba-chashm-e-khud mulahiza kar saken. Phir zameen mein Allah Ta'ala ne apni rahmat-e-kamila se raahein banadin ke log ba-asani apne safar tay kar saken aur door-daraz mulkoN mein bhi pahunch saken. Shan-e-Ilahi dekhiye is hisse aur iske tukde ke darmiyan buland pahadi hail hai yahan se wahan pahunchna ba-zahir sakht dushwar maloom hota hai lekin qudrat-e-Ilahi khud is pahad mein rasta banaditi hai ke yahan ke log wahan aur wahan ke yahan pahunch jayen aur apne kaam-kaj poore kar len. Asman ko zameen par misl-e-qubbe ke banadiya jaise farman hai ke humne asman ko apne hathon se banaya aur hum wus'at aur kushaadgi wale hain farmata hai qasam asman ki aur uski banawat ki. Irshad hai kya unhoN ne nahi dekha ke humne unke saron par asman ko kis kaifiyat ka banaya hai aur kis tarah zeenat de rakhi hai aur lutf yeh hai ke itne bade asman mein koi sorakh tak nahi. Bana kehte hain qubbe ya kheme ke khada karne ko jaise Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke islam ki banayeN paanch hain jaise paanch suton par koi qubba ya khema khada hua ho. Phir asman jo misl-e-chhat ke hai. Yeh hai bhi mehfooz buland pehre chauki wala ke kahin se ise koi nuqsan nahi pahunchata. Buland-o-bala uncha aur saf hai jaise hadith mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke yeh asman kya hai? Aap ne farmaya ruki hui mauj hai. Yeh riwayat sanad-e-gharib hai lekin log Allah ki in zabardast nishaniyon se bhi be-parwah hain. Jaise farman hai asman-o-zameen ki bahut si nishaniyan hain jo logon ki nigahon tale hain lekin phir bhi woh un se munh mode hue hain. Koi ghaur-o-fikr hi nahi karte kabhi nahi sochte ke kitna phela hua kitna buland kis qadar azeem-ush-shan yeh asman hamare saron par baghair suton ke Allah Ta'ala ne qaim kar rakha hai. Phir is mein kis khoobsurati se sitaron ka jadaw ho raha hai. In mein bhi koi thehra hua hai koi chalta phirta hai. Phir sooraj ki chaal muqarrar hai. Uski maujudgi din hai uska nazar na ana raat hai. Poore asman ka chakkar sirf ek din raat mein sooraj poora kar leta hai. Uski chaal ko uski tezi ko bajuz Allah ke koi nahi janta. Yun qiyas-araiyan aur andaze karna aur baat hai. Bani Israel ke abidon mein se ek ne apni tees saal ki muddat-e-ibadat poori karli magar jis tarah aur abidon par tees saal ki ibadat ke baad abr ka saya hojaya karta tha us par na hua to us ne apni walida se yeh haal bayan kiya. Us ne kaha bete tum ne apni is ibadat ke zamane mein koi gunah karliya hoga?

To kya yeh hamesha rehne wale hain? Aisa to mahz na-mumkin hai, duniya mein to chal-chalao lag raha hai. Kisi ko bijuz zat-e-bari ke dawam nahi. Koi aage hai koi peechhe. Phir farmaya maut ka zaika har ek ko chakhna parega. Hazrat Imam Shafie (Rahimahullah) farmaya karte thay ke log meri maut ke aarzu-mand hain to kya iske bare mein main hi akela hoon? Yeh woh zaika nahi jo kisi ko chhor de. Phir farmata hai bhalaai burai se, sukh dukh se, mithaas karwahat se, kushaadgi tangi se. Hum apne bando ko aazma lete hain taake shukar-guzaar aur na-shukra, sabir aur na-umeed khul jaye. Sehat-o-beemari, tongri, faqiri, sakhti, narmi, halal, haram, hidayat, gumrahi, itaat, masiyat yeh sab aazmaishein hain, is mein bhale bure khul jate hain. Tumhara sab ka lotna hamari hi taraf hai, us waqt jo jaisa tha khul jayega. Buro ko saza, neko ko jaza milegi.

Yeh ghalat hai ke woh ab tak zinda hon kyunke woh bhi insan hi thay, wali hon ya nabi hon ya rasul hon, thay to insan hi. In kuffar ki yeh aarzu kitni napak hai ke tum marjao? To kya yeh hamesha rehne wale hain? Aisa to mahz na-mumkin hai, duniya mein to chal-chalao lag raha hai. Kisi ko bijuz zat-e-bari ke dawam nahi. Koi aage hai koi peechhe. Phir farmaya maut ka zaika har ek ko chakhna parega. Hazrat Imam Shafie (Rahimahullah) farmaya karte thay ke log meri maut ke aarzu-mand hain to kya iske bare mein main hi akela hoon? Yeh woh zaika nahi jo kisi ko chhor de. Phir farmata hai bhalaai burai se, sukh dukh se, mithaas karwahat se, kushaadgi tangi se. Hum apne bando ko aazma lete hain taake shukar-guzaar aur na-shukra, sabir aur na-umeed khul jaye. Sehat-o-beemari, tongri, faqiri, sakhti, narmi, halal, haram, hidayat, gumrahi, itaat, masiyat yeh sab aazmaishein hain, is mein bhale bure khul jate hain. Tumhara sab ka lotna hamari hi taraf hai, us waqt jo jaisa tha khul jayega. Buro ko saza, neko ko jaza milegi.

Jild-baaz insan! Abu Jahl waghera kuffar-e-Quraish An-Hazrat ﷺ ko dekhte hi hansi mazaq shuru kar dete aur Aap ki shan mein be-adabi karne lagte. Kehne lagte ke lo miyan dekh lo, yahi hain jo hamare maboodon ko bura kehte hain. Allah ke munkar, Rasool Allah ke munkar aur ayat mein un ke usi kufr ka bayan karke farmaya gaya hai ayat (In kada liydillana 'an alihatna). Yani woh to kahiye hum jame rahe warna us ne to humein hamare purane maboodon se bargashta karne mein koi kami nahi chhodi thi. Khair unhein azab ke mu'aina se maloom ho jaye ga ke gumrah kaun tha? Insan bara jild-baaz hai.

Hazrat Mujahid ؒ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tamam cheezon ki paidaish ke baad Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida karna shuru kiya sham ke qareeb jab un mein rooh phoonki gayi, sar aankh aur zaban mein jab rooh aa gayi to kehne lage ilahi maghrib se pehle hi meri paidaish mukammal ho jaye. 

Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain tamam dinon mein behtar wa afzal din Jumah ka din hai isi mein Hazrat Adam A.S paida kiye gaye, isi mein jannat mein dakhil hue, isi mein wahan se utare gaye, isi mein qayamat qaim hogi, isi din mein ek aisi saat hai ke us waqt jo banda namaz mein ho aur Allah Ta'ala se jo kuch talab kare Allah use ata farmata hai. Aap ne apni ungliyon se ishara karke batlaya ke woh saat bahut thodi si hai. 

Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam ؓ farmate hain mujhe maloom hai ke woh saat kaun si hai, woh Jumah ke din ki aakhri saat hai isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida kiya. Phir Aap ne yahi ayat padhi.

Pehli ayat mein kafiron ka zikr karke is ke baad hi insani ujlat ka zikr is hikmat se hai ke goya kafiron ki sarkashi sunte hi musalman ka intiqami jazba bhadak uthta hai aur woh jald badla lena chahta hai is liye ke insani jablat mein jild-bazi hai. Lekin aadat-e-Ilahi yeh hai ke woh zalimon ko dheel deta hai phir jab pakadta hai to chhodta nahi. Isi liye farmaya ke main tumhein apni nishaniyan dikhane wala hoon ke aasiyon par kis tarah sakhti hoti hai. Mere Nabi ko mazaq mein udane walon ki kis tarah khaal udhadti hai tum abhi dekh loge. Jaldi na machao der hai andher nahi muhlat hai bhool nahi.

Khud azab ke talib log azab-e-ilahi ko, qayamat ke ane ko yeh log chunke mahal jante the is liye jurrat se kehte the ke batao to sahi tumhare yeh darawe kab pure honge? Unhe jawab diya jata hai ke tum agar samajh-dar hote aur us din ki holnakiyon se agah hote toh jaldi na machate us waqt azab-e-ilahi ooper tale se orhna bichona bane hue honge, taqat na hogi ke age peche se Allah ka azab hata sako. Gandhak ka libas hoga jis mein ag lagi hui hogi aur khare jal rahe honge, har taraf se jahannam ghere hue hogi. Koi na hoga jo madad ko uthe jahannam achanak daboch legi us waqt hairan-o-shashdar reh jaoge mabhoot aur behosh ho jaoge, koi hila na milega ke ise dafa karo, is se bach jao aur na ek sa'at ki dheel aur mohlat milegi.

Ambiya ki takzeeb kafiron ka shewa hai Allah Ta'ala apne paighambar ﷺ ko tasalli dete hue farmata hai ki tumhe jo sataya ja raha hai, mazak mein udaya jata hai aur jhoota kaha jata hai us par pareshan na hona, kafiron ki yeh purani aadat hai. Agle nabiyon ke sath bhi unhon ne yahi kiya jis ki wajah se aakhirash azabon mein phans gaye. Jaise farman hai aayat (Walaqad kuzzibat rusulun min qablika fasabaru 'ala ma kuzzibu wa uzu hatta atahum nasruna wala mubaddila likalimatil lahi walaqad jaaka min naba-il mursalin 34) (Al-An'am: 34), tujh se pehle ke ambiya bhi jhutlaye gaye aur unhon ne apne jhutlaye jane par sabr kiya yahan tak ke unke pas hamari madad aa gayi. Allah ki baton ka badalne wala koi nahi tumhare pas rasulon ki khabrein aa chuki hain. Phir apni nemat bayan farmata hai ki woh tum sab ki hifazat din raat apni un ankhon se kar raha hai jo na kabhi thaken na soyen. Min ar-Rahman ka mani Rahman ke badle yaani Rahman ke siwa hain arabi sheron mein bhi min badal ke mani mein hai. Isi ek ehsaan par kya moquf hai yeh kuffar to Allah ke har ek ehsaan ki nashukri karte hain balki uske nematon ke munkar aur un se munh pherne wale hain? Yani woh aisa nahi kar sakte unka guman yeh mahz ghalat hai, balki unke mabudan-e-batil khud apni hifazat ke bhi malik nahi. Balki woh hum se bach bhi nahi sakte. Hamari janib se koi khabar unke hathon mein nahi. Ek mani is jumle ke yeh bhi hain ki na to woh kisi ko bacha saken na khud bacha saken.

Zillat-o-ruswai ke maare log kafir setDescription ki aur apni gumraahi par jam jaane ki wajah bayan ho rahi hai ke unhe khane peene ko milta raha, lambi lambi umrein milin. Unhone samajh liya ke hamare kartoot Allah ko pasand hain, iske baad unhe nasehat karta hai ke kya woh yeh nahi dekhte ke humne kafirun ki bastiyon ki bastiyan wajah unke kufr ke miliameet kar din? Is jumle ke aur bhi bahut se maane kiye gaye hain jo Surah Ra'd mein hum bayan kar aaye hain. Lekin zyada theek maane yahi hain. Jaise farmaya ayat: (Wa laqad ahlakna ma hawlakum minal-qura wa sarrafnal-ayati la'allahum yarji'un) (Al-Ahqaf: 27). Hum ne tumhare aas paas ki bastiyan halak keen aur apni nishaniyaan her pher kar ke tumhe dikha din taake log apni buraiyon se baaz aa jayen. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah ne iske ek maane yeh bhi bayan kiye hain ke hum kufr par Islam ko ghalib karte chale hain kya tum isse ibrat hasil nahi karte ke kis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne apne doston ko apne dushmanon par ghalib kar diya aur kis tarah jhutlane wali agli umton ko is ne miliameet kar diya aur apne momino ko najaat de di kya ab bhi yeh log apne aap ko ghalib hi samajh rahe hain? Nahi nahi balki yeh maghloob hain, zaleel hain, razeel hain, nuqsaan mein hain, barbadi ke tahet hain. Main to Allah ki taraf se muballigh hoon, jin jin azabon se tumhe khabardar kar raha hoon yeh apni taraf se nahi hai balki Allah ka kaha hua hai. Haan jin ki aankhein Allah ne andhi kar di hain, jin ke dil-o-dimaagh band kar diye hain unhe Allah ki yeh baatein soodmand nahi padteen. Behron ko aagah karna bekaar hai kyunki woh to sunte hi nahi. In gunahgaaron par ek adna sa bhi azab aa jaye to wawila karne lagte hain aur usi waqt besakhta apne qusoor ka iqrara kar lete hain. Qayamat ke din adl ki tarazu qaim ki jayegi. Yeh tarazu ek hi hogi lekin chunke jo amaal is mein tole jayenge woh bahut se honge, is ehtebar se lafz jama laaye. Us din kisi par kisi tarah ka zara sa bhi zulm na hoga. Is liye ke hisab lene wala khud Allah hai jo akela hi tamam makhlooq ke hisab ke liye kafi hai har chhote se chhota amal bhi wahan maujud ho jayega. Aur ayat mein farmaya tera Rab kisi par zulm na karega. Farman hai ayat: (Inna Allaha la yazlimu mithqala zarratin) (An-Nisa: 40), Allah Ta'ala ek raai ke daane barabar bhi zulm nahi karta, neki ko barhata hai aur uska ajr apne paas se bahut bada inayat farmata hai. Hazrat Luqman Rahimahullah ne apni wasiyaton mein apne bete se farmaya tha ek raai ke daane barabar bhi jo amal ho khwah woh pathar mein ho ya aasmano mein ho ya zameen mein ho Allah use layega woh bada hi barik been aur ba-khabar hai.

Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain do kalme hain zuban par halke hain, mizan mein wazan daar hain aur Allah ko bahut pyare hain Subhan Allahi wa Bihamdihi Subhan Allahil Azeem. Musnad Ahmad hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain meri ummat ke ek shakhs ko Qiyamat ke din Allah Ta'ala tamam ahl-e-mahshar ke samne apne paas bulayega aur us ke gunahon ke ek kam ek sau daftar us ke samne khole jayenge jahan tak nigah kaam kare wahan tak ka ek ek daftar hoga phir us se Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala daryaft farmayega ke kya tujhe apne kiye hue in gunahon mein se kisi ka inkar hai? Meri taraf se jo muhafiz farishte tere aamal likhne par muqarrar the unhon ne tujh par koi zulm to nahi kiya? Yeh jawab dega ke اے Allah na inkar ki gunjaish hai na yeh keh sakta hoon ke zulm kiya. Allah Ta'ala farmayega achha tera koi uzr hai ya koi neki hai? Woh ghabraya hua kahega اے Allah koi nahi. Parwardigar-e-Aalam farmayega kyun nahi? Beshak teri ek neki hamare paas hai aur aaj tujh par koi zulm na hoga ab ek chhota sa parcha nikala jayega jis mein (Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan Rasulullah) likha hua hoga. Allah Ta'ala farmayega ise pesh karo. Woh kahega اے Allah yeh parcha in daftaron ke muqable mein kya karega? Janab-e-Bari farmayega tujh par zulm na kiya jayega. Ab tamam ke tamam daftar tarazu ke ek palle mein rakhe jayenge aur woh parcha dusre palde mein rakha jayega to us parche ka wazan in tamam daftaron se barh jayega. Yeh jhuk jayega aur unche ho jayenge aur Allah Rahman o Rahim ke naam se koi cheez wazni na hogi. Ibn Majah aur Tirmizi mein riwayat hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Qiyamat ke din jab tarazuwein rakhi jayengi pas ek shakhs ko laya jaye aur ek palde mein rakha jayega aur jo kuch us par shumar kiya gaya hai woh bhi rakha jayega to woh palda jhuk jayega aur ise Jahannam ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga. Abhi us ne peeth pheri hi hogi ke Allah ki taraf se ek aawaz dene wala farishta aawaz dega aur kahega jaldi na karo ek cheez is ki abhi baqi gayi hai phir ek parcha nikala jayega jis mein La ilaha illallah hoga woh us shakhs ke sath tarazu ke palde mein rakha jayega aur yeh palda neki ka jhuk jayega. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek Sahabi Rasulullah ﷺ ke pas baith kar kehne laga ke Ya Rasulullah mere ghulam hain jo mujhe jhutlate bhi hain, meri khiyanat bhi karte hain, meri nafarmani bhi karte hain aur main bhi unhein marta peetta hoon aur bura bhala bhi kehta hoon. Agar teri saza un ki khataon ke barabar hui to tu chhoot gaya. Na azab na sawab haan agar teri saza kam rahi to tujhe Allah ka fazal o karam milega aur agar teri saza un ke kartuton se barh gayi to tujh se us barhi hui saza ka intiqam liya jayega. Yeh sun kar woh Sahabi rone lage aur cheekhna shuru kar diya. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ise kya ho gaya?

Kya usne Quran-e-Kareem mein yeh nahi पढ़ा ayat (Wana'du al-mawazeena al-qista liyaum al-qiyamati fala tuzlamu nafsun shai'an 47) 21. Al-Anbiya: 47. Yeh sun kar us sahabi R.A ne kaha Ya RasoolAllah ﷺ in mamlaat ko sun kar to mera ji chahta hai ki main apne in tamam ghulamon ko azad kar dun. Aap gawah rahiye yeh sab Allah ki rah mein azad hain.

Farman hai ayat: (Inna Allaha la yazlimu mithqala zarratin) (An-Nisa: 40), Allah Ta'ala ek raai ke daane barabar bhi zulm nahi karta, neki ko barhata hai aur uska ajr apne paas se bahut bada inayat farmata hai. Hazrat Luqman Rahimahullah ne apni wasiyaton mein apne bete se farmaya tha ek raai ke daane barabar bhi jo amal ho khwah woh pathar mein ho ya aasmano mein ho ya zameen mein ho Allah use layega woh bada hi barik been aur ba-khabar hai.

Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain do kalme hain zuban par halke hain, mizan mein wazan daar hain aur Allah ko bahut pyare hain Subhan Allahi wa Bihamdihi Subhan Allahil Azeem. Musnad Ahmad hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain meri ummat ke ek shakhs ko Qiyamat ke din Allah Ta'ala tamam ahl-e-mahshar ke samne apne paas bulayega aur us ke gunahon ke ek kam ek sau daftar us ke samne khole jayenge jahan tak nigah kaam kare wahan tak ka ek ek daftar hoga phir us se Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala daryaft farmayega ke kya tujhe apne kiye hue in gunahon mein se kisi ka inkar hai? Meri taraf se jo muhafiz farishte tere aamal likhne par muqarrar the unhon ne tujh par koi zulm to nahi kiya? Yeh jawab dega ke اے Allah na inkar ki gunjaish hai na yeh keh sakta hoon ke zulm kiya. Allah Ta'ala farmayega achha tera koi uzr hai ya koi neki hai? Woh ghabraya hua kahega اے Allah koi nahi. Parwardigar-e-Aalam farmayega kyun nahi? Beshak teri ek neki hamare paas hai aur aaj tujh par koi zulm na hoga ab ek chhota sa parcha nikala jayega jis mein (Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan Rasulullah) likha hua hoga. Allah Ta'ala farmayega ise pesh karo. Woh kahega اے Allah yeh parcha in daftaron ke muqable mein kya karega? Janab-e-Bari farmayega tujh par zulm na kiya jayega. Ab tamam ke tamam daftar tarazu ke ek palle mein rakhe jayenge aur woh parcha dusre palde mein rakha jayega to us parche ka wazan in tamam daftaron se barh jayega. Yeh jhuk jayega aur unche ho jayenge aur Allah Rahman o Rahim ke naam se koi cheez wazni na hogi. Ibn Majah aur Tirmizi mein riwayat hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Qiyamat ke din jab tarazuwein rakhi jayengi pas ek shakhs ko laya jaye aur ek palde mein rakha jayega aur jo kuch us par shumar kiya gaya hai woh bhi rakha jayega to woh palda jhuk jayega aur ise Jahannam ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek Sahabi Rasulullah ﷺ ke pas baith kar kehne laga ke Ya Rasulullah mere ghulam hain jo mujhe jhutlate bhi hain, meri khiyanat bhi karte hain, meri nafarmani bhi karte hain aur main bhi unhein marta peetta hoon aur bura bhala bhi kehta hoon. Agar teri saza un ki khataon ke barabar hui to tu chhoot gaya. Na azab na sawab haan agar teri saza kam rahi to tujhe Allah ka fazal o karam milega aur agar teri saza un ke kartuton se barh gayi to tujh se us barhi hui saza ka intiqam liya jayega. Yeh sun kar woh Sahabi rone lage aur cheekhna shuru kar diya. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ise kya ho gaya?

Is jumle ke aur bhi bahut se maane kiye gaye hain jo Surah Ra'd mein hum bayan kar aaye hain. Lekin zyada theek maane yahi hain. Hamara etraz jo tum par hai wohi tumhare aglon par hai. Aik gumrahi mein tumhare bare mubtala hon aur tum bhi ismein mubtala ho jao to woh bhalayi banne se rahi? Main kehta hoon tum aur tumhare baap dada sabhi rah-e-haq se bargashta ho gaye ho aur khuli gumrahi mein doobe hue ho. 

Ab to unke kaan khade hue kyunki unhone apne aqal-mandon ki toheen dekhi, apne baap dadon ki nisbat na sunne wale kalmaat sune.

Apne ma'budon ki haqarat hoti hui dekhi toh ghabra gaye aur kehne lage, "Aiy Ibrahim, kya waqai tum theek keh rahe ho ya mazaq kar rahe ho? Hum ne toh aisi baat kabhi nahi suni." Aap ko tabligh ka moqa mila aur saaf elan kiya ke Rab toh sirf Khaliq-e-Asman-o-Zameen hi hai. Tamam cheezon ka Khaliq-o-Malik wahi hai, tumhare yeh ma'bud kisi adna si cheez ke bhi khaliq hain na malik. Phir ma'bud-e-masjud kaise ho gaye? Meri gawahi hai ke Khaliq-o-Malik Allah hi layiq-e-ibadat hai, na iske siva koi Rab na ma'bud.

Kufr se bezari tabiyat mein izmihlal paida karti hai, upar zikr guzra ke Khalilullah A.S ne apni kaum ko but-parasti se roka aur jazba-e-tauheed mein akar aap ne qasam kha li ke main tumhare in buton ka zaroor kuch na kuch ilaaj karunga. Isey bhi kaum ke ba'az afraad ne sun liya. Unka eid ka din jo muqarrar tha Hazrat Khalilullah A.S ne farmaya ke jab tum apni rusoom-e-eid ada karne ke liye bahar jaoge, main tumhare buton ko theek kar dunga. Eid ke ek aadh din peshtar aap ke walid ne aap se kaha ke pyare bete, tum hamare sath hamari eid mein chalo taake tumhein hamare deen ki achhai aur raunaq maloom ho jaye. Chunancha yeh aap ko le chala. Kuch door jane ke baad Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salatu Wassalam gir pade aur farmane lage, aba main bemaar ho gaya. Baap aap ko chhod kar marasim-e-kufr baja lane ke liye badh gaye aur jo log raste se guzarte aap se poochte, kya baat hai raste par kaise baithe ho? Jawab dete ke main bemaar hoon. Jab aam log nikal gaye aur budhe bade log reh gaye toh aap ne farmaye, tum sab ke chale jane ke baad aaj main tumhare ma'aboodon ki marmat kar dunga. Aap ne jo farmaya ke main bemaar hoon toh waaqai aap us din ke agle din qadre aleel bhi thay. Jab ke woh log chale gaye toh maidan khali pa kar aap ne apna irada poora kiya aur bade but ko chhod kar tamam buton ka choora kar diya. Jaise aur aayaton mein iska tafseeli bayan maujood hai ke apne hath se in buton ke tukde tukde kar diye. Is bade but ke baqi rakhne mein hikmat-o-maslihat yeh thi ke awwalan in logon ke zehn mein khayal aaye ke shayad is bade but ne in chhote buton ko gharat kar diya hoga? Kyunke isse ghairat maloom hui hogi ke mujh bade ke hote hue yeh chhote khudai ke laaiq kaise ho gaye. Chunancha is khayal ki pukhtagi unke zehn mein qaim karne ke liye aap ne kulhada bhi uski gardan par rakh diya tha. Jaise marwi hai. Jab yeh mushrikeen apne mele se wapas aaye toh dekha ke unke sare ma'abood munh ke bal ondhe gire hue hain aur apni halat se woh bata rahe hain ke woh mahz be-jaan, be-nafa-o-nuqsaan, zaleel-o-haqeer cheez hain aur goya apni is halat se apne pujariyon ki be-waqufi par mohar laga rahe the. Lekin in bewqufon par ulta asar hua, kehne lage yeh kaun zalim shakhs tha jis ne hamare ma'aboodon ki aisi ihanat ki? Us waqt jin logon ne Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ka woh kalam suna tha, unhein khayal aa gaya aur kehne lage woh naujawan jiska naam Ibrahim hai, use hum ne apne ma'aboodon ki mazammat karte hue suna hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A is aayat ko padhte aur farmate jo nabi aaya jawan, jo aalim bana jawan. Shaan-e-Ilahi dekhiye jo maqsad Hazrat Khalilullah alaihi salawatullah ka tha, woh ab poora ho raha hai. Kaum ke yeh log mashwara karte hain ke aao sab ko jama karo aur use bulao aur phir usko saza do. Hazrat Khalilullah yehi chahte the ke koi aisa majma ho aur main us mein inki galtiyan un par wazeh karun aur un mein tauheed ki tabligh karun aur unhein batlaun ke yeh kaise zalim-o-jahil hain?

ke un ki ibadatein karte hain jo nafa nuqsaan ke maalik nahin balki apni jaan ka bhi ikhtiyar nahin rakhte. Chunacha majma hua. Sab chhote bade aa gaye, Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam bhi mulzim ki haisiyat se maujud hue aur aap se sawal hua ke hamare khudaon ke sath yeh lagho harkat tum ne ki hai? Is par aap ne unhein qayil maaqool karne ke liye farmaya ke yeh kaam to un ke is bade but ne kiya hai. Aur is ki taraf ishara kiya jise aap ne toda na tha phir farmaya ke mujh se kya poochte ho? Apne in maboodon se hi kyun daryaft nahin karte ke tumhare tukde udane wala kaun hai? Is se maqsood Khalilullah Alaihis Salam ka yeh tha ke yeh log khud-ba-khud hi samajh lein ke yeh patthar kya bolenge? Aur jab woh itne aajiz hain toh yeh laiq-e-ibadat kaise thahar sakte hain? Chunacha yeh maqsad bhi aap ka bifzl-e-Ilahi poora hua aur yeh doosri zarb bhi kaari lagi. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Khalilullah ne teen jhoot bole hain, do toh rah-e-Khuda mein. Ek toh un ka yeh farmana ke in buton ko un ke bade ne toda hai. Doosra yeh farmana ke main bimar hoon. Aur ek martiba Hazrat Sarah ke sath safar mein the. Ittefaq se ek zalim ki hudood se aap guzar rahe the aap ne wahan manzil ki thi. Kisi ne badshah ko khabar kar di ke ek musafir ke sath behtareen aurat hai aur woh is waqt hamari saltanat mein hai. Badshah ne jhat sipahi bheja ke woh Hazrat Sarah ko le aaye. Us ne poocha ke tumhare sath yeh kaun hai? Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne farmaya meri bahan hai. Us ne kaha ise badshah ke darbar mein bhejo. Aap Hazrat Sarah ke paas gaye aur farmaya suno is zalim ne tumhein talab kiya hai aur main tumhein apni bahan bata chuka hoon agar tum se bhi poocha jaye toh yahi kehna is liye ke deen ke aitbaar se tum meri bahan ho, ro-e-zameen par mere aur tumhare siwa koi musalman nahin. Yeh keh kar aap chale aaye Hazrat Sarah wahan se chalien aap namaz mein khade ho gaye. Jab Hazrat Sarah ko is zalim ne dekha aur un ki taraf lapka usi waqt Allah ke azab ne use pakad liya hath paon ainth gaye. Teesri dafa chhootte hi us ne apne qareeb ke mulazim ko awaz di aur kaha tu mere paas kisi insan aurat ko nahin laya balki shaitana ko laya hai ja ise nikaal aur Hajra ko is ke sath kar de. Usi waqt aap wahan se nikaal di gain aur Hazrat Hajra aap ke hawale ki gain. Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne un ki aahat pate hi namaz se faraghat hasil ki aur daryaft farmaya ke kaho kya guzri?

Aap ne farmaya Allah ne us kafir ke makar ko usi par lota diya aur Hajra meri khidmat ke liye aa gain. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A is hadith ko bayan farma kar farmate ke yeh hain tumhari amman, hey aasmani pani ke ladko.

Is par aap ne unhein qayil maaqool karne ke liye farmaya ke yeh kaam to un ke is bade but ne kiya hai. Aur is ki taraf ishara kiya jise aap ne toda na tha phir farmaya ke mujh se kya poochte ho? Apne in maboodon se hi kyun daryaft nahin karte ke tumhare tukde udane wala kaun hai? Is se maqsood Khalilullah Alaihis Salam ka yeh tha ke yeh log khud-ba-khud hi samajh lein ke yeh patthar kya bolenge? Aur jab woh itne aajiz hain toh yeh laiq-e-ibadat kaise thahar sakte hain? Chunacha yeh maqsad bhi aap ka bifzl-e-Ilahi poora hua aur yeh doosri zarb bhi kaari lagi. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Khalilullah ne teen jhoot bole hain, do toh rah-e-Khuda mein. Ek toh un ka yeh farmana ke in buton ko un ke bade ne toda hai. Doosra yeh farmana ke main bimar hoon. Aur ek martiba Hazrat Sarah ke sath safar mein the. Ittefaq se ek zalim ki hudood se aap guzar rahe the aap ne wahan manzil ki thi. Kisi ne badshah ko khabar kar di ke ek musafir ke sath behtareen aurat hai aur woh is waqt hamari saltanat mein hai. Badshah ne jhat sipahi bheja ke woh Hazrat Sarah ko le aaye. Us ne poocha ke tumhare sath yeh kaun hai? Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne farmaya meri bahan hai. Us ne kaha ise badshah ke darbar mein bhejo. Aap Hazrat Sarah ke paas gaye aur farmaya suno is zalim ne tumhein talab kiya hai aur main tumhein apni bahan bata chuka hoon agar tum se bhi poocha jaye toh yahi kehna is liye ke deen ke aitbaar se tum meri bahan ho, ro-e-zameen par mere aur tumhare siwa koi musalman nahin. Yeh keh kar aap chale aaye Hazrat Sarah wahan se chalien aap namaz mein khade ho gaye. Jab Hazrat Sarah ko is zalim ne dekha aur un ki taraf lapka usi waqt Allah ke azab ne use pakad liya hath paon ainth gaye. Ghabra kar aajizi se kehne laga ae naik aurat Allah se dua kar ke woh mujhe chhod de main wada karta hoon ke tujhe hath bhi nahin lagaunga. Aap ne dua ki usi waqt woh achha ho gaya lekin achha hote hi us ne phir qasd kiya aur aap ko pakadna chaha wohi phir azab-e-Ilahi aa pohncha aur yeh pehli dafa se zyada sakht pakad liya gaya phir aajizi karne laga gharz teen dafa pai dar pai yahi hua. Teesri dafa chhootte hi us ne apne qareeb ke mulazim ko awaz di aur kaha tu mere paas kisi insan aurat ko nahin laya balki shaitana ko laya hai ja ise nikaal aur Hajra ko is ke sath kar de. Usi waqt aap wahan se nikaal di gain aur Hazrat Hajra aap ke hawale ki gain. Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne un ki aahat pate hi namaz se faraghat hasil ki aur daryaft farmaya ke kaho kya guzri?

Aap ne farmaya Allah ne us kafir ke makar ko usi par lota diya aur Hajra meri khidmat ke liye aa gain. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A is hadith ko bayan farma kar farmate ke yeh hain tumhari amman, hey aasmani pani ke ladko.

Apni himaqat se pareshan kafir bayan ho raha hai ke Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) ki baatein sun kar unhein khayal toh paida ho gaya. Apne aap ko apni bewqufi par malamat karne lage. Sakht nadamat uthai aur aapas mein kehne lage ke hum ne badi galti ki, apne maboodon ke paas kisi ko hifazat ke liye na chhoda aur chal diye. Phir ghor-o-fikr karke baat banai ke aap jo kuch hum se kehte hain ke unhein hum pooch lein ke tumhein kis ne toda hai toh kya aap ko ilm nahi ke yeh بت (but) bezubaan hain? Aajizi, hairat aur intehai lajawabi ki haalat mein unhein is baat ka ikraar karna pada. Ab Hazrat Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) ko khaasa moqa mil gaya aur aap foran farmane lage ke bezubaan, benafa-o-zarr cheez ki ibadat kaisi? Tum kyun is قدر besamjh rahe ho? Taf hai tum par aur tumhare in jhoote khudaon par, ah kis قدر zulm-o-jahl hai ke aisi cheezon ki parastish ki jaye aur Allah Wahid ko chhod diya jaye? Yahi thi woh dalelein jin ka zikr pehle hua tha ke hum ne Ibrahim ko dalelein sikha dien jin se qoum haqeeqat tak pahunch jaye.

Aag gulistan ban gayi yeh qaida hai ki jab insan daleel se lajawab hojata hai toh ya neki use ghasit leti hai ya badi ghalib ajati hai. Yahan un logon ki badbakhti ne gher liya aur daleel se aajiz akar qail maqool ho kar lage apne dabaa ka muzahira karne aapas mein mashwara kiya ki Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ko aag mein daal kar uski jaan le lo taaki hamare in ma'budon ki izzat rahe. Is baat par sab ne ittefaq kar liya aur lakdiyan jama karni shuru kar diyan yahan tak ki bimar auratein bhi nazr maanti thin toh yahi ki agar unhein shifa hojaye toh Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke jalane ko lakdiyan laayengi. Zameen mein ek bahut bada aur bahut gehra gadha khoda lakdiyon se pur kiya aur anbaar khada karke us mein aag lagayi roo-e-zameen par kabhi itni badi aag dekhi nahi gayi. Jab aag ke sholae aasman se baatein karne lage uske paas jana mahal ho gaya ab ghabraaye ki Khalilullah (Alaihis Salam) ko aag mein daalen kaise? Aakhir ek Kurdi Farsi Aarabi ke mashwore se jiska naam Haizan tha ek manjaniq tayar karayi gayi ki us mein baitha kar jhoola kar phenk do. Marwi hai ki usko Allah Ta'ala ne usi waqt zameen mein dhansa diya aur qayamat tak woh andar utarta jata hai. Jab aapko aag mein dala gaya aap ne farmaya Hasbiyallahu Wa Ni'mal Wakeel, An-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur aap ke sahaba ke paas bhi jab yeh khabar pahunchi ki tamam arab lashkar-e-jarrar lekar aap ke mukable ke liye aa rahe hain toh aap ne bhi yahi padha tha. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki jab aap ko aag mein dalne lage toh aap ne farmaya Ilaahi tu aasmanon mein akela ma'bud hai aur tauheed ke sath tera aabid zameen par sirf main hi hoon. Marwi hai ki jab kafir aap ko baandhne lage toh aap ne farmaya Ilaahi tere siva koi laaiq-e-ibadat nahi teri zaat paak hai tamam hamd-o-sana tere hi liye sazawar hai. Sare mulk ka tu akela hi maalik hai koi bhi tera shareek-o-saajhi nahi. Hazrat Shoaib Jabai farmate hain ki us waqt aap ki umr sirf solah saal ki thi. Wallahu A'lam. Ba'z salaf se manqool hai ki usi waqt Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) aap ke samne aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan zahir hue aur farmaya kya aap ko koi haajat hai? Aap ne jawab diya tum se toh koi haajat nahi albata Allah Ta'ala se haajat hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ki barish ka darogha farishta kaan lagaye hue tayar tha ki kab Allah ka hukum ho aur main us aag par barish barsa kar ise thandi kar doon lekin brahe raast hukum-e-ilahi aag ko hi pahuncha ki mere Khalil par salamati aur thandak ban ja. Farmate hain ki is hukum ke sath hi roo-e-zameen ki aag thandi ho gayi. Hazrat Ka'b Ahbar (Rahimahullah) farmate hain us din duniya bhar mein aag se koi faida na utha saka. Aur Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ki jootiyan toh aag ne jala diyan lekin aap ke ek rongte ko bhi aag na lagi. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ki agar aag ko sirf thanda hone ka hi hukum hota toh phir thandak bhi aap ko zarar pahunchati isliye sath hi farma diya gaya ki thandak ke sath hi salamati ban ja.

Zahhak Rahimahullah farmate hain ki bahut bada gadha bahut hi gehra khoda tha aur use aag se pur kiya tha har taraf aag ke shole nikal rahe the us mein Khalilullah ko daal diya lekin aag ne aap ko chuwa tak nahi yahan tak ki Allah Azzawajal ne use bilkul thanda kar diya. Mazkoor hai ki us waqt Hazrat Jibril Alaihis Salam aap ke sath the aap ke munh par se pasina ponch rahe the bas is ke siva aap ko aag ne koi takleef nahi di. Sudhi farmate hain saya ya farishta us waqt aap ke sath tha. Marwi hai ki aap us mein chaalis ya pachas din rahe farmaya karte the ki mujhe us zamane mein jo rahat-o-suroor hasil tha waisa is se nikalne ke baad hasil nahi hua kya achha hota ki meri saari zindagi usi mein guzarhti. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain ki Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid ne sab se achha kalma jo kaha hai woh yeh hai ki jab Ibrahim A.S aag se zinda sahi salim nikle us waqt aap ko peshani se pasina ponchte hue dekh kar aap ke walid ne kaha Ibrahim tera Rab bahut hi buzurg aur bada hai. Qatadah Rahimahullah farmate hain us din jo janwar nikla woh aap ki aag ko bujhane ki koshish karta raha siwaye girgit ke. Hazrat Zuhri Rahimahullah farmate hain Rasoolullah ﷺ ne girgit ke maar dalne ka hukum farmaya hai aur fasiq kaha hai. Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa R.A ke ghar mein ek neza dekh kar ek aurat ne sawal kiya ki yeh kyun rakh chhoda hai? Aap ne farmaya girgiton ko maar dalne ke liye. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ki jis waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S aag mein dale gaye us waqt tamam janwar is aag ko bujha rahe the siwaye girgit ke. Yeh phoonk raha tha pas aap ne is ke maar dalne ka hukum farmaya hai. Phir farmata hai ki un ka makr hum ne un par ulat diya. Kafiron ne Allah ke Nabi A.S ko neecha karna chaha Allah ne unhein neecha dikhaya. Hazrat Atiyyah Awfi ka bayan hai ki Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ka aag mein jalaye jaane ka tamasha dekhne ke liye un kafiron ka badshah bhi aaya tha. Idhar Khalilullah ko aag mein dala jata hai udhar aag mein se ek chingari udti hai aur us kafir badshah ke angoothe par aapadti hai aur wahin khade khade sab ke samne is tarah use jala deti hai jaise rui jal jaye.

Zahhak Rahimahullah farmate hain ki bahut bada gadha bahut hi gehra khoda tha aur use aag se pur kiya tha har taraf aag ke shole nikal rahe the us mein Khalilullah ko daal diya lekin aag ne aap ko chuwa tak nahi yahan tak ki Allah Azzawajal ne use bilkul thanda kar diya. Mazkoor hai ki us waqt Hazrat Jibril Alaihis Salam aap ke sath the aap ke munh par se pasina ponch rahe the bas is ke siva aap ko aag ne koi takleef nahi di. Sudhi farmate hain saya ya farishta us waqt aap ke sath tha. Marwi hai ki aap us mein chaalis ya pachas din rahe farmaya karte the ki mujhe us zamane mein jo rahat-o-suroor hasil tha waisa is se nikalne ke baad hasil nahi hua kya achha hota ki meri saari zindagi usi mein guzarhti. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain ki Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid ne sab se achha kalma jo kaha hai woh yeh hai ki jab Ibrahim A.S aag se zinda sahi salim nikle us waqt aap ko peshani se pasina ponchte hue dekh kar aap ke walid ne kaha Ibrahim tera Rab bahut hi buzurg aur bada hai. Qatadah Rahimahullah farmate hain us din jo janwar nikla woh aap ki aag ko bujhane ki koshish karta raha siwaye girgit ke. Hazrat Zuhri Rahimahullah farmate hain Rasoolullah ﷺ ne girgit ke maar dalne ka hukum farmaya hai aur fasiq kaha hai. Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa R.A ke ghar mein ek neza dekh kar ek aurat ne sawal kiya ki yeh kyun rakh chhoda hai? Aap ne farmaya girgiton ko maar dalne ke liye. Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ki jis waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S aag mein dale gaye us waqt tamam janwar is aag ko bujha rahe the siwaye girgit ke. Yeh phoonk raha tha pas aap ne is ke maar dalne ka hukum farmaya hai. Phir farmata hai ki un ka makr hum ne un par ulat diya. Kafiron ne Allah ke Nabi A.S ko neecha karna chaha Allah ne unhein neecha dikhaya. Hazrat Atiyyah Awfi ka bayan hai ki Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ka aag mein jalaye jaane ka tamasha dekhne ke liye un kafiron ka badshah bhi aaya tha. Idhar Khalilullah ko aag mein dala jata hai udhar aag mein se ek chingari udti hai aur us kafir badshah ke angoothe par aapadti hai aur wahin khade khade sab ke samne is tarah use jala deti hai jaise rui jal jaye.

Hijrat-e-Khalil A.S

Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke usne apne Khalil ko kafiron ki aag se bacha kar Sham ke muqaddas mulk mein pohncha diya. Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A farmate hain tamam meetha pani Sham ke Sakhra ke neeche se nikalta hai. Qatadah R.H farmate hain aapko Iraq ki sarzameen se Allah ne najat di aur Sham ke mulk mein pohnchaya. Sham hi nabiyon ka hijrat-kadah raha. Zameen mein se jo ghatta hai woh Sham mein barhta hai aur Sham ki kami Palestine mein ziyadati hoti hai. Sham hi mahshar ki sarzameen hai. Yahin Hazrat Isa A.S utarenge, yahin Dajjal qatal kiya jayega. Ba-qaul-e-Ka'ab aap Harran ki taraf gaye the. Yahan aakar aapko maloom hua ke yahan ke badshah ki larki apni qaum ke deen se bezar hai aur usse nafrat rakhti hai balke unke upar taana-zani karti hai toh aap ne unse is qarar par nikah kar liya ke woh aap ke sath hijrat karke yahan se nikal chalein, unhi ka naam Hazrat Sarah R.A hai. Yeh riwayat ghareeb hai aur mashhoor yeh hai ke Hazrat Sarah aap ke chacha ki sahibzadi theen, aur aap ke sath hijrat karke chali aayi theen. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh hijrat Makkah Shareef mein khatam hui, Makkah hi ki nisbat Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke yeh Allah ka pehla ghar hai jo barkat-o-hidayat wala hai, jismein alawa aur bohat si nishaniyon ke Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai. Ismein aajane wala amn-o-salamati mein aa jata hai. 

Phir farmata hai ke humne isse Ishaq diya aur Yaqub ka atiya bhi kiya. Yaani larka aur pota jaise farman hai ayat (F bashsharnaha bi Ishaqa wa min wara'i Ishaqa Ya'quba) (Hud: 71). Chonke Khalilullah A.S ke sawal mein ek larke hi ki talab thi dua ki thi ke ayat (Rabbi hab li minas-saliheen) Allah Ta'ala ne yeh dua bhi qubool farmai aur larke ke han bhi larka diya jo sawal se zaid tha aur sab ko neko-kar banaya. In sab ko duniya ka muqtada aur peshwa bana diya ke buhkm-e-Ilahi khalq-e-Allah ko rah-e-haq ki dawat dete rahe. Inki taraf hum ne nek kaamon ki wahi farmai. Is aam baat par atf daal kar phir khas baatein yaani namaz aur zakat ka bayan farmaya. Aur irshad hua ke woh alawa un nek kaamon ke hukum ke khud bhi in nekiyon par aamil the. 

Phir Hazrat Lut A.S ka zikr shuru hota hai. Lut bin Haran bin Azar Alaihis Salam. Aap Hazrat Ibrahim A.S par iman laye the aur aap ki tabadari mein aap hi ke sath hijrat ki thi. Jaise Kalamullah Shareef mein hai ayat (Fa amana lahu Lutun wa qala inni muhajirun ila Rabbi) (Al-Ankabut: 26). Hazrat Lut A.S aap par iman laye aur farmaya ke main apne Rabb ki taraf hijrat karne wala hoon, pas Allah Ta'ala ne unhein hikmat-o-ilm ata farmaya aur wahi nazil farmai aur nabiyon ke pak zumre mein dakhil kiya. Aur Sodom aur uske aas paas ki bastiyon ki taraf aap ko bheja. Unhone na mana mukhalifat par kamar-basti kar li.

Jis ke ba'is azab-e-ilahi mein giraftar hue aur fana kar diye gaye, jin ki barbadi ke waqiyat Allah Ta'ala ki Kitab-e-Aziz mein kayi jagah bayan hue hain, yahan farmaya ke hum ne unhein badtareen kaam karne wale fasiqon ki basti se nijat de di aur chunke woh aala naikokar the, hum ne unhein apni rahmat mein dakhil kar liya.

Nafasht ke ma’ani hain raat ke waqt janwaron ke charne ke, aur din ke waqt charne ko arabi mein hamal kehte hain. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain is bagh ko bakriyon ne bigaad diya, Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ne yeh faisla kiya ke bagh ke nuqsan ke badle yeh bakriyan bagh wale ko de di jaen. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne yeh faisla sun kar arz ki ke Aiye Allah ke Nabi Alaihis Salam is ke siva bhi faisle ki koi soorat hai? Aap ne farmaya woh kya? Jawab diya ke bakriyan bagh wale ke hawale kar di jaen woh un se faida uthata rahe aur bagh bakri wale ko de diya jaye yeh is mein angoor ki belon ki khidmat kare yahan tak ke belen theek thaak ho jaen angoor lagen aur phir usi halat par aa jaen jis par the to bagh wale ko is ka bagh saunp de aur bagh wala use is ki bakriyan saunp de. Yahi matlab is ayat ka hai ke hum ne is jhagde ka sahi faisla Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ko samjha diya. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ka yeh faisla sun kar bakriyon wale apna sa munh le kar sirf kutton ko apne sath liye hue wapas ja rahe the.
