Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko jab yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ne unhe bulwaya aur poocha ke bete tum kya faisla karte? Aap ne wahi oopar wala faisla sunaya. 

Hazrat Masroq R.H farmate hain in bakriyon ne khoshe aur patte sab kha liye the. To Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke faisle ke khilaf Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne faisla diya ke in logon ki bakriyan bagh walon ko de di jaen aur yeh bagh unhe saunpa jaye jab tak bagh apni asli halat par aaye tab tak bakriyon ke bachche aur un ka doodh aur un ka kul nafa bagh walon ka. Phir har ek ko un ki cheez saunp di jaye. 

Qazi Shureeh R.H ke paas bhi ek aisa hi jhagda aaya to Aap ne yeh faisla kiya ke agar din ko bakriyon ne nuqsan pahunchaya hai tab to koi muaawza nahi. Aur agar raat ko nuqsan pahunchaya hai to bakriyon wale zamin hain. Phir Aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Bara bin Azib R.A ki oontni kisi bagh mein chali gayi aur wahan bagh ka bada nuqsan kiya to Rasoolullah ﷺ ne yeh faisla farmaya ke bagh walon par din ke waqt bagh ki hifazat hai aur jo nuqsan janwaron se raat ko ho is ka jurmana janwar walon par hai. Is hadith mein illaten nikali gayi hain aur hum ne Kitab-ul-Ahkam mein Allah ke fazl se is ki poori tafseel bayan kar di hai. 

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Iyas bin Muawiyah R.H se jab ke Qazi banne ki darkhwast ki gayi to woh Hasan R.H ke paas aaye aur roye. Poocha gaya ke Abu Saeed aap kyun rote hain?

Farmaya mujhe yeh riwayat pohanchi hai ke agar qazi ne ijtihad kiya phir galti ki woh jahannumi hai aur jo khwahish-e-nafs ki taraf jhuk gaya woh bhi jahannumi hai haan jis ne ijtihad kiya aur sehat par pohch gaya woh jannat mein pohcha. Hazrat Hasan yeh sun kar farmane lage suno Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki quzat ka zikr farmaya hai zahir hai ke anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aala mansab par hote hain, un ke qool se un logon ki baatein radd ho sakti hain. Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman ki tareef to bayan farmai hai lekin Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ki mazammat bayan nahi farmai. Phir farmane lage suno teen baaton ka ahd Allah Ta'ala ne qaziyon se liya hai. Aik to yeh ke woh munsifeen-e-sharia duniyawi nafa ki wajah se badal na dein, doosre yeh ke apne dili iradon aur khwahishon ke peeche na parjayein, teesre yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ke siva kisi se na darein. Phir aap ne yeh ayat parhi (Ya Dawoodu inna ja'alnaka khalifatan fil-ardi fahkum bainannasi bil-haqqi wa la tattabi'al-hawa fayudillaka 'an sabilillah 38 - Surah (Sad: 26) yaani اے داؤد hum ne tujhe zameen ka khalifa banaya hai to logon mein haq ke sath faisle karta rah khwahish ke peeche na par ke Allah ki rah se behak jaye. Aur irshad hai ayat (Fala takhshawun-nasa wa khshawni wa la tashtaru bi ayati thamanan qalilan wa man lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa ula'ika humul-kafirun 44 - Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 44) logon se na daro mujhi se darte raha karo aur farman hai ayat (Wa la tashtaru bi ayati thamanan qalilan wa iyyaya fattaqun 41 - Surah (Al-Baqarah: 41) meri ayaton ko mamooli nafa ki khatir bech na diya karo. Main kehta hoon anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki masoomiyat mein aur un ki minjanib Allah har waqt ta'ayud hote rehne mein to kisi ko bhi ikhtilaf nahi. Rahe aur log to Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab hakim ijtihad aur koshish kare phir sehat tak bhi pohch jaye to usay dohra ajr milta hai aur jab poori koshish ke baad bhi galti karjaye to usay aik ajr milta hai. Yeh hadith saaf batla rahi hai ke Hazrat Ayas (Rahimahullah) ko jo waham tha ke bawajood poori jad-o-jehad ke bhi khata karjaye to dozakhi hai yeh galati hai, wallahu a'lam. Sunan ki aur hadith mein hai qazi teen qism ke hain aik jannati do jahannumi aur jis ne haq ko maloom karliya aur usi se faisla kiya woh jannati. Aur jis ne jahalat ke sath faisla kiya woh jahannumi aur jis ne haq ko jaante huwe us ke khilaf faisla diya woh bhi jahannumi. Quran Kareem ke bayan karda is waqie ke kareeb hi woh qissa hai jo Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain do aurtein thin jin ke sath un ke do bachhe bhi the bhediya aakar aik bachhe ko utha le gaya ab har aik doosri se kehne lagi ke tera bachha gaya aur jo hai woh mera bachha hai. Aakhir yeh qissa Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ke samne paish hua.

Aap ne bari aurat ko digree de di ke yeh bacha tera hai yeh yahan se niklein raste mein Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam thay aap ne dono ko bulaya aur farmaya chhuri laao mein is larke ke do tukre karke aadha aadha dono ko de deta hoon is par bari to khamosh ho gayi lekin choti ne haaye wawila shuru kardiya ke Allah aap par raham kare aap aisa na kijiye yeh larka isi bari ka hai isi ko de dijiye. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam mamle ko samajh gaye aur larka choti aurat ko dila diya. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai Imam Nasai Rahimahullah ne is par baab bandha hai ke hakim ko jaiz hai ke apna faisla apne dil mein rakh kar haqeeqat ko maloom karne ke liye is ke khilaf kuch kahe. Aisa hi ek waqia Ibn Asakir mein hai ke ek khoobsurat aurat se ek raees ne milna chaha lekin aurat ne na mana isi tarah teen aur shakhson ne bhi is se badkari ka irada kiya lekin woh baaz rahi. Is par woh ru'sa khar kha gaye aur aapas mein ittefaq karke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ki adalat mein jaakar sab ne gawahi di ke woh aurat apne kutte se aisa kaam karti hai chaaron ke muttafiqa bayan par hukum hogaya ke ise rajam kardiya jaye. Isi shaam ko Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam apne ham-umar larkon ke sath baith kar khud hakim bane aur chaar larke in logon ki tarah aap ke paas is muqadme ko laaye aur ek aurat ki nisbat yehi kaha. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne hukum diya in chaaron ko alag alag kardo. Phir ek ko apne paas bulaya aur is se poocha ke is kutte ka rang kaisa tha? Us ne kaha siyah. Phir doosre ko tanha bulaya is se bhi yehi sawal kiya us ne kaha surkh. Teesre ne kaha khaki. Chauthe ne kaha safaid aap ne usi waqt faisla diya ke aurat par yeh nari tuhmat hai aur in chaaron ko qatal kardiya jaye. Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke paas bhi yeh waqia bayan kiya gaya. Aap ne usi waqt fil-for in chaaron ameerion ko bulaya aur isi tarah alag alag in se is kutte ka rang ki baabat sawal kiya. Yeh garbara gaye kisi ne kuch kaha kisi ne kuch kaha. Aap ko in ka jhoot maloom hogaya aur hukum farmaya ke inhein qatal kardiya jaye. Phir bayan ho raha hai ke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko woh noorani gala ata farmaya gaya tha aur aap aisi khush aawazi aur khuloos ke sath Zaboor parhte thay ke parind bhi apni parwaaz chhor kar tham jaate thay aur Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karne lagte thay isi tarah pahar bhi. Ek riwayat mein hai ke raat ke waqt Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari R.A tilawat-e-Quran-e-Kareem kar rahe thay Rasulullah ﷺ un ki meethi raseeli aur khuloos bhari aawaz sun kar thehar gaye aur der tak sunte rahe phir farmane lage yeh to Aal-e-Dawood ki aawazon ki sheerini diye gaye hain. Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari R.A ko jab maloom hua to farmane lage ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ agar mujhe maloom hota ke Huzoor ﷺ meri qirat sun rahe hain to main aur bhi achhi tarah parhta. Hazrat Abu Usman Nahdi R.A farmate hain main ne to kisi behtar se behtar baaje ki aawaz mein bhi woh maza nahi paya jo Hazrat Moosa Ash'ari R.A ki aawaz mein tha. Pas itni khush aawazi ko Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ki khush aawazi ka ek hissa qarar diya.

Ab samajh lijiye ke khud Dawood Alaihis Salam ki aawaz kaisi hogi? Phir apna ek aur ehsaan batata hai ke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko zerein banani hum ne sikha di thin. Aap ke zamane se pehle baghair kundlon aur baghair halqon ki zerein banti thin. Kundlon daar aur halqon wali zerein aap ne hi banayein. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke liye lohe ko narm kar diya tha ke woh behtareen zire tayyar karein aur theek andaz se un mein halqe banayein. Yeh zerein maidan-e-jang mein kaam aati thin. Pas yeh naemat woh thi jis par logon ko Allah ki shukarguzari karni chahiye. Hum ne zorآور hawa ko Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ke tabe kar diya tha jo unhein un ke farman ke mutabiq barkat wali zameen yani mulk-e-sham mein pohncha deti thi. Humein har cheez ka ilm hai. Aap apne takht par ma-e-apne lao lashkar aur saaman asbaab ke baith jate the. Phir jahan jana chahte hawa aap ko aap ke farman ke mutabiq ghari bhar mein wahan pohncha deti. Takht ke upar se parind par khole aap par saya dalte jaise farman hai aayat (Fasakh-kharna lahul-riha tajri bi-amrihi rukh-an haisu asaba) 38. (Suad: 36) yani hum ne hawa ko un ka tabe kar diya ke jahan pohnchna chahte un ke hukm ke mutabiq usi taraf narmi se le chalti. Subh sham mahina mahina bhar ki rah ko tay kar leti. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair Rahimahullah farmate hain ke chhe hazaar kursi lagayi jati. Aap ke qareeb momin insan baithte un ke peeche momin jinn hote. Phir aap ke hukm se sab par parind saya karte phir hukm karte to hawa aap ko le chalti. Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair Rahimahullah farmate hain Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ko hukm dete woh misl bare taude ke jama ho jati goya pahad hai phir us ke sab se buland makan par farsh afroz hone ka hukm dete phir pehrdar ghore par sawar ho kar apne farsh par charh jate phir hawa ko hukm dete woh aap ko bulandi par le jati aap us waqt sar neecha kar lete dayen bayen bilkul na dekhte us mein aap ki tawazu aur Allah ki shukar guzari maqsood hoti thi. Kyunke aap ko apni forutani ka ilm tha. Phir jahan aap hukm dete wahin hawa aap ko utar deti. Isi tarah sarkash jinnat bhi Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke qabze mein kar diye the jo samundaron mein ghote laga kar moti aur jawahir waghera nikal laya karte the aur bhi bohat se kaam kaaj karte the jaise farman hai aayat (Wash-shayateena kulla banna-in wa ghawwas) 38. (Suad: 37) hum ne sarkash jinno ko un ka matahat kar diya tha jo memar the aur ghota khor. Aur un ke alawa aur shaitan bhi un ke matahat the jo zanjeeron mein bandhe rehte the aur hum hi Sulaiman ke hafiz-o-nigehban the koi shaitan unhein burayi na pohncha sakta tha balki sab ke sab un ke matahat farman bardar aur tabe the koi un ke qareeb bhi na phatak sakta tha ki aap ki hukmarani un par chalti thi jise chahte qaid kar lete jise chahte azad kar dete usi ko farmaya ke aur jinnat the jo jakre raha karte the.)))

Ab samajh lijiye ke khud Dawood Alaihis Salam ki aawaz kaisi hogi? Phir apna ek aur ehsaan batata hai ke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko zerein banani hum ne sikha di thin. Aap ke zamane se pehle baghair kundlon aur baghair halqon ki zerein banti thin. Kundlon daar aur halqon wali zerein aap ne hi banayein. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke liye lohe ko narm kar diya tha ke woh behtareen zire tayyar karein aur theek andaz se un mein halqe banayein. Yeh zerein maidan-e-jang mein kaam aati thin. Pas yeh naemat woh thi jis par logon ko Allah ki shukarguzari karni chahiye. Hum ne zorآور hawa ko Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ke tabe kar diya tha jo unhein un ke farman ke mutabiq barkat wali zameen yani mulk-e-sham mein pohncha deti thi. Humein har cheez ka ilm hai. Aap apne takht par ma-e-apne lao lashkar aur saaman asbaab ke baith jate the. Phir jahan jana chahte hawa aap ko aap ke farman ke mutabiq ghari bhar mein wahan pohncha deti. Takht ke upar se parind par khole aap par saya dalte jaise farman hai aayat (Fasakh-kharna lahul-riha tajri bi-amrihi rukh-an haisu asaba) 38. (Suad: 36) yani hum ne hawa ko un ka tabe kar diya ke jahan pohnchna chahte un ke hukm ke mutabiq usi taraf narmi se le chalti. Subh sham mahina mahina bhar ki rah ko tay kar leti. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair Rahimahullah farmate hain ke chhe hazaar kursi lagayi jati. Aap ke qareeb momin insan baithte un ke peeche momin jinn hote. Phir aap ke hukm se sab par parind saya karte phir hukm karte to hawa aap ko le chalti. Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair Rahimahullah farmate hain Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ko hukm dete woh misl bare taude ke jama ho jati goya pahad hai phir us ke sab se buland makan par farsh afroz hone ka hukm dete phir pehrdar ghore par sawar ho kar apne farsh par charh jate phir hawa ko hukm dete woh aap ko bulandi par le jati aap us waqt sar neecha kar lete dayen bayen bilkul na dekhte us mein aap ki tawazu aur Allah ki shukar guzari maqsood hoti thi. Kyunke aap ko apni forutani ka ilm tha. Phir jahan aap hukm dete wahin hawa aap ko utar deti. Isi tarah sarkash jinnat bhi Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke qabze mein kar diye the jo samundaron mein ghote laga kar moti aur jawahir waghera nikal laya karte the aur bhi bohat se kaam kaaj karte the jaise farman hai aayat (Wash-shayateena kulla banna-in wa ghawwas) 38. (Suad: 37) hum ne sarkash jinno ko un ka matahat kar diya tha jo memar the aur ghota khor. Aur un ke alawa aur shaitan bhi un ke matahat the jo zanjeeron mein bandhe rehte the aur hum hi Sulaiman ke hafiz-o-nigehban the koi shaitan unhein burayi na pohncha sakta tha balki sab ke sab un ke matahat farman bardar aur tabe the koi un ke qareeb bhi na phatak sakta tha ki aap ki hukmarani un par chalti thi jise chahte qaid kar lete jise chahte azad kar dete usi ko farmaya ke aur jinnat the jo jakre raha karte the.)))

Aik hi muqaddame mein Dawood Alaihis Salam aur Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ke mukhtalif faisle. Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain yeh kheti angoor ki thi jis ke khoshe latak rahe the. Nafasht ke ma’ani hain raat ke waqt janwaron ke charne ke, aur din ke waqt charne ko arabi mein hamal kehte hain. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain is bagh ko bakriyon ne bigaad diya, Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ne yeh faisla kiya ke bagh ke nuqsan ke badle yeh bakriyan bagh wale ko de di jaen. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne yeh faisla sun kar arz ki ke Aiye Allah ke Nabi Alaihis Salam is ke siva bhi faisle ki koi soorat hai? Aap ne farmaya woh kya? Jawab diya ke bakriyan bagh wale ke hawale kar di jaen woh un se faida uthata rahe aur bagh bakri wale ko de diya jaye yeh is mein angoor ki belon ki khidmat kare yahan tak ke belen theek thaak ho jaen angoor lagen aur phir usi halat par aa jaen jis par the to bagh wale ko is ka bagh saunp de aur bagh wala use is ki bakriyan saunp de. Yahi matlab is ayat ka hai ke hum ne is jhagde ka sahi faisla Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ko samjha diya. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ka yeh faisla sun kar bakriyon wale apna sa munh le kar sirf kutton ko apne sath liye hue wapas ja rahe the. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne unhe dekh kar daryaft kiya ke tumhara faisla kya hua? Unhon ne khabar di to Aap ne farmaya agar main is jagah hota to yeh faisla na deta balki kuch aur faisla karta. Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko jab yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ne unhe bulwaya aur poocha ke bete tum kya faisla karte? Aap ne wahi oopar wala faisla sunaya. 

Hazrat Masroq R.H farmate hain in bakriyon ne khoshe aur patte sab kha liye the. To Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke faisle ke khilaf Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne faisla diya ke in logon ki bakriyan bagh walon ko de di jaen aur yeh bagh unhe saunpa jaye jab tak bagh apni asli halat par aaye tab tak bakriyon ke bachche aur un ka doodh aur un ka kul nafa bagh walon ka. Phir har ek ko un ki cheez saunp di jaye. 

Qazi Shureeh R.H ke paas bhi ek aisa hi jhagda aaya to Aap ne yeh faisla kiya ke agar din ko bakriyon ne nuqsan pahunchaya hai tab to koi muaawza nahi. Aur agar raat ko nuqsan pahunchaya hai to bakriyon wale zamin hain. Phir Aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Bara bin Azib R.A ki oontni kisi bagh mein chali gayi aur wahan bagh ka bada nuqsan kiya to Rasoolullah ﷺ ne yeh faisla farmaya ke bagh walon par din ke waqt bagh ki hifazat hai aur jo nuqsan janwaron se raat ko ho is ka jurmana janwar walon par hai. Is hadith mein illaten nikali gayi hain aur hum ne Kitab-ul-Ahkam mein Allah ke fazl se is ki poori tafseel bayan kar di hai. 

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Iyas bin Muawiyah R.H se jab ke Qazi banne ki darkhwast ki gayi to woh Hasan R.H ke paas aaye aur roye. Poocha gaya ke Abu Saeed aap kyun rote hain?

Farmaya mujhe yeh riwayat pohanchi hai ke agar qazi ne ijtihad kiya phir galti ki woh jahannumi hai aur jo khwahish-e-nafs ki taraf jhuk gaya woh bhi jahannumi hai haan jis ne ijtihad kiya aur sehat par pohch gaya woh jannat mein pohcha. Hazrat Hasan yeh sun kar farmane lage suno Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki quzat ka zikr farmaya hai zahir hai ke anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aala mansab par hote hain, un ke qool se un logon ki baatein radd ho sakti hain. Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman ki tareef to bayan farmai hai lekin Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ki mazammat bayan nahi farmai. Phir farmane lage suno teen baaton ka ahd Allah Ta'ala ne qaziyon se liya hai. Aik to yeh ke woh munsifeen-e-sharia duniyawi nafa ki wajah se badal na dein, doosre yeh ke apne dili iradon aur khwahishon ke peeche na parjayein, teesre yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ke siva kisi se na darein. Phir aap ne yeh ayat parhi (Ya Dawoodu inna ja'alnaka khalifatan fil-ardi fahkum bainannasi bil-haqqi wa la tattabi'al-hawa fayudillaka 'an sabilillah 38 - Surah (Sad: 26) yaani اے داؤد hum ne tujhe zameen ka khalifa banaya hai to logon mein haq ke sath faisle karta rah khwahish ke peeche na par ke Allah ki rah se behak jaye. Aur irshad hai ayat (Fala takhshawun-nasa wa khshawni wa la tashtaru bi ayati thamanan qalilan wa man lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa ula'ika humul-kafirun 44 - Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 44) logon se na daro mujhi se darte raha karo aur farman hai ayat (Wa la tashtaru bi ayati thamanan qalilan wa iyyaya fattaqun 41 - Surah (Al-Baqarah: 41) meri ayaton ko mamooli nafa ki khatir bech na diya karo. Main kehta hoon anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki masoomiyat mein aur un ki minjanib Allah har waqt ta'ayud hote rehne mein to kisi ko bhi ikhtilaf nahi. Rahe aur log to Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab hakim ijtihad aur koshish kare phir sehat tak bhi pohch jaye to usay dohra ajr milta hai aur jab poori koshish ke baad bhi galti karjaye to usay aik ajr milta hai. Yeh hadith saaf batla rahi hai ke Hazrat Ayas (Rahimahullah) ko jo waham tha ke bawajood poori jad-o-jehad ke bhi khata karjaye to dozakhi hai yeh galati hai, wallahu a'lam. Sunan ki aur hadith mein hai qazi teen qism ke hain aik jannati do jahannumi aur jis ne haq ko maloom karliya aur usi se faisla kiya woh jannati. Aur jis ne jahalat ke sath faisla kiya woh jahannumi aur jis ne haq ko jaante huwe us ke khilaf faisla diya woh bhi jahannumi. Quran Kareem ke bayan karda is waqie ke kareeb hi woh qissa hai jo Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain do aurtein thin jin ke sath un ke do bachhe bhi the bhediya aakar aik bachhe ko utha le gaya ab har aik doosri se kehne lagi ke tera bachha gaya aur jo hai woh mera bachha hai. Aakhir yeh qissa Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ke samne paish hua.

Aap ne bari aurat ko digree de di ke yeh bacha tera hai yeh yahan se niklein raste mein Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam thay aap ne dono ko bulaya aur farmaya chhuri laao mein is larke ke do tukre karke aadha aadha dono ko de deta hoon is par bari to khamosh ho gayi lekin choti ne haaye wawila shuru kardiya ke Allah aap par raham kare aap aisa na kijiye yeh larka isi bari ka hai isi ko de dijiye. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam mamle ko samajh gaye aur larka choti aurat ko dila diya. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai Imam Nasai Rahimahullah ne is par baab bandha hai ke hakim ko jaiz hai ke apna faisla apne dil mein rakh kar haqeeqat ko maloom karne ke liye is ke khilaf kuch kahe. Aisa hi ek waqia Ibn Asakir mein hai ke ek khoobsurat aurat se ek raees ne milna chaha lekin aurat ne na mana isi tarah teen aur shakhson ne bhi is se badkari ka irada kiya lekin woh baaz rahi. Is par woh ru'sa khar kha gaye aur aapas mein ittefaq karke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ki adalat mein jaakar sab ne gawahi di ke woh aurat apne kutte se aisa kaam karti hai chaaron ke muttafiqa bayan par hukum hogaya ke ise rajam kardiya jaye. Isi shaam ko Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam apne ham-umar larkon ke sath baith kar khud hakim bane aur chaar larke in logon ki tarah aap ke paas is muqadme ko laaye aur ek aurat ki nisbat yehi kaha. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne hukum diya in chaaron ko alag alag kardo. Phir ek ko apne paas bulaya aur is se poocha ke is kutte ka rang kaisa tha? Us ne kaha siyah. Phir doosre ko tanha bulaya is se bhi yehi sawal kiya us ne kaha surkh. Teesre ne kaha khaki. Chauthe ne kaha safaid aap ne usi waqt faisla diya ke aurat par yeh nari tuhmat hai aur in chaaron ko qatal kardiya jaye. Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke paas bhi yeh waqia bayan kiya gaya. Aap ne usi waqt fil-for in chaaron ameerion ko bulaya aur isi tarah alag alag in se is kutte ka rang ki baabat sawal kiya. Yeh garbara gaye kisi ne kuch kaha kisi ne kuch kaha. Aap ko in ka jhoot maloom hogaya aur hukum farmaya ke inhein qatal kardiya jaye. Phir bayan ho raha hai ke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko woh noorani gala ata farmaya gaya tha aur aap aisi khush aawazi aur khuloos ke sath Zaboor parhte thay ke parind bhi apni parwaaz chhor kar tham jaate thay aur Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karne lagte thay isi tarah pahar bhi. Ek riwayat mein hai ke raat ke waqt Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari R.A tilawat-e-Quran-e-Kareem kar rahe thay Rasulullah ﷺ un ki meethi raseeli aur khuloos bhari aawaz sun kar thehar gaye aur der tak sunte rahe phir farmane lage yeh to Aal-e-Dawood ki aawazon ki sheerini diye gaye hain. Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari R.A ko jab maloom hua to farmane lage ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ agar mujhe maloom hota ke Huzoor ﷺ meri qirat sun rahe hain to main aur bhi achhi tarah parhta. Aap ne bari aurat ko digree de di ke yeh bacha tera hai yeh yahan se niklein raste mein Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam thay aap ne dono ko bulaya aur farmaya chhuri laao mein is larke ke do tukre karke aadha aadha dono ko de deta hoon is par bari to khamosh ho gayi lekin choti ne haaye wawila shuru kardiya ke Allah aap par raham kare aap aisa na kijiye yeh larka isi bari ka hai isi ko de dijiye. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam mamle ko samajh gaye aur larka choti aurat ko dila diya. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai Imam Nasai Rahimahullah ne is par baab bandha hai ke hakim ko jaiz hai ke apna faisla apne dil mein rakh kar haqeeqat ko maloom karne ke liye is ke khilaf kuch kahe. Aisa hi ek waqia Ibn Asakir mein hai ke ek khoobsurat aurat se ek raees ne milna chaha lekin aurat ne na mana isi tarah teen aur shakhson ne bhi is se badkari ka irada kiya lekin woh baaz rahi. Is par woh ru'sa khar kha gaye aur aapas mein ittefaq karke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ki adalat mein jaakar sab ne gawahi di ke woh aurat apne kutte se aisa kaam karti hai chaaron ke muttafiqa bayan par hukum hogaya ke ise rajam kardiya jaye. Isi shaam ko Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam apne ham-umar larkon ke sath baith kar khud hakim bane aur chaar larke in logon ki tarah aap ke paas is muqadme ko laaye aur ek aurat ki nisbat yehi kaha. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne hukum diya in chaaron ko alag alag kardo. Phir ek ko apne paas bulaya aur is se poocha ke is kutte ka rang kaisa tha? Us ne kaha siyah. Phir doosre ko tanha bulaya is se bhi yehi sawal kiya us ne kaha surkh. Teesre ne kaha khaki. Chauthe ne kaha safaid aap ne usi waqt faisla diya ke aurat par yeh nari tuhmat hai aur in chaaron ko qatal kardiya jaye. Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke paas bhi yeh waqia bayan kiya gaya. Aap ne usi waqt fil-for in chaaron ameerion ko bulaya aur isi tarah alag alag in se is kutte ka rang ki baabat sawal kiya. Yeh garbara gaye kisi ne kuch kaha kisi ne kuch kaha. Aap ko in ka jhoot maloom hogaya aur hukum farmaya ke inhein qatal kardiya jaye. Phir bayan ho raha hai ke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko woh noorani gala ata farmaya gaya tha aur aap aisi khush aawazi aur khuloos ke sath Zaboor parhte thay ke parind bhi apni parwaaz chhor kar tham jaate thay aur Allah ki tasbeeh bayan karne lagte thay isi tarah pahar bhi. Ek riwayat mein hai ke raat ke waqt Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari R.A tilawat-e-Quran-e-Kareem kar rahe thay Rasulullah ﷺ un ki meethi raseeli aur khuloos bhari aawaz sun kar thehar gaye aur der tak sunte rahe phir farmane lage yeh to Aal-e-Dawood ki aawazon ki sheerini diye gaye hain. Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari R.A ko jab maloom hua to farmane lage ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ agar mujhe maloom hota ke Huzoor ﷺ meri qirat sun rahe hain to main aur bhi achhi tarah parhta. Hazrat Abu Usman Nahdi R.A farmate hain main ne to kisi behtar se behtar baaje ki aawaz mein bhi woh maza nahi paya jo Hazrat Moosa Ash'ari R.A ki aawaz mein tha. Pas itni khush aawazi ko Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ki khush aawazi ka ek hissa qarar diya.

Ab samajh lijiye ke khud Dawood Alaihis Salam ki aawaz kaisi hogi? Phir apna ek aur ehsaan batata hai ke Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko zerein banani hum ne sikha di thin. Aap ke zamane se pehle baghair kundlon aur baghair halqon ki zerein banti thin. Kundlon daar aur halqon wali zerein aap ne hi banayein. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke liye lohe ko narm kar diya tha ke woh behtareen zire tayyar karein aur theek andaz se un mein halqe banayein. Yeh zerein maidan-e-jang mein kaam aati thin. Pas yeh naemat woh thi jis par logon ko Allah ki shukarguzari karni chahiye. Hum ne zorآور hawa ko Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ke tabe kar diya tha jo unhein un ke farman ke mutabiq barkat wali zameen yani mulk-e-sham mein pohncha deti thi. Humein har cheez ka ilm hai. Aap apne takht par ma-e-apne lao lashkar aur saaman asbaab ke baith jate the. Phir jahan jana chahte hawa aap ko aap ke farman ke mutabiq ghari bhar mein wahan pohncha deti. Takht ke upar se parind par khole aap par saya dalte jaise farman hai aayat (Fasakh-kharna lahul-riha tajri bi-amrihi rukh-an haisu asaba) 38. (Suad: 36) yani hum ne hawa ko un ka tabe kar diya ke jahan pohnchna chahte un ke hukm ke mutabiq usi taraf narmi se le chalti. Subh sham mahina mahina bhar ki rah ko tay kar leti. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair Rahimahullah farmate hain ke chhe hazaar kursi lagayi jati. Aap ke qareeb momin insan baithte un ke peeche momin jinn hote. Phir aap ke hukm se sab par parind saya karte phir hukm karte to hawa aap ko le chalti. Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair Rahimahullah farmate hain Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ko hukm dete woh misl bare taude ke jama ho jati goya pahad hai phir us ke sab se buland makan par farsh afroz hone ka hukm dete phir pehrdar ghore par sawar ho kar apne farsh par charh jate phir hawa ko hukm dete woh aap ko bulandi par le jati aap us waqt sar neecha kar lete dayen bayen bilkul na dekhte us mein aap ki tawazu aur Allah ki shukar guzari maqsood hoti thi. Kyunke aap ko apni forutani ka ilm tha. Phir jahan aap hukm dete wahin hawa aap ko utar deti. Isi tarah sarkash jinnat bhi Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke qabze mein kar diye the jo samundaron mein ghote laga kar moti aur jawahir waghera nikal laya karte the aur bhi bohat se kaam kaaj karte the jaise farman hai aayat (Wash-shayateena kulla banna-in wa ghawwas) 38. (Suad: 37) hum ne sarkash jinno ko un ka matahat kar diya tha jo memar the aur ghota khor. Aur un ke alawa aur shaitan bhi un ke matahat the jo zanjeeron mein bandhe rehte the aur hum hi Sulaiman ke hafiz-o-nigehban the koi shaitan unhein burayi na pohncha sakta tha balki sab ke sab un ke matahat farman bardar aur tabe the koi un ke qareeb bhi na phatak sakta tha ki aap ki hukmarani un par chalti thi jise chahte qaid kar lete jise chahte azad kar dete usi ko farmaya ke aur jinnat the jo jakre raha karte the.)))

Aik hi muqaddame mein Dawood Alaihis Salam aur Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ke mukhtalif faisle. Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain yeh kheti angoor ki thi jis ke khoshe latak rahe the. Nafasht ke ma’ani hain raat ke waqt janwaron ke charne ke, aur din ke waqt charne ko arabi mein hamal kehte hain. Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A farmate hain is bagh ko bakriyon ne bigaad diya, Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ne yeh faisla kiya ke bagh ke nuqsan ke badle yeh bakriyan bagh wale ko de di jaen. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne yeh faisla sun kar arz ki ke Aiye Allah ke Nabi Alaihis Salam is ke siva bhi faisle ki koi soorat hai? Aap ne farmaya woh kya? Jawab diya ke bakriyan bagh wale ke hawale kar di jaen woh un se faida uthata rahe aur bagh bakri wale ko de diya jaye yeh is mein angoor ki belon ki khidmat kare yahan tak ke belen theek thaak ho jaen angoor lagen aur phir usi halat par aa jaen jis par the to bagh wale ko is ka bagh saunp de aur bagh wala use is ki bakriyan saunp de. Yahi matlab is ayat ka hai ke hum ne is jhagde ka sahi faisla Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ko samjha diya. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ka yeh faisla sun kar bakriyon wale apna sa munh le kar sirf kutton ko apne sath liye hue wapas ja rahe the. Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne unhe dekh kar daryaft kiya ke tumhara faisla kya hua? Unhon ne khabar di to Aap ne farmaya agar main is jagah hota to yeh faisla na deta balki kuch aur faisla karta. Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ko jab yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ne unhe bulwaya aur poocha ke bete tum kya faisla karte? Aap ne wahi oopar wala faisla sunaya. 

Hazrat Masroq R.H farmate hain in bakriyon ne khoshe aur patte sab kha liye the. To Hazrat Dawood Alaihis Salam ke faisle ke khilaf Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihis Salam ne faisla diya ke in logon ki bakriyan bagh walon ko de di jaen aur yeh bagh unhe saunpa jaye jab tak bagh apni asli halat par aaye tab tak bakriyon ke bachche aur un ka doodh aur un ka kul nafa bagh walon ka. Phir har ek ko un ki cheez saunp di jaye. 

Qazi Shureeh R.H ke paas bhi ek aisa hi jhagda aaya to Aap ne yeh faisla kiya ke agar din ko bakriyon ne nuqsan pahunchaya hai tab to koi muaawza nahi. Aur agar raat ko nuqsan pahunchaya hai to bakriyon wale zamin hain. Phir Aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Bara bin Azib R.A ki oontni kisi bagh mein chali gayi aur wahan bagh ka bada nuqsan kiya to Rasoolullah ﷺ ne yeh faisla farmaya ke bagh walon par din ke waqt bagh ki hifazat hai aur jo nuqsan janwaron se raat ko ho is ka jurmana janwar walon par hai. Is hadith mein illaten nikali gayi hain aur hum ne Kitab-ul-Ahkam mein Allah ke fazl se is ki poori tafseel bayan kar di hai. 

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Iyas bin Muawiyah R.H se jab ke Qazi banne ki darkhwast ki gayi to woh Hasan R.H ke paas aaye aur roye. Poocha gaya ke Abu Saeed aap kyun rote hain?

Farmaya mujhe yeh riwayat pohanchi hai ke agar qazi ne ijtihad kiya phir galti ki woh jahannumi hai aur jo khwahish-e-nafs ki taraf jhuk gaya woh bhi jahannumi hai haan jis ne ijtihad kiya aur sehat par pohch gaya woh jannat mein pohcha. Hazrat Hasan yeh sun kar farmane lage suno Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) aur Hazrat Sulaiman (Alaihis Salam) ki quzat ka zikr farmaya hai zahir hai ke anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aala mansab par hote hain, un ke qool se un logon ki baatein radd ho sakti hain. Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Sulaiman ki tareef to bayan farmai hai lekin Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) ki mazammat bayan nahi farmai. Phir farmane lage suno teen baaton ka ahd Allah Ta'ala ne qaziyon se liya hai. Aik to yeh ke woh munsifeen-e-sharia duniyawi nafa ki wajah se badal na dein, doosre yeh ke apne dili iradon aur khwahishon ke peeche na parjayein, teesre yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ke siva kisi se na darein. Phir aap ne yeh ayat parhi (Ya Dawoodu inna ja'alnaka khalifatan fil-ardi fahkum bainannasi bil-haqqi wa la tattabi'al-hawa fayudillaka 'an sabilillah 38 - Surah (Sad: 26) yaani اے داؤد hum ne tujhe zameen ka khalifa banaya hai to logon mein haq ke sath faisle karta rah khwahish ke peeche na par ke Allah ki rah se behak jaye. Aur irshad hai ayat (Fala takhshawun-nasa wa khshawni wa la tashtaru bi ayati thamanan qalilan wa man lam yahkum bima anzalallahu fa ula'ika humul-kafirun 44 - Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 44) logon se na daro mujhi se darte raha karo aur farman hai ayat (Wa la tashtaru bi ayati thamanan qalilan wa iyyaya fattaqun 41 - Surah (Al-Baqarah: 41) meri ayaton ko mamooli nafa ki khatir bech na diya karo. Main kehta hoon anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki masoomiyat mein aur un ki minjanib Allah har waqt ta'ayud hote rehne mein to kisi ko bhi ikhtilaf nahi. Rahe aur log to Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab hakim ijtihad aur koshish kare phir sehat tak bhi pohch jaye to usay dohra ajr milta hai aur jab poori koshish ke baad bhi galti karjaye to usay aik ajr milta hai. Yeh hadith saaf batla rahi hai ke Hazrat Ayas (Rahimahullah) ko jo waham tha ke bawajood poori jad-o-jehad ke bhi khata karjaye to dozakhi hai yeh galati hai, wallahu a'lam. Sunan ki aur hadith mein hai qazi teen qism ke hain aik jannati do jahannumi aur jis ne haq ko maloom karliya aur usi se faisla kiya woh jannati. Aur jis ne jahalat ke sath faisla kiya woh jahannumi aur jis ne haq ko jaante huwe us ke khilaf faisla diya woh bhi jahannumi. Azmaish aur Masaib-e-Ayyub (A.S):
Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) ki takleefon ka bayan ho raha hai jo mali, jismani aur aulaad par mushtamil thin. Unke paas bahut se qisam qisam ke janwar thay, khetiyan, baghaat waghera thay, aulaad, biwiyan, laundiyan, ghulam, jaidad aur maal-o-mata sabhi kuch Allah ka diya hua maujood tha. Ab jab Rabb ki taraf se un par azmaish aayi toh ek sire se sab kuch fana hota gaya yahan tak ke jism mein juzam phoot pada. Dil-o-zaban ke siva sare jism ka koi hissa is marz se mehfooz na raha. Yahan tak ke aas paas wale karahat karne lage. Shehar ke ek veeran kone mein aap ko sukunat ikhtiyar karni padi. Sivaye aap ki ek biwi sahabah (R.A) ke aur koi aap ke paas na raha, is museebat ke waqt sab ne kinara kar liya. Yehi ek thin jo unki khidmat karti thin sath hi mehnat mazduri karke pait palne ko bhi laya karti thin. 

Aank حضرت ﷺ ne sach farmaya ke sab se zyada sakht imtihan nabiyon ka hota hai, phir saleh logon ka, phir un se neeche ke darje walon ka, phir un se kam darje walon ka. Aur riwayat mein hai ke har shakhs ka imtihan uske deen ke andaz se hota hai, agar woh deen mein mazboot hai, imtihan bhi sakht-tar hota hai. 

Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) bade hi sabir thay yahan tak ke sabr-e-ayyub zaban-zad-e-aam hai. Yazid bin Maysarah (R.H) farmate hain: Jab aap ki azmaish shuru hui, ahl-o-ayyal mar gaye, maal fana ho gaya, koi cheez hath tale na rahi, aap Allah ke zikr mein aur badh gaye, kehne lage: "Ae tamam palne walon ke palne wale! Tu ne mujh par bade ehsaan kiye, maal diya, aulaad di, us waqt mera dil bahut hi mashghool tha, ab tu ne sab kuch lekar mere dil ko in fikron se paak kar diya, ab mere dil mein aur tujh mein koi hail na raha. Agar mera dushman Iblees teri is meharbaani ko jaan leta toh woh mujh par bahut hi hasad karta." 

Iblees-e-Laeen is qaul se aur us waqt ki is hamd se jal bhun kar reh gaya. Aap ki duaaon mein ye bhi dua thi: "Ae Allah! Tu ne jab mujhe tawanigar aur aulaad aur ahl-o-ayyal wala bana rakha tha toh khoob janta hai ke us waqt main ne na kabhi ghuroor-o-takabbur kiya na kabhi kisi par zulm-o-sitam kiya. Mere Parwardigar! Tujh par roshan hai ke mera narm-o-garm bistar taiyar hota aur main raton ko teri ibadaton mein guzaarta aur apne nafs ko is tarah daant deta ke tu is liye paida nahi kiya gaya, teri razamandi ki talab mein main apni rahat-o-aram ko tark kar diya karta." (Ibn Abi Hatim)

Is ayat ki tafsir mein Ibn Jarir aur Ibn Abi Hatim mein ek bahut lamba qissa hai jise bahut se pichle mufassirin ne bhi zikr kiya hai, lekin is mein gharabat hai aur iske tool ki wajah se hum ne ise chhod diya hai. Muddaton tak aap in balaon mein mubtala rahe. 

Hazrat Hasan aur Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain: Saat saal aur kayi mah aap beemari mein mubtala rahe, Bani Israel ke koda phenkne ki jagah aap ko daal rakha tha, badan mein keede pad gaye the, phir Allah ne aap par raham-o-karam kiya, tamam balaon se nijat di, ajr diya aur tareefin keen. 

Wahab bin Munabbih ka bayan hai ke poore teen saal aap is takleef mein rahe, sara gosht jhad gaya tha.

Sirf haddiyan aur chamra reh gaya, aap dukh mein pare rehte thay, sirf ek biwi sahiba thin jo aap ke paas thin. Jab zyada zamana guzar gaya to ek roz arz karne lagin ke, "Ae Nabi Allah A.S, aap Allah se dua kyun nahi karte ke woh is museebat ko hum par se taal de?" 

Aap farmane lage, "Sunno, sattar baras tak Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe sehat-o-aafiyat mein rakha, to agar sattar saal tak main is halat mein rahoon aur sabr karoon to yeh bhi bohat kam hai." 

Is par biwi sahiba kaanp uthin. Aap shehar mein jaatin, logon ka kaam-kaaj kartin aur jo milta woh le aatin aur aap ko khilatin pilatin. Aap ke do dost aur sangee (dilli khairkhwah dost) thay, unhein Palestine mein jaakar Shaitan ne khabar di ke, "Tumhara dost sakht museebat mein mubtala hai, tum jao un ki khabar-geeri karo aur apne haan ki kuch sharab apne sath le jao, woh pila dena is se unhein shifa ho jayegi." 

Chunancha yeh dono aaye, Hazrat Ayub A.S ki halat dekhte hi un ke aansu nikal aaye aur bilbila kar rane lage. Aap ne poocha, "Tum kaun ho?" 

Unhon ne yaad dilaya to aap khush huye, unhein marhaba kaha. 

Woh kehne lage, "Ae Janab! Aap shayad kuch chupate honge aur zahir is ke khilaf karte honge?" 

Aap ne nigahein aasman ki taraf utha kar farmaya, "Allah khoob jaanta hai ke main kya chupata tha aur kya zahir karta tha? Mere Rabb ne mujhe is mein mubtala kiya hai taake woh dekhe ke main sabr karta hoon ya be-sabri?" 

Woh kehne lage, "Achha, hum aap ke vaste dawa laye hain, aap ise pee leejiye shifa ho jayegi, yeh sharab hai jo hum apne haan se laye hain." 

Yeh sunte hi aap sakht ghazabnak huye aur farmane lage, "Tumhein Shaitan khabees laya hai, tum se kalam karna aur tumhara khana peena mujh par haram hai." Yeh dono aap ke paas se chale gaye. 

Ek martaba ka zikr hai ke aap ki biwi sahiba ne ek ghar walon ki rotiyan pakayin, un ka ek bacha soya hua tha, to unhon ne us bache ke hisse ki tikiya unhein de di. Yeh lekar Hazrat Ayub A.S ke paas ayin. 

Aap ne kaha, "Yeh aaj kahan se layin?" 

Unhon ne sara waqia bayan kar diya. 

Aap ne farmaya, "Abhi abhi wapas jao, mumkin hai bacha jaag gaya ho aur usi tikiya ki zid karta ho aur ro ro kar sare ghar walon ko pareshan karta ho." 

Aap roti wapas lekar chalin, un ki deohri mein bakri bandhi hui thi, us ne zor se aap ko takkar mari, aap ki zubaan se nikal gaya, "Dekho Ayub kaise ghalat khayal wale hain!" 

Phir upar gayin to dekha waqai bacha jaga hua hai aur tikiya ke liye machal raha hai aur ghar bhar ka naak mein dam kar rakha hai. Yeh dekh kar be-sakhta zubaan se nikla ke, "Allah Ayub par raham kare, achhe mauqa par pohnchi." 

Tikiya de di aur wapas lotin. Raste mein Shaitan ba-soorat-e-tabeeb mila aur kehne laga ke, "Tere khawand sakht takleef mein hain, marz par muddatein guzar gayin, tum unhein samjhao, falan qabeele ke but ke naam par ek makkhi maar dein shifa ho jayegi, phir tauba kar lein." 

Jab aap Hazrat Ayub A.S ke paas pohnchin aur un se yeh kaha, to aap ne farmaya, "Shaitan khabees ka jadoo tujh par chal gaya, agar main tandrust ho gaya to tujhe sau kore lagaunga."

Ek din Aap hasb-e-ma'mol talash-e-ma'ash mein niklein, ghar ghar phir aaein kahin kaam na laga, mayus ho gayin, sham ko palatne waqt Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ki bhook ka khayal aaya toh Aap ne apne baalon ki ek lat kaat kar ek ameer larki ke haath farokht kar di, us ne Aap ko bahut kuch khane peene ka asbab diya. Jise lekar Aap aaein, Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ne pucha yeh aaj itna sara aur itna acha khana kaise mil gaya? Farmaya main ne ek ameer ghar ka kaam kar diya tha. Aap ne kha liya, dusre roz bhi ittefaq se aisa hi hua aur Aap ne apne baalon ki dusri lat kaat kar farokht kar di aur khana lekar aaein, aaj bhi yehi khana dekh kar Aap ne farmaya, Wallahi main hargiz na khaunga jab tak tu mujhe yeh na bata de ke kaise layi? Ab Aap ne apna dupatta sar se utaar diya, dekha ke sar ke baal sab kat chuke hain, us waqt sakht ghabrahat aur be-chaini hui aur Allah se dua ki ke mujhe zarar pahuncha aur Tu sab se zyada Rahim hai. Hazrat Nauf kehte hain ke jo shaitan Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ke peechhe pada tha uska naam Masboot tha. Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ki biwi sahiba umoman Aap se arz kiya karti thin ke Allah se dua karo, lekin Aap na karte the, yahan tak ke ek din Bani Israel ke kuch log Aap ke paas se nikle aur Aap ko dekh kar kehne lage ke is shakhs ko yeh takleef zarur kisi na kisi gunah ki wajah se hai, us waqt be-sakhta Aap ki zuban se yeh dua nikal gayi. Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair Rahimahullah farmate hain ke Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ke do bhai the, ek din woh milne ke liye aaein, lekin jism ki badbu ki wajah se qareeb na aa sake, dur hi se khade ho kar ek dusre se kehne lage ke agar is shakhs mein bhalai hoti toh Allah Ta'ala ise is museebat mein na daalta, is baat ne Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko woh sadma pahunchaya jo aaj tak Aap ko kisi cheez se na hua tha, us waqt kehne lage, Allah koi raat mujh par aisi nahi guzri ke koi bhooka shakhs mere ilm mein ho aur main ne pait bhar liya ho, Parwardigar agar main apni is baat mein Tere nazdeek sacha hun toh meri tasdeeq farma. Usi waqt aasman se Aap ki tasdeeq ki gayi thi aur woh dono sun rahe the. Phir farmaya ke Parwardigar kabhi aisa nahi hua ke mere paas ek se zaid kapde hon aur main ne kisi nange ko na diye hon, agar main is mein sacha hun toh meri tasdeeq aasman se kar. Is par bhi Aap ki tasdeeq un ke sunte hue ki gayi. Phir yeh dua karte hue sajde mein gir pade ke Aye Allah main toh ab sajde se sar na uthaunga jab tak ke Tu mujh se un tamam museebaton ko dur na karde jo mujh par nazil hui hain. Chunache yeh dua qabul hui aur us se pehle ke Aap sar uthaein tamam takleefen aur bimariyan dur ho gayin jo Aap par utri thin.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain ke Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam atharah baras tak balaon mein ghere rahe phir un ke do doston ke aane aur badgumani karne ka zikr hai jis ke jawab mein aap ne فرمایا ke meri to yeh halat thi ke rasta chalte do shakhson ko jhagarta dekhta aur un mein se kisi ko qasam khate sun leta to ghar aakar us ki taraf se kaffara ada kar deta ke aisa na ho ke us ne naam na-haq liya ho. Aap apni is beemari mein is qadar nidhal ho gaye the ke aap ki biwi sahiba haath tham kar pakhana peshab ke liye le jati thin. Aik martaba aap ko hajat thi aap ne aawaz di lekin unhe aane mein der lagi aap ko sakht takleef hui usi waqt aasman se nida aayi ke 'A Oor Ayub apni eri zameen par maro usi pani ko pee bhi lo aur usi se naha bhi lo'. Is hadis ka marfoo hona bilkul ghareeb hai. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain usi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke liye jannat ka hulla nazil farma diya jise pehen kar aap yaksu ho kar baith gaye. Jab aap ki biwi aayin aur aap ko na pehchan saken to aap se puchne lagen 'A Allah ke bande yahan aik beemar bekas bebass the tumhe maloom hai ke woh kya hue? Kahen unhe bheriye na kha gaye hon ya kutte na le gaye hon?' Tab aap ne farmaya 'Nahi nahi woh beemar Ayyub main hi hoon.' Biwi sahiba kehne lagi 'A shakhs tu mujh dukhiya aurat se hansi kar raha hai aur mujhe bana raha hai?' Aap ne farmaya 'Nahi nahi mujhe Allah ne shifa de di aur yeh rang roop bhi.' 

Aap ka maal aap ko wapas diya gaya aap ki aulad wahi aap ko wapas mili aur un ke sath hi waisi hi aur bhi wahi mein yeh khushkhabri bhi suna di gayi thi aur farmaya gaya tha ke qurbani karo aur istighfar karo, tere apnon ne tere bare mein meri nafarmani kar li thi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko afiyat ata farmai aasman se sone ki tiddiyan un par barsayin jinhe le kar aap ne apne kapre mein jama karni shuru kar din to aawaz di gayi ke 'A Ayyub kya tu ab tak aasuda nahi hua?' Aap ne jawab diya ke 'A mere Parvardigar teri rahmat se aasuda kaun ho sakta hai?' 

Phir farmata hai hum ne use us ke ahl ata farmaye. Ibn Abbas R.A to farmate hain wahi log wapas kiye gaye. Aap ki biwi ka naam Rahmat tha. Yeh qaul agar ayat se samjha gaya hai to yeh bhi door-az-kaar amr hai aur agar Ahl-e-Kitab se liya gaya hai to woh tasdeeq-o-takzeeb ke qabil hai cheez nahi. Ibn Asakir ne un ka naam apni tarikh mein "Liya" bataya hai. Yeh Mansha bin Yusuf bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki beti hain. Aik qaul yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat "Liya" Hazrat Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki beti Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ki biwi hain jo Shafi'ah ki zameen mein aap ke sath thin. 

Marwi hai ke aap se farmaya gaya ke 'Teri ahl sab jannat mein hain tum kaho to main un sab ko yahan duniya mein la dun aur kahe to wahin rehne dun aur duniya mein un ka awaz dun.' Aap ne dusri baat pasand farmai. Pas akhirat ka ajr aur duniya ka badla dono aap ko mila. Yeh sab kuch hamari rahmat ka zuhoor tha.

Aur hamare sachhe abidon ke liye nasiyat-o-ibrat thi, aap ahl-e-bala ke peshwa the. Yeh sab is liye hua ki museebaton mein phanse hue log apne liye aap ki zaat mein ibrat dekhein, besabri se nashukri na karne lagein aur log unhein Allah ke bure bande na samjhein. Hazrat Ayyub (Alaihis Salam) sabr ka pahad, sabit-qadmi ka namuna the Allah ke likhe par, uske imtihan par insan ko sabr-o-bardasht karni chahiye na jaane qubrat dar-parda apni kya kya hikmatein dikha rahi hai.

Azmaish aur Masaib-e-Ayyub (A.S):
Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) ki takleefon ka bayan ho raha hai jo mali, jismani aur aulaad par mushtamil thin. Unke paas bahut se qisam qisam ke janwar thay, khetiyan, baghaat waghera thay, aulaad, biwiyan, laundiyan, ghulam, jaidad aur maal-o-mata sabhi kuch Allah ka diya hua maujood tha. Ab jab Rabb ki taraf se un par azmaish aayi toh ek sire se sab kuch fana hota gaya yahan tak ke jism mein juzam phoot pada. Dil-o-zaban ke siva sare jism ka koi hissa is marz se mehfooz na raha. Yahan tak ke aas paas wale karahat karne lage. Shehar ke ek veeran kone mein aap ko sukunat ikhtiyar karni padi. Sivaye aap ki ek biwi sahabah (R.A) ke aur koi aap ke paas na raha, is museebat ke waqt sab ne kinara kar liya. Yehi ek thin jo unki khidmat karti thin sath hi mehnat mazduri karke pait palne ko bhi laya karti thin. 

Aank حضرت ﷺ ne sach farmaya ke sab se zyada sakht imtihan nabiyon ka hota hai, phir saleh logon ka, phir un se neeche ke darje walon ka, phir un se kam darje walon ka. Aur riwayat mein hai ke har shakhs ka imtihan uske deen ke andaz se hota hai, agar woh deen mein mazboot hai, imtihan bhi sakht-tar hota hai. 

Hazrat Ayyub (A.S) bade hi sabir thay yahan tak ke sabr-e-ayyub zaban-zad-e-aam hai. Yazid bin Maysarah (R.H) farmate hain: Jab aap ki azmaish shuru hui, ahl-o-ayyal mar gaye, maal fana ho gaya, koi cheez hath tale na rahi, aap Allah ke zikr mein aur badh gaye, kehne lage: "Ae tamam palne walon ke palne wale! Tu ne mujh par bade ehsaan kiye, maal diya, aulaad di, us waqt mera dil bahut hi mashghool tha, ab tu ne sab kuch lekar mere dil ko in fikron se paak kar diya, ab mere dil mein aur tujh mein koi hail na raha. Agar mera dushman Iblees teri is meharbaani ko jaan leta toh woh mujh par bahut hi hasad karta." 

Iblees-e-Laeen is qaul se aur us waqt ki is hamd se jal bhun kar reh gaya. Aap ki duaaon mein ye bhi dua thi: "Ae Allah! Tu ne jab mujhe tawanigar aur aulaad aur ahl-o-ayyal wala bana rakha tha toh khoob janta hai ke us waqt main ne na kabhi ghuroor-o-takabbur kiya na kabhi kisi par zulm-o-sitam kiya. Mere Parwardigar! Biwi sahiba kehne lagi 'A shakhs tu mujh dukhiya aurat se hansi kar raha hai aur mujhe bana raha hai?' Aap ne farmaya 'Nahi nahi mujhe Allah ne shifa de di aur yeh rang roop bhi.' 

Aap ka maal aap ko wapas diya gaya aap ki aulad wahi aap ko wapas mili aur un ke sath hi waisi hi aur bhi wahi mein yeh khushkhabri bhi suna di gayi thi aur farmaya gaya tha ke qurbani karo aur istighfar karo, tere apnon ne tere bare mein meri nafarmani kar li thi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko afiyat ata farmai aasman se sone ki tiddiyan un par barsayin jinhe le kar aap ne apne kapre mein jama karni shuru kar din to aawaz di gayi ke 'A Ayyub kya tu ab tak aasuda nahi hua?' Aap ne jawab diya ke 'A mere Parvardigar teri rahmat se aasuda kaun ho sakta hai?' 

Phir farmata hai hum ne use us ke ahl ata farmaye. Ibn Abbas R.A to farmate hain wahi log wapas kiye gaye. Aap ki biwi ka naam Rahmat tha. Yeh qaul agar ayat se samjha gaya hai to yeh bhi door-az-kaar amr hai aur agar Ahl-e-Kitab se liya gaya hai to woh tasdeeq-o-takzeeb ke qabil hai cheez nahi. Ibn Asakir ne un ka naam apni tarikh mein "Liya" bataya hai. Yeh Mansha bin Yusuf bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki beti hain. Aik qaul yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat "Liya" Hazrat Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki beti Hazrat Ayyub Alaihis Salam ki biwi hain jo Shafi'ah ki zameen mein aap ke sath thin. 

Marwi hai ke aap se farmaya gaya ke 'Teri ahl sab jannat mein hain tum kaho to main un sab ko yahan duniya mein la dun aur kahe to wahin rehne dun aur duniya mein un ka awaz dun.' Aap ne dusri baat pasand farmai. Pas akhirat ka ajr aur duniya ka badla dono aap ko mila. Yeh sab kuch hamari rahmat ka zuhoor tha.

Aur hamare sachhe abidon ke liye nasiyat-o-ibrat thi, aap ahl-e-bala ke peshwa the. Yeh sab is liye hua ki museebaton mein phanse hue log apne liye aap ki zaat mein ibrat dekhein, besabri se nashukri na karne lagein aur log unhein Allah ke bure bande na samjhein. Hazrat Ayyub (Alaihis Salam) sabr ka pahad, sabit-qadmi ka namuna the Allah ke likhe par, uske imtihan par insan ko sabr-o-bardasht karni chahiye na jaane qubrat dar-parda apni kya kya hikmatein dikha rahi hai.

Zulkifl nabi nahi buzurg thay. Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah A.S ke farzand thay. Surah Maryam mein unka waqia bayan ho chuka hai. Hazrat Idris A.S ka bhi zikr guzar chuka hai. Zulkifl ba-zahir toh nabi hi maloom hote hain kyunke nabiyon ke zikr mein unka naam aya hai aur log kehte hain yeh nabi na thay balkay ek salih shakhs thay, apne zamane ke badshah thay, baray hi aadil aur ba-maruwat. Imam Ibn Jarir R.H is mein tawakkuf karte hain, wallahu a'lam. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yeh ek nek buzurg thay jinhon ne apne zamane ke nabi se ahd-o-paiman kiye aur un par qaim rahay. Qawm mein adl-o-insaf kiya karte thay.

Marwi hai ki jab Hazrat Yasa' A.S bahut burhay ho gaye toh irada kiya ki main apni zindagi mein hi unka khalifa muqarrar kar dun aur dekh lun ki woh kaisay amal karta hai. Logon ko jama kiya aur kaha ki teen baatein jo shakhs manzoor kare main use khilafat saunpta hun. Din bhar rozay se rahe, raat bhar qiyam kare aur kabhi bhi ghussay na ho. Koi aur toh khara na hua, ek shakhs jise log bahut halkay darjay ka samajhte thay khara hua aur kehne laga main is shart ko poori kar dun ga. Aap ne pucha ya'ni tu dinon mein rozay se rahega aur raton ko tahajjud parhta rahega aur ghussa na karega? Us ne kaha haan. Yasa' A.S ne farmaya achha ab kal sahi. Dusre roz bhi aap ne usi tarah majlis mein aam sawal kiya lekin us shakhs ke siwa koi aur khara na hua. Chunacha unhi ko khalifa bana diya gaya.

Ab shaitan ne chotay chotay shayateen ko is buzurg ke behkane ke liye bhejna shuru kiya. Magar kisi ki kuch na chali. Iblis khud chala, dopahar ko qaylolah ke liye aap letay hi thay jo khabeeth ne kundiyan peetni shuru kar din. Aap ne daryaft farmaya ki tu kaun hai? Us ne kehna shuru kiya ki main ek mazloom hun, faryadi hun, meri qawm mujhe sata rahi hai. Mere sath unhon ne yeh kiya, yeh kiya, ab lamba qissa sunana shuru kiya toh kisi tarah khatam hi nahi karta. Neend ka sara waqt usi mein chala gaya aur Hazrat Zulkifl din raat bas sirf usi waqt zara si der ke liye sotay thay. Aap ne farmaya achha shaam ko aana main tumhara insaf kar dun ga. Ab shaam ko aap jab faisle karne lage har taraf use dekhte hain lekin uska kahin pata nahi, yahan tak ki khud ja kar idhar udhar bhi talash kiya magar use na paya. 

Dusri subah ko bhi woh na aya, phir jahan aap dopahar ko do ghari aaram karne ke iradaye se letay jo yeh khabeeth aa gaya aur darwaza thonkne laga. Aap ne khol diya aur farmane lage main ne toh tumse shaam ko aane ko kaha tha, muntazir raha lekin tum na aaye. Woh kehne laga Hazrat kya bataun jab main ne aap ki taraf aane ka irada kiya toh woh kehne lage tum na jao hum tumhara haq ada kar dete hain, main ruk gaya phir unhon ne ab inkar kar diya aur bhi kuch lambe chauray waqayat bayan karne shuru kar diye aur aaj ki neend bhi khoyi. Ab shaam ko phir intezar kiya lekin na use aana tha na aya.

Tisre din Aap ne admi muqarrar kiya ke dekho koi darwaze par na aane paye mare neend ke meri halat ghair ho rahi hai Aap abhi lete hi thay ke woh mardood phir aagya chowkidar ne use roka yeh ek taaq mein se andar ghus gaya aur andar se darwaza khatkhatana shuru kiya Aap ne uth kar pehre-dar se kaha ke dekho main ne tumhein hidayat kardi thi phir bhi Aap ne darwaze ke andar kisi ko aane diya us ne kaha nahi meri taraf se koi nahi aaya. Ab jo ghor se Aap ne dekha to darwaze ko band payaya. Aur us shakhs ko andar maujood payaya. Aap pehchan gaye ke yeh Shaitan hai us waqt Shaitan ne kaha Ae Waliullah main tujh se hara na tu ne raat ka qiyam tark kiya na tu ne us naukar par aise mauqa par ghusse huwa pas Allah ne un ka naam Zul-Kifl rakha. Is liye ke jin baton ki unhon ne kafalat li thi unhein poora kar dikhaya. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Ibn Abbas R.A se bhi kuch tafsir ke sath yeh qissa marwi hai us mein hai ke Bani Israel ke ek qazi ne ba-waqt-e-marg kaha tha ke mere baad mera ohda kaun sambhalta hai? Us ne kaha main chunacha un ka naam Zul-Kifl huwa is mein hai ke Shaitan jab un ke aaram ke waqt aaya pehre walon ne roka us ne is qadr ghul machaya ke Aap jag gaye doosre din bhi yehi kiya teesre din bhi yehi kiya ab Aap us ke sath chalne ke liye aamada huye ke main tere sath chal kar tera haq dilwata hoon lekin raste mein se woh apna hath chuda kar bhag khada huwa. Hazrat Ash'ari ne mimar par farmaya ke Zul-Kifl Nabi na tha Bani Israel ka ek saleh shakhs tha jo har roz sau namazein padhta tha us ke baad unhon ne is qism ki ibadaton ka zimma uthaya. Is liye unhein Zul-Kifl kaha gaya. Ek munqata' riwayat mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A se yeh manqool hai. Ek ghareeb Hadees Musnad Imam Ibn Hanbal mein hai us mein Kifl ka ek waqya bayan hai Zul-Kifl nahi kaha gaya. Bahut mumkin hai yeh koi aur sahib hon. Waqya is Hadees mein yeh hai ke Kifl nami ek shakhs tha jo kisi gunah se bachta na tha. Ek martaba us ne ek aurat ko sath dinar de kar badkari ke liye aamada kiya jab apna irada poora karne ke liye tayyar huwa to woh aurat rone aur kanpne lagi. Us ne kaha main ne tujh se koi zabardasti to ki nahi phir rone aur kanpne ki wajah kya hai? Us ne kaha main ne aisi koi nafarmani aaj tak Allah Ta'ala ki nahi ki. Is waqt meri mohtaji ne mujhe yeh bura din dikhaya hai. Kifl ne kaha tu ek gunah par is qadr pareshan hai? Halankay is se pehle tu ne kabhi aisa nahi kiya. Isi waqt use chhod kar us se alag ho gaya aur kehne laga ja yeh dinar main ne tujhe bakhshe. Qasam Allah ki aaj se main kisi qism ki Allah ki nafarmani na karunga. Allah ki shan isi raat is ka inteqal hota hai. Subah log dekhte hain ke us ke darwaze par qudrati haroof se likha huwa tha ke Allah ne Kifl ko bakhsh diya.

Yunus Alaihis Salam aur un ki ummat yeh waqia yahan bhi mazkur hai aur Surah Saffat mein bhi hai aur Surah Noon mein bhi hai. Yeh paighambar Hazrat Yunus bin Matta Alaihis Salam thay. Inhein Mosul ke ilaqe ki basti Nainwa ki taraf Nabi bana kar Allah Ta'ala ne bheja tha. Aap ne Allah ki rah ki dawat di lekin kaum iman na layi. Aap wahan se naraz ho kar chal diye aur un logon se kehne lage ke teen din mein tum par Azab-e-Ilahi aa jayega. Jab unhein is baat ki tehqiq ho gayi aur unhon ne jaan liya ke Anbiya Alaihimas Salam jhoote nahi hote toh yeh sab ke sab chote bare ma' apne janwaron aur maweshiyon ke jangal mein nikal khade huwe, bachon ko maon se juda kar diya aur bilak bilak kar nihayat girya-o-zari se Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein faryad shuru kar di. Idhar un ki aah-o-baka, idhar janwaron ki bhayanak sada, gharz Allah ki rahmat mutawajjo ho gayi, azab utha liya gaya. Jaise farman hai ayat (falawla kanat qaryatun amanat fanafa'aha imanuha illa qauma yunus 98) (Yunus: 98). Yaani azabon ki tehqiq ke baad ke iman ne kisi ko nafa nahi diya siwaye kaum-e-Yunus ke ke un ke iman ki wajah se hum ne un par se azab hata liye aur duniya ki ruswai se unhein bacha liya aur maut tak ki mohlat de di. Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam yahan se chal kar aik kashti mein sawar huwe, aage jaakar toofan ke asar namoodar huwe. Qareeb tha ke kashti doob jaye, mashwara yeh huwa ke kisi aadmi ko darya mein daal dena chahiye ke wazan kam ho jaye. Qura' Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam ka nikla lekin kisi ne aap ko darya mein dalna pasand na kiya. Dobara qura' andazi hui aap hi ka naam nikla, teesri martaba phir qura' dala ab ki martaba bhi aap hi ka naam nikla. Chunacha khud Quran mein hai ayat (fasahama fakana minal-mudhadhin 141) (Saffat: 141). Ab ke Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam khud khade ho gaye, kapre utaar kar darya mein kood pare. Bahr-e-Akhzar se bi-hukm-e-Ilahi aik machhli pani kaat ti hui aayi aur aap ko luqma kar gayi. Lekin bi-hukm-e-Allah ne aap ki haddi toori na jism ko kuch nuqsan pohanchaya. Aap is ke liye ghiza na thay balki is ka peet aap ke liye qaid-khana tha. Isi wajah se aap ki nisbat machhli ki taraf ki gayi, arabi mein machhli ko Noon kehte hain. Aap ka gazab-o-gussa aap ki kaum par tha. Khayal yeh tha ke Allah aap ko tang na pakdega, pas yahan naqdar ke yahi ma'ni Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Dahhak waghera ne kiye hain, Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain aur is ki ta'yid ayat (wa man qudira 'alaihi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahullahu) (At-Talaq: 7) se bhi hoti hai. Hazrat Atiyyah Aufi Rahimahullah ne yeh ma'ni kiye hain ke hum is par muqaddar na karenge, qadar aur qdar dono lafz aik ma'ni mein bole jate hain, is ki sanad mein arabi ke sher ke elawa ayat (fal-taqal-ma'u 'ala amrin qad qudira 12) (Al-Qamar: 12) bhi paish ki ja sakti hai. In andheriyon mein phans kar ab Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko pukara.

Samundar ke neeche ka andhera phir machli ke pet ka andhera phir raat ka andhera yeh andhere sab jama thay. Aap ne samandar ki teh ki kankariyon ki tasbeeh suni aur khud bhi tasbeeh karni shuru ki. Aap machli ke pet mein ja kar pehle toh samjhe ke main mar gaya phir pair ko hilaya toh yaqeen hua ke main zinda hoon. Wahin sajde mein gir pare aur kehne lage Bar-Ilahi main ne tere liye is jagah ko masjid banaya jise is se pehle kisi ne jaye sujud na banaya hoga. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain chaalis din aap machli ke pet mein rahe. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Yunus A.S ke qaid ka irada kiya toh machli ko hukm diya ke aap ko nigal le lekin is tarah ke na haddi tute na jism par kharash aaye jab aap samandar ki teh mein poche toh wahan tasbeeh sun kar hairan reh gaye wahi aayi ke yeh samandar ke janwaron ki tasbeeh hai. Chunacha aap ne bhi Allah ki tasbeeh shuru kar di ise sun kar farishton ne kaha Bar-Ilaha! Yeh aawaz toh bahut door ki aur bahut kamzor hai kis ki hai? Hum toh nahi pehchan sake. Jawab mila ke yeh mere bande Yunus ki aawaz hai is ne meri nafarmani ki main ne ise machli ke pet ke qaid khane mein daal diya hai. Unhon ne kaha Parvardigar in ke naik aamal toh din raat ke har waqt charhte hi rehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne in ki sifarish qubool farmayi aur machli ko hukm diya ke woh aap ko kinare par ugal de. Tafsir Ibn-e-Kaseer ke ek nuske mein yeh riwayat bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kisi ko layq nahi ke woh apne taiy Yunus bin Matta se afzal kahe. Allah ke is bande ne andheriyon mein apne Rabb ki tasbeeh bayaan ki hai. Upar jo riwayat guzri us ki wahi ek sanad hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab Hazrat Yunus A.S ne yeh dua ki toh yeh kalmaat Arsh ke gird-o-nghumne lage farishte kehne lage bahut door daraz ki yeh aawaz hai lekin kaan is se pehle aashna zaroor hain aawaz bahut zaeef hai. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya kya tum ne pehchana nahi? Unhon ne kaha nahi. Farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha wahi Yunus jis ke pak amal qubool shuda har roz teri taraf charhte thay aur jin ki duayein tere paas maqbool thin, اے Allah jaise woh aaram ke waqt nekiyan karta tha toh is museebat ke waqt is par raham kar. Usi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne machli ko hukm diya ke woh aap ko baghair kisi takleef ke kinare par ugal de. Istighfar mojib-e-nijaat hai phir farmata hai ke hum ne in ki dua qubool kar li aur gham se nijaat de di in andheriyon se nikal diya. Isi tarah hum iman daron ko nijaat diya karte hain. Woh museebaton mein ghir kar hamein pukarte hain aur hum in ki dastgiri farma kar tamam mushkilein asan kar dete hain. Khususan jo log is duayein Yunusi ko parhein Syed-ul-Anbiya Rasool ﷺ farmate hain Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas R.A farmate hain main masjid mein gaya Hazrat Usman R.A wahan thay.

Maine salam kiya aap ne mujhe baghor dekha aur mere salam ka jawab na diya, maine Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A se aakar shikayat ki, aap ne Hazrat Usman R.A ko bulwaya, un se kaha ke aap ne aik musalman bhai ke salam ka jawab kyun na diya? Aap ne farmaya na yeh aaye na unhon ne salam kiya na yeh ke maine unhe jawab na diya ho. Is par main ne qasam khai to aap ne bhi mere muqable mein qasam kha li, phir kuch khayal karke Hazrat Usman R.A ne tauba istaghfar kiya aur farmaya theek hai. Aap nikle thay lekin main us waqt apne dil se woh baat keh raha tha jo main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suni thi. Wallah mujhe jab woh yaad aati hai meri ankhon par hi nahi balkay mere dil par bhi parda pad jata hai. Hazrat Sa'd R.A ne farmaya main aap ko is ki khabar deta hoon, Rasool Allah ﷺ ne hamare samne awwal dua ka zikr kiya hi tha ke aik a'rabi aa gaya aur aap ko apni baaton mein mashghool kar liya, waqt guzarta gaya, ab Huzoor ﷺ wahan se uthe aur makan ki taraf tashreef le chale, main bhi aap ke peeche ho liya, jab aap ghar ke qareeb pahunch gaye, mujhe darr laga ke kahin aap andar na chale jayen aur main reh jaun, to main ne zor zor se paon maar maar kar chalna shuru kiya, meri jootiyon ki aahat sun kar aap ne meri taraf dekha aur farmaya: Kaun Abu Ishaq? Main ne kaha: Ji haan Ya Rasool Allah! Main hi hoon. Aap ne farmaya: Haan haan, woh dua Hazrat Zun-Noon A.S ki thi jo unhon ne machli ke pait mein ki thi yaani (Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaż-ẓālimīn) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 87). Suno! Jo bhi musalman jis kisi mamle mein jab kabhi apne Rabb se yeh dua kare Allah Ta'ala use zaroor qubool farmata hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai: Jo bhi is dua ke sath dua kare us ki dua zaroor qubool ki jaye. Abu Saeed farmate hain: Isi ayat mein is ke baad hi farman hai: Hum isi tarah mominon ko najaat dete hain. Ibn Jareer mein hai: Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Allah ka woh naam jis se woh pukara jaye to qubool farma le aur jo manga jaye woh ata farmaye, woh Hazrat Yunus bin Matta ki dua mein hai. Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas R.A farmate hain: Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah! Woh Hazrat Yunus ke liye hi khas thi ya tamam musalmanon ke liye aam hai? Farmaya: Un ke liye khas aur tamam musalmanon ke liye aam, jo bhi yeh dua kare. Kya tu ne Quran mein nahi padha ke hum ne us ki dua qubool farmayi, use gham se chhidaye aur isi tarah hum mominon ko chhulate hain? Pas jo bhi is dua ko kare us se Allah ka qubooliyat ka wada ho chuka hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai: Kaseer bin Saeed farmate hain: Main ne Imam Hasan Basri R.H se poochha ke Abu Saeed, Allah ka woh Ism-e-Azam ke jab is ke sath us se dua ki jaye Allah Ta'ala qubool farma le aur jab is ke sath us se sawal kiya jaye to woh ata farmaye, kya hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke baradar-zade! Kya tum ne Quran-e-Kareem mein Allah ka yeh farman nahi padha?

Phir Aap ne yehi do aayatein tilawat farmayin aur farmaya: Bhatije! Yehi Allah ka woh Ism-e-Azam hai ke jab is ke sath dua ki jaye woh qabool farmata hai aur jab is ke sath is se manga jaye woh ata farmata hai.)

Yunus Alaihis Salam aur un ki ummat yeh waqia yahan bhi mazkur hai aur Surah Saffat mein bhi hai aur Surah Noon mein bhi hai. Yeh paighambar Hazrat Yunus bin Matta Alaihis Salam thay. Inhein Mosul ke ilaqe ki basti Nainwa ki taraf Nabi bana kar Allah Ta'ala ne bheja tha. Aap ne Allah ki rah ki dawat di lekin kaum iman na layi. Aap wahan se naraz ho kar chal diye aur un logon se kehne lage ke teen din mein tum par Azab-e-Ilahi aa jayega. Jab unhein is baat ki tehqiq ho gayi aur unhon ne jaan liya ke Anbiya Alaihimas Salam jhoote nahi hote toh yeh sab ke sab chote bare ma' apne janwaron aur maweshiyon ke jangal mein nikal khade huwe, bachon ko maon se juda kar diya aur bilak bilak kar nihayat girya-o-zari se Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein faryad shuru kar di. Idhar un ki aah-o-baka, idhar janwaron ki bhayanak sada, gharz Allah ki rahmat mutawajjo ho gayi, azab utha liya gaya. Jaise farman hai ayat (falawla kanat qaryatun amanat fanafa'aha imanuha illa qauma yunus 98) (Yunus: 98). Yaani azabon ki tehqiq ke baad ke iman ne kisi ko nafa nahi diya siwaye kaum-e-Yunus ke ke un ke iman ki wajah se hum ne un par se azab hata liye aur duniya ki ruswai se unhein bacha liya aur maut tak ki mohlat de di. Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam yahan se chal kar aik kashti mein sawar huwe, aage jaakar toofan ke asar namoodar huwe. Qareeb tha ke kashti doob jaye, mashwara yeh huwa ke kisi aadmi ko darya mein daal dena chahiye ke wazan kam ho jaye. Qura' Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam ka nikla lekin kisi ne aap ko darya mein dalna pasand na kiya. Dobara qura' andazi hui aap hi ka naam nikla, teesri martaba phir qura' dala ab ki martaba bhi aap hi ka naam nikla. Chunacha khud Quran mein hai ayat (fasahama fakana minal-mudhadhin 141) (Saffat: 141). Ab ke Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam khud khade ho gaye, kapre utaar kar darya mein kood pare. Bahr-e-Akhzar se bi-hukm-e-Ilahi aik machhli pani kaat ti hui aayi aur aap ko luqma kar gayi. Lekin bi-hukm-e-Allah ne aap ki haddi toori na jism ko kuch nuqsan pohanchaya. Aap is ke liye ghiza na thay balki is ka peet aap ke liye qaid-khana tha. Isi wajah se aap ki nisbat machhli ki taraf ki gayi, arabi mein machhli ko Noon kehte hain. Aap ka gazab-o-gussa aap ki kaum par tha. Khayal yeh tha ke Allah aap ko tang na pakdega, pas yahan naqdar ke yahi ma'ni Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Dahhak waghera ne kiye hain, Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain aur is ki ta'yid ayat (wa man qudira 'alaihi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahullahu) (At-Talaq: 7) se bhi hoti hai. Hazrat Atiyyah Aufi Rahimahullah ne yeh ma'ni kiye hain ke hum is par muqaddar na karenge, qadar aur qdar dono lafz aik ma'ni mein bole jate hain, is ki sanad mein arabi ke sher ke elawa ayat (fal-taqal-ma'u 'ala amrin qad qudira 12) (Al-Qamar: 12) bhi paish ki ja sakti hai. In andheriyon mein phans kar ab Hazrat Yunus Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko pukara.

Samundar ke neeche ka andhera phir machli ke pet ka andhera phir raat ka andhera yeh andhere sab jama thay. Aap ne samandar ki teh ki kankariyon ki tasbeeh suni aur khud bhi tasbeeh karni shuru ki. Aap machli ke pet mein ja kar pehle toh samjhe ke main mar gaya phir pair ko hilaya toh yaqeen hua ke main zinda hoon. Wahin sajde mein gir pare aur kehne lage Bar-Ilahi main ne tere liye is jagah ko masjid banaya jise is se pehle kisi ne jaye sujud na banaya hoga. Hasan Basri Rahimahullah farmate hain chaalis din aap machli ke pet mein rahe. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Yunus A.S ke qaid ka irada kiya toh machli ko hukm diya ke aap ko nigal le lekin is tarah ke na haddi tute na jism par kharash aaye jab aap samandar ki teh mein poche toh wahan tasbeeh sun kar hairan reh gaye wahi aayi ke yeh samandar ke janwaron ki tasbeeh hai. Chunacha aap ne bhi Allah ki tasbeeh shuru kar di ise sun kar farishton ne kaha Bar-Ilaha! Yeh aawaz toh bahut door ki aur bahut kamzor hai kis ki hai? Hum toh nahi pehchan sake. Jawab mila ke yeh mere bande Yunus ki aawaz hai is ne meri nafarmani ki main ne ise machli ke pet ke qaid khane mein daal diya hai. Unhon ne kaha Parvardigar in ke naik aamal toh din raat ke har waqt charhte hi rehte hain Allah Ta'ala ne in ki sifarish qubool farmayi aur machli ko hukm diya ke woh aap ko kinare par ugal de. Tafsir Ibn-e-Kaseer ke ek nuske mein yeh riwayat bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kisi ko layq nahi ke woh apne taiy Yunus bin Matta se afzal kahe. Allah ke is bande ne andheriyon mein apne Rabb ki tasbeeh bayaan ki hai. Upar jo riwayat guzri us ki wahi ek sanad hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain jab Hazrat Yunus A.S ne yeh dua ki toh yeh kalmaat Arsh ke gird-o-nghumne lage farishte kehne lage bahut door daraz ki yeh aawaz hai lekin kaan is se pehle aashna zaroor hain aawaz bahut zaeef hai. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya kya tum ne pehchana nahi? Unhon ne kaha nahi. Farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha wahi Yunus jis ke pak amal qubool shuda har roz teri taraf charhte thay aur jin ki duayein tere paas maqbool thin, اے Allah jaise woh aaram ke waqt nekiyan karta tha toh is museebat ke waqt is par raham kar. Usi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne machli ko hukm diya ke woh aap ko baghair kisi takleef ke kinare par ugal de. Istighfar mojib-e-nijaat hai phir farmata hai ke hum ne in ki dua qubool kar li aur gham se nijaat de di in andheriyon se nikal diya. Isi tarah hum iman daron ko nijaat diya karte hain. Woh museebaton mein ghir kar hamein pukarte hain aur hum in ki dastgiri farma kar tamam mushkilein asan kar dete hain. Khususan jo log is duayein Yunusi ko parhein Syed-ul-Anbiya Rasool ﷺ farmate hain Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi waghera mein hai Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas R.A farmate hain main masjid mein gaya Hazrat Usman R.A wahan thay.

Aap ne farmaya na yeh aaye na unhon ne salam kiya na yeh ke maine unhe jawab na diya ho. Dua aur burhape mein aulad

Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ka qissa bayan farmata hai ke unhon ne dua ki ke mujhe aulad ho jo mere baad nabi bane. Surah Maryam mein aur Surah Ale-Imran mein yeh waqia tafseel se hai. Aap ne yeh dua chhupa kar ki thi. Mujhe tanha nah chhod yaani be-aulad. Dua ke baad Allah Ta'ala ki sana ki jaise ke us dua ke layak thi. Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki dua qabul farmayi aur aap ki biwi sahiba ko jinhen burhape tak koi aulad na hui thi, aulad ke qabil bana diya. Baaz log kehte hain un ki tul-e-zabanen band kar di, baaz kehte hain ke un ke akhlaq ki kami poori kar di. Lekin alfaz-e-Quran ke qareeb pehla maana hi hai.

Yeh sab buzurg nekiyon ki taraf, Allah ki farmanbardari ki taraf bhaag-daud karne wale the, aur lalach aur dar se Allah se duayein karne wale the, aur sache momin Rab ki baatein manne wale, Allah ka khauf rakhne wale, tawazu, inksari aur aajizi karne wale, Allah ke samne apni forutani zahir karne wale the.

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne apne ek khutbe mein farmaya: Main tumhein Allah Ta'ala se darte rehne ki aur uski poori sana-o-sifat bayan karte rehne ki, aur lalach aur khauf se duayein mangne ki, aur duaaon mein khushoo-o-khuzoo karne ki wasiyat karta hoon. Dekho, Allah Azzawajal ne Hazrat Zakariya (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ke gharane ki yehi fazilat bayan farmayi hai. Phir aap ne yeh ayat tilawat farmayi.

Dua aur burhape mein aulad

Bila shohar aulad Hazrat Maryam aur Hazrat Isa A.S ka qissa bayan ho raha hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein umuman Hazrat Zakariya A.S aur Hazrat Yahya A.S ke qisse ke sath hi unka qissa bayan hota raha hai. Isliye ke in logon mein poora rabta hai. Hazrat Zakariya A.S poore budhape ke aalam mein, aap ki biwi sahiba jawani se guzri hui aur poori umar ki be-aulad, unke haan aulad ata farmai. Is qudrat ko dikha kar phir mahz aurat baghair shohar ke aulad ka ata farmana yeh aur qudrat ka kamal zahir karta hai. Surah Al-Imran aur Surah Maryam mein bhi yahi tarteeb hai. Murad ismat wali aurat se Hazrat Maryam hain jaise farman hai: Ayat (Wa Maryamabnata Imranallati ahsanat farjaha fanafakha fihi min ruhina wa saddaqat bikalimati Rabbiha wa kutubiha wa kanat minal-qanitin) (At-Tahrim: 12) Yaani Imran ki larki Maryam jo pak daman thin, unhe aur unke larke aur Hazrat Isa A.S ko apni be-nazir qudrat ka nishan banaya, ke makhlooq ko Allah ki har tarah ki qudrat aur uske paidaish ke wasee ikhtiyar aur sirf apne irade se cheezon ka banana maloom ho jaye. Isa A.S Allah ki qudrat ki ek alamat the, jinrat ke liye bhi aur insanon ke liye bhi.

Tamam shari'aton ki rooh tauheed hai. Farman hai ke tum sab ka deen ek hi hai. Awamir-o-nawahi ke ahkaam tum sab mein yaksan hain. Hazihi ism hai in ka aur ummatukum khabar hai aur ummatan wahidatan haal hai. Ya'ni yeh shari'at jo bayan hui tum sab ki muttafiq-e-alaihi shari'at hai. Jis ka asli maqsood tauheed-e-Ilahi hai jaise aayat (Yaa ayyuhar-rusulu kulu minat-tayyibati wa'malu saliha, inni bima ta'maluna 'alim) (Surah (Al-Mu'minun: 51). Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hum ambiya ki jama'at agarcheh ahkamat-e-shar' mukhtalif hain jaise farman-e-Quran hai aayat (Likullin ja'alna minkum shir'atan wa minhaja) (Surah (Al-Ma'idah: 48) har ek ki raah aur tareeqa hai. Phir logon ne ikhtilaf kiya, ba'z apne nabiyon par iman laye aur ba'z na laye. Qayamat ke din sab ka lautna hamari taraf hai, har ek ko us ke a'maal ka badla diya jaye ga, nekon ko nek badla aur buron ko buri saza. Jis ke dil mein iman ho aur jis ke a'maal nek hon us ke a'maal akarat na honge. Jaise farman hai aayat (Innal-lazina amanu wa 'amilus-salihati inna la nudi'u ajra man ahsana 'amala) (Surah (Al-Kahf: 30). Nek kaam karne walon ka ajr hum zaya nahin karte. Aise a'maal ki qadardani karte hain, ek zarre ke barabar hum zulm rawa nahin rakhte, tamam a'maal likh lete hain, koi cheez chhodte nahin.)))
