Yafis ki aulad halak shuda logon ka duniya ki taraf phir palatna mahal hai. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke un ki tauba maqbool nahin. Lekin pehla qaul aula hai. Yajooj Majooj nasl-e-Adam se hain. Balkeh woh Hazrat Nuh A.S ke ladke Yafis ki aulad mein se hain jin ki nasl Turk hain yeh bhi inhi ka ek giroh hai yeh Zulqarnain ki banai hui deewar se bahar hi chhor diye gaye thay. Aap ne deewar bana kar farmaya tha ke yeh mere Rab ki rahmat hai. Allah ke wade ke waqt is ka choora choora ho jayega mere Rab ka wada haq hai al-kh. Yajooj Majooj qurb-e-qayamat ke waqt wahan se nikal aayenge aur zameen mein fasad macha denge. Har oonchi jagah ko Arabi mein hadab kehte hain. Un ke nikalne ke waqt un ki yahi halat hogi to is khabar ko is tarah bayan kiya jaise sunne wala apni aankhon se dekh raha hai aur waqia mein Allah Ta'ala se zyada sachi khabar kis ki hogi? Jo ghaib aur hazir ka janne wala hai. Ho chuki hui aur hone wali baton se aagah hai. Ibn Abbas R.A ne ladkon ko uchalte koodte khelte daudte ek dusron ki chutkiyan bharte hue dekh kar farmaya isi tarah Yajooj Majooj aayenge. Bahut si ahadees mein un ke nikalne ka zikr hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Yajooj Majooj khole jayenge aur woh logon ke paas pahunchenge jaise Allah Azzawajal ka farman hai aayat (وَهُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنْسِلُوْنَ) (Al-Anbiya: 96) woh chha jayenge aur musalman apne shahron aur qilon mein simat aayenge apne janwaron ko bhi wahi le lenge aur apna pani unhein pilate rahenge Yajooj Majooj jis nehar se guzrenge us ka pani safa chat kar jayenge yahan tak ke us mein khaak udne lage gi un ki dusri jamaat jab wahan pahunche gi to woh kahe gi shayad is mein kisi zamane mein pani hoga. Jab yeh dekhenge ke ab zameen par koi na raha aur waqia mein siwaye un musalmanon ke jo apne shahron aur qilon mein panah guzeen honge koi aur wahan hoga bhi nahin to yeh kahenge ke ab zameen walon se tum hum farigh ho gaye aao aasman walon ki khabar lein. Chunancha un mein se ek shareer apna neza ghuma kar aasman ki taraf phenke ga qudrat-e-ilahi se woh khoon alood ho kar un ke paas gire ga yeh bhi ek qudrati aazmaish hogi ab un ki gardanon mein guthli ho jayegi aur isi waba mein yeh saare ke saare ek sath ek dam mar jayenge ek bhi baqi na rahe ga sara shor-o-ghul khatam ho jayega musalman kahenge koi hai jo apni jaan hum musalmanon ke liye hatheli par rakh kar shahar ke bahar jaye aur in dushmanon ko dekhe ke kis haal mein hain? Chunancha ek sahib is ke liye tayyar ho jayenge aur apne aap ko qatl shuda samajh kar Allah ki rah mein musalmanon ki khidmat ke liye nikal khade honge dekhenge ke sab ka dher lag raha hai saare halak shuda pade hue hain yeh isi waqt nida kare ga ke musalmano!

Khush ho jao Allah ne khud tumhare dushmanon ko gharat kardiya yeh dher para hua hai ab musalman bahar aayenge aur apne maweshiyon ko bhi layenge un ke liye chara bajuz un ke gosht ke aur kuch na hoga yeh un ka gosht kha kha kar khoob mote taze hojayenge. 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek din subh hi subh Dajjal ka zikr kiya is tarah ke hum samjhe shayad woh un darakhton ki aar mein hai aur ab nikla hi chahta hai aap farmane lage mujhe Dajjal se zyada khauf tum par aur cheez ka hai. Agar Dajjal meri maujoodgi mein nikla to main khud nimat lunga tum mein se har shakhs us se bache. Main tumhein Allah ki aman mein de raha hoon. Woh jawan umr uljhe hue baalon wala kana aur ubhri hui aankh wala hai. Woh Sham aur Iraq ke darmiyan se niklega aur dayen bayen ghoomega. Aye bandagan-e-Ilahi tum sabit qadam rehna. Hum ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh kitna thehre ga? Aap ne farmaya chalees din. Ek din misl ek baras ke, ek din misl ek mahine ke, ek din misl ek jumah ke aur baqi din mamooli dinon jaise. Hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo din saal bhar ke barabar hoga us mein hamein yehi panch namazein kafi hongi? Aap ne farmaya nahin tum apne andaze se waqt par namaz parhte raha karna. Hum ne daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ki raftar kaisi hogi? Farmaya jaise badal ke hawa unhein idhar se udhar bhagaye liye jati ho. Ek qabeelay ke paas jayega unhein apni taraf bulayega woh us ki maan lenge. Aasman ko hukm dega ke un par barish barsaye, zameen se kahega ke un ke liye paidawar ugaye, un ke janwar un ke paas mote taze bhare pet lautenge. Ek qabeelay ke paas apne tayin manwana chahega woh inkar kardenge yeh wahan se niklega to un ke tamam maal us ke peeche lag jayenge woh bilkul khali hath reh jayenge, woh ghair-abad jangalon mein jayega aur zameen se kahega apne khazane ugal de woh ugal degi aur saare khazane us ke peeche aise chalenge jaise shehad ki makkhiyan apne sardar ke peeche. Yeh bhi dikhayega ke ek shakhs ko talwar se theek do tukray karade ga aur idhar udhar door daraz phenkwa dega phir us ka naam le kar awaz dega to woh zinda chalta phirta us ke paas aajayega yeh isi haal mein hoga jo Allah Azzawajal Hazrat Maseeh Ibn-e-Maryam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko utarega aap Damishq ki mashriqi taraf safed minaray ke paas utrenge apne dono hath do farishton ke paron par rakhe hue honge aap us ka peecha karenge aur mashriqi baab ke Lud ke paas use pa kar qatl kardenge phir Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki taraf Allah ki wahi aayegi main apne aise bandon ko bhejta hoon jin se larne ki tum mein taab-o-taqat nahin mere bandon ko Toor ki taraf samet le ja.

Phir Janab-e-Bari Ya'juj Ma'juj ko bhejega jaise farmaya aayat (Wa hum min kulli hadabin yansilun). Un se tang aakar Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke saathi Janab-e-Bari mein dua karenge toh Allah Ta'ala un par guthli ki bimari bhejega jo un ki gardan mein niklegi, saare ke saare upar tale ek saath hi mar jayenge. Tab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ma'a momino ke aayenge. Dekhenge ke tamam zameen un ki lashon se pati padi hai aur un ki badbu se khada nahin hua jata. Aap phir Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge toh Allah Ta'ala bakhti unton ki gardanon jaise parind bhejega jo unhein Allah jaane kahan phenk aayenge? Ka'ab (R.H) kehte hain Mahil mein yani suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah mein unhein phenk aayenge. Phir chalis din tak tamam zameen mein musalsal barish barsegi, zameen dhul dhula kar hatheli ki tarah saaf ho jayegi phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi apni barkatein uga degi. Us din ek jama'at ki jama'at ek anaar se sair ho jayegi aur us ke chhalke tale saya hasil kar legi, ek untni ka doodh logon ki ek jama'at ko aur ek gaye ka doodh ek qabeele ko aur ek bakri ka doodh ek gharane ko kafi hoga. Phir ek pakeeza hawa chalegi jo musalmanon ki baghlon tale se nikal jayegi aur un ki rooh qabz ho jayegi, phir roo-e-zameen par badtareen shareer log baqi reh jayenge jo gadhon ki tarah koodte honge, inhi par Qayamat qaim hogi. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan kehte hain. 003 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ek bichhu ne kaat khaya tha toh aap apni ungli par patti bandhe hue khutbe ke liye khade hue aur farmaya tum kehte ho ab dushman nahin hain lekin tum toh dushmanon se jihad karte hi rahoge yahan tak ke Ya'juj Ma'juj aayen, woh chaude chehre wale chhoti aankhon wale, un ke chehre teh-ba-teh dhalon jaise honge. 004 Yeh riwayat Surah A'raf ki tafsir ke aakhir mein bayan kar di gayi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Mi'raj wali raat mein Ibrahim, Musa aur Isa (Alaihimas Salam) se roz-e-Qayamat ka muzakra shuru hua. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne us ke ilm se inkar kar diya, isi tarah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne bhi, han Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne farmaya us ke waqay hone ke waqt toh bajuz Allah ke koi nahin janta, han mujh se mere Allah ne yeh toh farmaya hai ke Dajjal nikalne wala hai. Us ke saath do tehniyan hongi. Woh mujhe dekhte hi seesay ki tarah pighalne lagega yahan tak ke Allah use halak kar de jab ke woh mujhe dekhe, yahan tak ke patthar aur darakht bhi pukar uthenge ke aye Muslim! Yeh hai mere saye tale kafir, aa aur ise qatl kar. Pas Allah unhein halak karega aur log apne shehron aur watanon ki taraf laut jayenge.

Us waqt Yajuj Majuj niklenge jo har unchai se phudakte aayenge, jo payenge tabah kar denge, pani jitna payenge pee jayenge. Log phir tang aakar apne watanon mein mahsur ho kar baith jayenge, shikayat karenge to main phir Allah se dua karunga, Allah unhein gharat kar de, sari zameen par unki badbu phail jayegi. Phir barish barsegi aur pani ka bahao unke sade hue jismon ko ghasit kar darya-burd kar dega. Mere Rab ne mujh se farma diya hai ke jab yeh sab kuch zuhoor mein aa jayega phir to Qayamat ka hona aisa hi hai jaise poore dinon mein hamal wali aurat ka waza hona ke ghar walon ko fikr hoti hai ke subah bacha hua ya sham hua, din ko hua ya raat ko hua. (Ibn Majah). Is ki tasdeeq Kalam-e-Allah Sharif ki aayat mein maujood hai, is bare mein hadeesein bakasrat hain aur aasar-e-salaf bhi bahut hain. Ka'ab (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Yajuj Majuj ke nikalne ke waqt woh deewar ko khodenge yahan tak ke un ki kudalon ki aawaz paas wale bhi sunenge. Raat ho jayegi, un mein se ek kahega ke ab subah aate hi ise tod dalenge aur nikal khade honge. Subah yeh aayenge to jaisi kal thi waisi hi aaj bhi payenge. Al-garaz yunhi hota rahega yahan tak ke un ka nikalna jab manzoor hoga to ek shakhs ki zaban se niklega ke hum kal Insha'Allah aise tod denge. Ab jo aayenge to jaisi chhod gaye the waisi hi payenge, to khod kar todenge aur bahar nikal aayenge. Un ka pehla giroh Bahira ke paas se niklega, sara pani pee jayega, dusra aayega keechad bhi chaat jayega, teesra aayega to kahega shayad yahan kabhi pani hoga? Log un se bhag bhag kar idhar udhar chhup jayenge, jab unhein koi bhi nazar na padega to yeh apne teer aasman ki taraf phenkenge, wahan se woh khoon-aalood wapas aayenge to yeh fakhr karenge ke hum zameen walon par aur aasman walon par ghalib aa gaye.

Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) un ke liye bad-dua karenge ke Allah hum mein un ke muqable ki taqat nahin aur zameen par hamara chalna phirna bhi zaroori hai to hamein jis tariqe se chahe un se nijat de to Allah un ko ta'oon mein mubtala karega, giltiyan nikal aayengi aur saare ke saare mar jayenge. Phir ek qisam ke parind aayenge jo apni chonch mein unhein lekar samundar mein phenk aayenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala nahr-e-hayat jaari kar dega jo zameen ko dhokar paak saaf kar degi aur zameen apni barkatein nikal degi, ek anaar ek gharane ko kaafi hoga. Achanak ek shakhs aayega aur nida karega ke Zul-Suwaiqatain nikal aaya hai. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) saat aath sau lashkariyon ka talaya bhejenge, yeh abhi raaste mein hi honge ke Yamani paak hawa nihayat latafat se chalegi jo tamam mominon ki rooh qabz kar jayegi. Phir to roo-e-zameen par raddi khaddi log reh jayenge jo chopayon jaise honge, un par Qayamat qaim hogi. Us waqt Qayamat is qadar qareeb hogi jaise poori dinon ki ghodi jo janne ke qareeb ho aur ghodi wala us ke aas paas ghoom raha ho ke kab bacha ho. Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) yeh bayan farma kar farmane lage ab jo shakhs mere is qaul aur is ilm ke baad bhi kuch kahe us ne takalluf kiya. Ka'ab (R.H) ka yeh waqia bayan karna behtareen waqia hai kyunke is ki shahadat sahih hadith mein bhi payi jaati hai. Ahadith mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) us zamane mein Baitullah Sharif ka hajj bhi karenge, chunancha Musnad Imam Ahmad mein yeh hadith marfoo'an marwi hai ke aap Yajooj Majooj ke khurooj ke baad yaqeenan Baitullah ka hajj karenge. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein bhi hai. Jab yeh holnakiyan, jab yeh zalzale, jab yeh balayein aur aafaat aa jayengi to us waqt Qayamat bilkul qareeb aa jayegi, ise dekh kar kafir kehne lagenge yeh nihayat sakht din hai, un ki aankhein phat jayengi aur kehne lagenge haye hum to ghaflat mein hi rahe, haye hum ne apna aap bigada. Gunahon ka iqrar aur us par sharmsaar honge lekin ab besood hai.

Log phir tang aakar apne watanon mein mahsur ho kar baith jayenge, shikayat karenge to main phir Allah se dua karunga, Allah unhein gharat kar de, sari zameen par unki badbu phail jayegi. Phir barish barsegi aur pani ka bahao unke sade hue jismon ko ghasit kar darya-burd kar dega. Mere Rab ne mujh se farma diya hai ke jab yeh sab kuch zuhoor mein aa jayega phir to Qayamat ka hona aisa hi hai jaise poore dinon mein hamal wali aurat ka waza hona ke ghar walon ko fikr hoti hai ke subah bacha hua ya sham hua, din ko hua ya raat ko hua. (Ibn Majah). Is ki tasdeeq Kalam-e-Allah Sharif ki aayat mein maujood hai, is bare mein hadeesein bakasrat hain aur aasar-e-salaf bhi bahut hain. Ka'ab (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Yajuj Majuj ke nikalne ke waqt woh deewar ko khodenge yahan tak ke un ki kudalon ki aawaz paas wale bhi sunenge. Raat ho jayegi, un mein se ek kahega ke ab subah aate hi ise tod dalenge aur nikal khade honge. Subah yeh aayenge to jaisi kal thi waisi hi aaj bhi payenge. Al-garaz yunhi hota rahega yahan tak ke un ka nikalna jab manzoor hoga to ek shakhs ki zaban se niklega ke hum kal Insha'Allah aise tod denge. Ab jo aayenge to jaisi chhod gaye the waisi hi payenge, to khod kar todenge aur bahar nikal aayenge. Un ka pehla giroh Bahira ke paas se niklega, sara pani pee jayega, dusra aayega keechad bhi chaat jayega, teesra aayega to kahega shayad yahan kabhi pani hoga? Log un se bhag bhag kar idhar udhar chhup jayenge, jab unhein koi bhi nazar na padega to yeh apne teer aasman ki taraf phenkenge, wahan se woh khoon-aalood wapas aayenge to yeh fakhr karenge ke hum zameen walon par aur aasman walon par ghalib aa gaye.

Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) un ke liye bad-dua karenge ke Allah hum mein un ke muqable ki taqat nahin aur zameen par hamara chalna phirna bhi zaroori hai to hamein jis tariqe se chahe un se nijat de to Allah un ko ta'oon mein mubtala karega, giltiyan nikal aayengi aur saare ke saare mar jayenge. Phir ek qisam ke parind aayenge jo apni chonch mein unhein lekar samundar mein phenk aayenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala nahr-e-hayat jaari kar dega jo zameen ko dhokar paak saaf kar degi aur zameen apni barkatein nikal degi, ek anaar ek gharane ko kaafi hoga. Achanak ek shakhs aayega aur nida karega ke Zul-Suwaiqatain nikal aaya hai. Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) saat aath sau lashkariyon ka talaya bhejenge, yeh abhi raaste mein hi honge ke Yamani paak hawa nihayat latafat se chalegi jo tamam mominon ki rooh qabz kar jayegi. Phir to roo-e-zameen par raddi khaddi log reh jayenge jo chopayon jaise honge, un par Qayamat qaim hogi. Us waqt Qayamat is qadar qareeb hogi jaise poori dinon ki ghodi jo janne ke qareeb ho aur ghodi wala us ke aas paas ghoom raha ho ke kab bacha ho. Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) yeh bayan farma kar farmane lage ab jo shakhs mere is qaul aur is ilm ke baad bhi kuch kahe us ne takalluf kiya. Ka'ab (R.H) ka yeh waqia bayan karna behtareen waqia hai kyunke is ki shahadat sahih hadith mein bhi payi jaati hai. Ahadith mein yeh bhi aaya hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) us zamane mein Baitullah Sharif ka hajj bhi karenge, chunancha Musnad Imam Ahmad mein yeh hadith marfoo'an marwi hai ke aap Yajooj Majooj ke khurooj ke baad yaqeenan Baitullah ka hajj karenge. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein bhi hai. Jab yeh holnakiyan, jab yeh zalzale, jab yeh balayein aur aafaat aa jayengi to us waqt Qayamat bilkul qareeb aa jayegi, ise dekh kar kafir kehne lagenge yeh nihayat sakht din hai, un ki aankhein phat jayengi aur kehne lagenge haye hum to ghaflat mein hi rahe, haye hum ne apna aap bigada. Gunahon ka iqrar aur us par sharmsaar honge lekin ab besood hai.

Yafis ki aulad halak shuda logon ka duniya ki taraf phir palatna mahal hai. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke un ki tauba maqbool nahin. Lekin pehla qaul aula hai. Yajooj Majooj nasl-e-Adam se hain. Balkeh woh Hazrat Nuh A.S ke ladke Yafis ki aulad mein se hain jin ki nasl Turk hain yeh bhi inhi ka ek giroh hai yeh Zulqarnain ki banai hui deewar se bahar hi chhor diye gaye thay. Aap ne deewar bana kar farmaya tha ke yeh mere Rab ki rahmat hai. Allah ke wade ke waqt is ka choora choora ho jayega mere Rab ka wada haq hai al-kh. Yajooj Majooj qurb-e-qayamat ke waqt wahan se nikal aayenge aur zameen mein fasad macha denge. Har oonchi jagah ko Arabi mein hadab kehte hain. Un ke nikalne ke waqt un ki yahi halat hogi to is khabar ko is tarah bayan kiya jaise sunne wala apni aankhon se dekh raha hai aur waqia mein Allah Ta'ala se zyada sachi khabar kis ki hogi? Jo ghaib aur hazir ka janne wala hai. Ho chuki hui aur hone wali baton se aagah hai. Ibn Abbas R.A ne ladkon ko uchalte koodte khelte daudte ek dusron ki chutkiyan bharte hue dekh kar farmaya isi tarah Yajooj Majooj aayenge. Bahut si ahadees mein un ke nikalne ka zikr hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Yajooj Majooj khole jayenge aur woh logon ke paas pahunchenge jaise Allah Azzawajal ka farman hai aayat (وَهُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنْسِلُوْنَ) (Al-Anbiya: 96) woh chha jayenge aur musalman apne shahron aur qilon mein simat aayenge apne janwaron ko bhi wahi le lenge aur apna pani unhein pilate rahenge Yajooj Majooj jis nehar se guzrenge us ka pani safa chat kar jayenge yahan tak ke us mein khaak udne lage gi un ki dusri jamaat jab wahan pahunche gi to woh kahe gi shayad is mein kisi zamane mein pani hoga. Jab yeh dekhenge ke ab zameen par koi na raha aur waqia mein siwaye un musalmanon ke jo apne shahron aur qilon mein panah guzeen honge koi aur wahan hoga bhi nahin to yeh kahenge ke ab zameen walon se tum hum farigh ho gaye aao aasman walon ki khabar lein. Chunancha un mein se ek shareer apna neza ghuma kar aasman ki taraf phenke ga qudrat-e-ilahi se woh khoon alood ho kar un ke paas gire ga yeh bhi ek qudrati aazmaish hogi ab un ki gardanon mein guthli ho jayegi aur isi waba mein yeh saare ke saare ek sath ek dam mar jayenge ek bhi baqi na rahe ga sara shor-o-ghul khatam ho jayega musalman kahenge koi hai jo apni jaan hum musalmanon ke liye hatheli par rakh kar shahar ke bahar jaye aur in dushmanon ko dekhe ke kis haal mein hain? Chunancha ek sahib is ke liye tayyar ho jayenge aur apne aap ko qatl shuda samajh kar Allah ki rah mein musalmanon ki khidmat ke liye nikal khade honge dekhenge ke sab ka dher lag raha hai saare halak shuda pade hue hain yeh isi waqt nida kare ga ke musalmano!

Khush ho jao Allah ne khud tumhare dushmanon ko gharat kardiya yeh dher para hua hai ab musalman bahar aayenge aur apne maweshiyon ko bhi layenge un ke liye chara bajuz un ke gosht ke aur kuch na hoga yeh un ka gosht kha kha kar khoob mote taze hojayenge. 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek din subh hi subh Dajjal ka zikr kiya is tarah ke hum samjhe shayad woh un darakhton ki aar mein hai aur ab nikla hi chahta hai aap farmane lage mujhe Dajjal se zyada khauf tum par aur cheez ka hai. Agar Dajjal meri maujoodgi mein nikla to main khud nimat lunga tum mein se har shakhs us se bache. Main tumhein Allah ki aman mein de raha hoon. Woh jawan umr uljhe hue baalon wala kana aur ubhri hui aankh wala hai. Woh Sham aur Iraq ke darmiyan se niklega aur dayen bayen ghoomega. Aye bandagan-e-Ilahi tum sabit qadam rehna. Hum ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh kitna thehre ga? Aap ne farmaya chalees din. Ek din misl ek baras ke, ek din misl ek mahine ke, ek din misl ek jumah ke aur baqi din mamooli dinon jaise. Hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo din saal bhar ke barabar hoga us mein hamein yehi panch namazein kafi hongi? Aap ne farmaya nahin tum apne andaze se waqt par namaz parhte raha karna. Hum ne daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ki raftar kaisi hogi? Farmaya jaise badal ke hawa unhein idhar se udhar bhagaye liye jati ho. Ek qabeelay ke paas jayega unhein apni taraf bulayega woh us ki maan lenge. Aasman ko hukm dega ke un par barish barsaye, zameen se kahega ke un ke liye paidawar ugaye, un ke janwar un ke paas mote taze bhare pet lautenge. Ek qabeelay ke paas apne tayin manwana chahega woh inkar kardenge yeh wahan se niklega to un ke tamam maal us ke peeche lag jayenge woh bilkul khali hath reh jayenge, woh ghair-abad jangalon mein jayega aur zameen se kahega apne khazane ugal de woh ugal degi aur saare khazane us ke peeche aise chalenge jaise shehad ki makkhiyan apne sardar ke peeche. Yeh bhi dikhayega ke ek shakhs ko talwar se theek do tukray karade ga aur idhar udhar door daraz phenkwa dega phir us ka naam le kar awaz dega to woh zinda chalta phirta us ke paas aajayega yeh isi haal mein hoga jo Allah Azzawajal Hazrat Maseeh Ibn-e-Maryam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko utarega aap Damishq ki mashriqi taraf safed minaray ke paas utrenge apne dono hath do farishton ke paron par rakhe hue honge aap us ka peecha karenge aur mashriqi baab ke Lud ke paas use pa kar qatl kardenge phir Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki taraf Allah ki wahi aayegi main apne aise bandon ko bhejta hoon jin se larne ki tum mein taab-o-taqat nahin mere bandon ko Toor ki taraf samet le ja.

Phir Janab-e-Bari Ya'juj Ma'juj ko bhejega jaise farmaya aayat (Wa hum min kulli hadabin yansilun). Un se tang aakar Hazrat Isa (A.S) aur aap ke saathi Janab-e-Bari mein dua karenge toh Allah Ta'ala un par guthli ki bimari bhejega jo un ki gardan mein niklegi, saare ke saare upar tale ek saath hi mar jayenge. Tab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ma'a momino ke aayenge. Dekhenge ke tamam zameen un ki lashon se pati padi hai aur un ki badbu se khada nahin hua jata. Aap phir Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge toh Allah Ta'ala bakhti unton ki gardanon jaise parind bhejega jo unhein Allah jaane kahan phenk aayenge? Ka'ab (R.H) kehte hain Mahil mein yani suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah mein unhein phenk aayenge. Phir chalis din tak tamam zameen mein musalsal barish barsegi, zameen dhul dhula kar hatheli ki tarah saaf ho jayegi phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi apni barkatein uga degi. Us din ek jama'at ki jama'at ek anaar se sair ho jayegi aur us ke chhalke tale saya hasil kar legi, ek untni ka doodh logon ki ek jama'at ko aur ek gaye ka doodh ek qabeele ko aur ek bakri ka doodh ek gharane ko kafi hoga. Phir ek pakeeza hawa chalegi jo musalmanon ki baghlon tale se nikal jayegi aur un ki rooh qabz ho jayegi, phir roo-e-zameen par badtareen shareer log baqi reh jayenge jo gadhon ki tarah koodte honge, inhi par Qayamat qaim hogi. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan kehte hain. 003 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ek bichhu ne kaat khaya tha toh aap apni ungli par patti bandhe hue khutbe ke liye khade hue aur farmaya tum kehte ho ab dushman nahin hain lekin tum toh dushmanon se jihad karte hi rahoge yahan tak ke Ya'juj Ma'juj aayen, woh chaude chehre wale chhoti aankhon wale, un ke chehre teh-ba-teh dhalon jaise honge. 004 Yeh riwayat Surah A'raf ki tafsir ke aakhir mein bayan kar di gayi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Mi'raj wali raat mein Ibrahim, Musa aur Isa (Alaihimas Salam) se roz-e-Qayamat ka muzakra shuru hua. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne us ke ilm se inkar kar diya, isi tarah Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne bhi, han Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne farmaya us ke waqay hone ke waqt toh bajuz Allah ke koi nahin janta, han mujh se mere Allah ne yeh toh farmaya hai ke Dajjal nikalne wala hai. Us ke saath do tehniyan hongi. Woh mujhe dekhte hi seesay ki tarah pighalne lagega yahan tak ke Allah use halak kar de jab ke woh mujhe dekhe, yahan tak ke patthar aur darakht bhi pukar uthenge ke aye Muslim! Yeh hai mere saye tale kafir, aa aur ise qatl kar. Pas Allah unhein halak karega aur log apne shehron aur watanon ki taraf laut jayenge.

Jahanum ki haolnakiyan: But-paraston se Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum aur tumhare but Jahanum ki aag ki lakdiyan banoge jaisi farmaan hai aayat (Woquduha-n-nasu wal-hijarah), is ka indhan insan hain aur patthar. Habshi zaban mein hatab ko hasab kehte hain yaani lakdiyan. Balki ek qirat mein bajaye hasab ke hatab hai. Tum sab aabid-o-mabood jahannami ho aur woh bhi hamesha ke liye. Agar yeh sachche mabood hote kyun aag mein jalte? Yahan to parastar aur parastish kiye jane wale sab abdi taur par dozakhi ho gaye. Woh ulti saans mein cheekhenge jaise farmaan hai aayat (Fa amma-l-lazina shaqu fa fin-nari lahum fiha zafirunw wa shahiq) (Surah (Hud: 106), woh seedhi ulti saansoon se cheekhenge aur cheekhon ke sawa un ke kaan mein aur koi awaaz na padegi. 

Hadrat Ibn Masood (Raji Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai ke jab sirf mushrik Jahanum mein reh jayenge unhein aag ke sandooqon mein qaid kar diya jayega jin mein aag ke sariye honge, un mein se har ek ko yehi guman hoga ke Jahanum mein is ke sawa aur koi nahi. Phir Aap ne yehi aayat tilawat farmai (Ibn Jarir). 

Husna se murad rahmat-o-saadahat hain. Dozakhiyon ka aur un ke azabon ka zikr kar ke ab naik logon aur un ki jazaoon ka zikr ho raha hai, yeh log ba-iman the un ke naik aamal ki wajah se saadahat un ke istiqbaal ko taiyar thi jaise farmaan hai aayat (Lil-lazina ahsanu-l-husna wa ziyadatuw wa la yarhaqu wujuho-hum qatarunw wa la zillatun ulaika ashabu-l-jannah, hum fiha khalidoon) (Surah (Yunus: 26). Nekon ke liye naik ajr hai aur ziyadati ajr bhi. Farmaan hai aayat (Hal jaza-u-l-ihsani illa-l-ihsan) (Surah (Ar-Rahman: 60), neki ka badla neki hi hai. 

Un ke duniya ke aamal naik the to aakhirat mein sawab aur naik badla mila, azab se bache aur rahmat-e-Rabb se sarfaraz hue. Yeh Jahanum se door kar diye gaye ke is ki aahat tak nahi sunte, na dozakhiyon ka jalna woh sunte hain. Pul-e-Sirat par dozakhiyon ko zehreelay naag daste hain aur yeh wahan haye haye karte hain, jannati logon ke kaan bhi is dard-nak awaaz se na-aashna rahenge. Itna hi nahi ke khauf-o-dar se yeh alag ho gaye balki sath hi rahat-o-aram bhi hasil kar liya. Man-maani cheezein maujood, dawami ki rahat bhi hazir. 

Hadrat Ali (Raji Allahu Anhu) ne ek raat is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya: "Main aur Umar, Usman aur Zubair aur Talha aur Abdur-Rahman inhi logon mein se hain" ya Hadrat Sa'd ka naam liya (Raji Allahu Anhu). Itne mein namaz ki takbeer hui to Aap chadar gheestte aayat (Wa hum la yasma'oona hasiseha) padhte hue uth khare ho gaye. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya Hadrat Usman (Raji Allahu Anhu) aur un ke sathi aise hi hain. 

Ibn Abbas (Raji Allahu Anhu) farmate hain: Yehi log Awliyaullah hain, bijli se bhi zyada tezi ke sath Pul-e-Sirat se paar ho jayenge aur kafir wahin ghutnon ke bal gir padenge.

Ba'az kehte hain is se murad woh buzurgane deen hain jo Allah wale thay shirk se bezaar thay lekin un ke baad logon ne un ki marzi ke khilaf un ki puja paat shuru kardi thi, Hazrat Uzair, Hazrat Masih, farishtay, sooraj, chand, Hazrat Maryam, waghera. Abdullah bin Zub'ari An-Haprat ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kehne laga tera khayal hai ke Allah ne ayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun 98) (Al-Anbiya: 98) utari hai? Agar yeh sach hai toh kya sooraj chand, farishtay Uzair, Isa, sab ke sab hamare buton ke sath jahannam mein jayenge? Is ke jawab mein ayat (Wa lamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan iza qawmuka minhu yasiddun 57) (Az-Zukhruf: 57) aur ayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ulaika ‘anha mub'adun) (Al-Anbiya: 101) nazil hui. Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ek din Walid bin Mughira ke sath masjid mein baithe hue thay ke Nazr bin Harith aaya us waqt masjid mein aur Quraysh bhi bohat sare thay Nazr bin Harith Rasool Allah ﷺ se baatein kar raha tha lekin woh lajawab hogya Aap ne ayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun 98) (Al-Anbiya: 98) tilawat farmai. Jab Aap us majlis se chale gaye toh Abdullah bin Zub'ari aaya logon ne us se kaha aaj Nazr bin Harith ne baatein keen lekin buri tarah maat khayi aur Hazrat yeh farmate hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar mein hota toh unhe jawab deta ke hum farishton ko poojte hain Yahood Uzair ko Nasrani Masih ko toh kya yeh sab bhi jahannam mein jalenge? Sab ko yeh jawab bohat pasand aaya jab Huzoor ﷺ se is ka zikr aaya toh Aap ne farmaya jis ne apni ibadat karai woh abidon ke sath jahannam mein hai yeh buzurg apni ibadatein nahi karate thay balki yeh log toh unhe nahi shaitan ko pooj rahe hain usi ne unhe un ki ibadat ki rah batai hai. Aap ke jawab ke sath hi Qurani jawab is ke baad hi ayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat) mein utra toh jin nek logon ki jahilon ne parastish ki thi woh is se mustasna hogaye. Chunacha Quran mein hai ayat (Wa man yaqul minhum inni ilahun min dunihil fa zalika najzihi jahannama - ilkh) yaani un mein se jo apni mabudiyat auron se manwani chahe us ka badla jahannam hai hum zalimon ko usi tarah saza dete hain aur ayat (Wa lamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan iza qawmuka minhu yasiddun 57) (Az-Zukhruf: 57) utri ke is baat ke sunte hi woh log mutaajjib hogaye aur kehne lage hamare mabood ache ya woh yeh toh sirf jhagda hai aur yeh log jhagralu hi hain woh hamara inaam yafta banda tha use hum ne Bani Israel ke liye namuna banaya tha. Agar hum chahte toh tumhare janasheen farishton ko kar dete Hazrat Isa nishan-e-qiyamat hain un ke hath se jo mojizat sadir hue woh shubah wali cheezein nahi woh qiyamat ki daleel hain tujhe is mein kuch shak na karna chahiye.

Meri manta chala ja yahi sirat-e-mustaqim hai. Ibn-e-Zab'ari ki jurrat dekhiye, khitab ahl-e-Makkah se hai aur un ki un tasweeron aur patharon ke liye kaha gaya hai jinhein woh siwae Allah ke pooja karte thay, nah ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) waghera pak nafs ke liye jo ghair Allah ki ibadat se rokte thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (Rahimahullah) farmate hain laafz 'ma' jo yahan hai woh Arab mein un ke liye aata hai jo be-jaan aur be-aql hon. Yeh Ibn-e-Zab'ari is ke baad musalman ho gaye thay (Razi Allahu Anhu), yeh bare mashhoor shayar thay. Pehle unhon ne musalmanon ki dil khol kar dhaul urai thi lekin musalman hone ke baad mazrat ki. Maut ki ghabrahat, us ghari ki ghabrahat jabke jahannam par dhakkan dhak diya jaye ga, jab ke maut ko dozakh-o-jannat ke darmiyan zibah kar diya jaye ga. Gharz kisi andishe ka nuzool un par na hoga, woh har gham-o-hiraas se door honge, poore masroor honge, khush honge aur na-khushi se koson alag honge. Farishton ke pare ke pare un se mulaqatein kar rahe honge aur unhein dharas dete hue kehte honge ke isi din ka wada tum se kiya gaya tha, us waqt tum qabron se uthne ke din ke muntazir raho.)))

Jahanum ki haolnakiyan: But-paraston se Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum aur tumhare but Jahanum ki aag ki lakdiyan banoge jaisi farmaan hai aayat (Woquduha-n-nasu wal-hijarah), is ka indhan insan hain aur patthar. Habshi zaban mein hatab ko hasab kehte hain yaani lakdiyan. Balki ek qirat mein bajaye hasab ke hatab hai. Tum sab aabid-o-mabood jahannami ho aur woh bhi hamesha ke liye. Agar yeh sachche mabood hote kyun aag mein jalte? Yahan to parastar aur parastish kiye jane wale sab abdi taur par dozakhi ho gaye. Woh ulti saans mein cheekhenge jaise farmaan hai aayat (Fa amma-l-lazina shaqu fa fin-nari lahum fiha zafirunw wa shahiq) (Surah (Hud: 106), woh seedhi ulti saansoon se cheekhenge aur cheekhon ke sawa un ke kaan mein aur koi awaaz na padegi. 

Hadrat Ibn Masood (Raji Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai ke jab sirf mushrik Jahanum mein reh jayenge unhein aag ke sandooqon mein qaid kar diya jayega jin mein aag ke sariye honge, un mein se har ek ko yehi guman hoga ke Jahanum mein is ke sawa aur koi nahi. Phir Aap ne yehi aayat tilawat farmai (Ibn Jarir). 

Husna se murad rahmat-o-saadahat hain. Dozakhiyon ka aur un ke azabon ka zikr kar ke ab naik logon aur un ki jazaoon ka zikr ho raha hai, yeh log ba-iman the un ke naik aamal ki wajah se saadahat un ke istiqbaal ko taiyar thi jaise farmaan hai aayat (Lil-lazina ahsanu-l-husna wa ziyadatuw wa la yarhaqu wujuho-hum qatarunw wa la zillatun ulaika ashabu-l-jannah, hum fiha khalidoon) (Surah (Yunus: 26). Nekon ke liye naik ajr hai aur ziyadati ajr bhi. Farmaan hai aayat (Hal jaza-u-l-ihsani illa-l-ihsan) (Surah (Ar-Rahman: 60), neki ka badla neki hi hai. 

Un ke duniya ke aamal naik the to aakhirat mein sawab aur naik badla mila, azab se bache aur rahmat-e-Rabb se sarfaraz hue. Yeh Jahanum se door kar diye gaye ke is ki aahat tak nahi sunte, na dozakhiyon ka jalna woh sunte hain. Pul-e-Sirat par dozakhiyon ko zehreelay naag daste hain aur yeh wahan haye haye karte hain, jannati logon ke kaan bhi is dard-nak awaaz se na-aashna rahenge. Itna hi nahi ke khauf-o-dar se yeh alag ho gaye balki sath hi rahat-o-aram bhi hasil kar liya. Man-maani cheezein maujood, dawami ki rahat bhi hazir. 

Hadrat Ali (Raji Allahu Anhu) ne ek raat is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya: "Main aur Umar, Usman aur Zubair aur Talha aur Abdur-Rahman inhi logon mein se hain" ya Hadrat Sa'd ka naam liya (Raji Allahu Anhu). Itne mein namaz ki takbeer hui to Aap chadar gheestte aayat (Wa hum la yasma'oona hasiseha) padhte hue uth khare ho gaye. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya Hadrat Usman (Raji Allahu Anhu) aur un ke sathi aise hi hain. 

Ibn Abbas (Raji Allahu Anhu) farmate hain: Yehi log Awliyaullah hain, bijli se bhi zyada tezi ke sath Pul-e-Sirat se paar ho jayenge aur kafir wahin ghutnon ke bal gir padenge.

Ba'az kehte hain is se murad woh buzurgane deen hain jo Allah wale thay shirk se bezaar thay lekin un ke baad logon ne un ki marzi ke khilaf un ki puja paat shuru kardi thi, Hazrat Uzair, Hazrat Masih, farishtay, sooraj, chand, Hazrat Maryam, waghera. Is ke jawab mein ayat (Wa lamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan iza qawmuka minhu yasiddun 57) (Az-Zukhruf: 57) aur ayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ulaika ‘anha mub'adun) (Al-Anbiya: 101) nazil hui. Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ek din Walid bin Mughira ke sath masjid mein baithe hue thay ke Nazr bin Harith aaya us waqt masjid mein aur Quraysh bhi bohat sare thay Nazr bin Harith Rasool Allah ﷺ se baatein kar raha tha lekin woh lajawab hogya Aap ne ayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun 98) (Al-Anbiya: 98) tilawat farmai. Jab Aap us majlis se chale gaye toh Abdullah bin Zub'ari aaya logon ne us se kaha aaj Nazr bin Harith ne baatein keen lekin buri tarah maat khayi aur Hazrat yeh farmate hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar mein hota toh unhe jawab deta ke hum farishton ko poojte hain Yahood Uzair ko Nasrani Masih ko toh kya yeh sab bhi jahannam mein jalenge? Sab ko yeh jawab bohat pasand aaya jab Huzoor ﷺ se is ka zikr aaya toh Aap ne farmaya jis ne apni ibadat karai woh abidon ke sath jahannam mein hai yeh buzurg apni ibadatein nahi karate thay balki yeh log toh unhe nahi shaitan ko pooj rahe hain usi ne unhe un ki ibadat ki rah batai hai. Aap ke jawab ke sath hi Qurani jawab is ke baad hi ayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat) mein utra toh jin nek logon ki jahilon ne parastish ki thi woh is se mustasna hogaye. Chunacha Quran mein hai ayat (Wa man yaqul minhum inni ilahun min dunihil fa zalika najzihi jahannama - ilkh) yaani un mein se jo apni mabudiyat auron se manwani chahe us ka badla jahannam hai hum zalimon ko usi tarah saza dete hain aur ayat (Wa lamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan iza qawmuka minhu yasiddun 57) (Az-Zukhruf: 57) utri ke is baat ke sunte hi woh log mutaajjib hogaye aur kehne lage hamare mabood ache ya woh yeh toh sirf jhagda hai aur yeh log jhagralu hi hain woh hamara inaam yafta banda tha use hum ne Bani Israel ke liye namuna banaya tha. Agar hum chahte toh tumhare janasheen farishton ko kar dete Hazrat Isa nishan-e-qiyamat hain un ke hath se jo mojizat sadir hue woh shubah wali cheezein nahi woh qiyamat ki daleel hain tujhe is mein kuch shak na karna chahiye.

Meri manta chala ja yahi sirat-e-mustaqim hai. Ibn-e-Zab'ari ki jurrat dekhiye, khitab ahl-e-Makkah se hai aur un ki un tasweeron aur patharon ke liye kaha gaya hai jinhein woh siwae Allah ke pooja karte thay, nah ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) waghera pak nafs ke liye jo ghair Allah ki ibadat se rokte thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (Rahimahullah) farmate hain laafz 'ma' jo yahan hai woh Arab mein un ke liye aata hai jo be-jaan aur be-aql hon. Yeh Ibn-e-Zab'ari is ke baad musalman ho gaye thay (Razi Allahu Anhu), yeh bare mashhoor shayar thay. Pehle unhon ne musalmanon ki dil khol kar dhaul urai thi lekin musalman hone ke baad mazrat ki. Maut ki ghabrahat, us ghari ki ghabrahat jabke jahannam par dhakkan dhak diya jaye ga, jab ke maut ko dozakh-o-jannat ke darmiyan zibah kar diya jaye ga. Gharz kisi andishe ka nuzool un par na hoga, woh har gham-o-hiraas se door honge, poore masroor honge, khush honge aur na-khushi se koson alag honge. Farishton ke pare ke pare un se mulaqatein kar rahe honge aur unhein dharas dete hue kehte honge ke isi din ka wada tum se kiya gaya tha, us waqt tum qabron se uthne ke din ke muntazir raho.)))

Jahanum ki haolnakiyan: But-paraston se Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum aur tumhare but Jahanum ki aag ki lakdiyan banoge jaisi farmaan hai aayat (Woquduha-n-nasu wal-hijarah), is ka indhan insan hain aur patthar. Habshi zaban mein hatab ko hasab kehte hain yaani lakdiyan. Balki ek qirat mein bajaye hasab ke hatab hai. Tum sab aabid-o-mabood jahannami ho aur woh bhi hamesha ke liye. Agar yeh sachche mabood hote kyun aag mein jalte? Yahan to parastar aur parastish kiye jane wale sab abdi taur par dozakhi ho gaye. Woh ulti saans mein cheekhenge jaise farmaan hai aayat (Fa amma-l-lazina shaqu fa fin-nari lahum fiha zafirunw wa shahiq) (Surah (Hud: 106), woh seedhi ulti saansoon se cheekhenge aur cheekhon ke sawa un ke kaan mein aur koi awaaz na padegi. 

Hadrat Ibn Masood (Raji Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai ke jab sirf mushrik Jahanum mein reh jayenge unhein aag ke sandooqon mein qaid kar diya jayega jin mein aag ke sariye honge, un mein se har ek ko yehi guman hoga ke Jahanum mein is ke sawa aur koi nahi. Phir Aap ne yehi aayat tilawat farmai (Ibn Jarir). 

Husna se murad rahmat-o-saadahat hain. Dozakhiyon ka aur un ke azabon ka zikr kar ke ab naik logon aur un ki jazaoon ka zikr ho raha hai, yeh log ba-iman the un ke naik aamal ki wajah se saadahat un ke istiqbaal ko taiyar thi jaise farmaan hai aayat (Lil-lazina ahsanu-l-husna wa ziyadatuw wa la yarhaqu wujuho-hum qatarunw wa la zillatun ulaika ashabu-l-jannah, hum fiha khalidoon) (Surah (Yunus: 26). Nekon ke liye naik ajr hai aur ziyadati ajr bhi. Farmaan hai aayat (Hal jaza-u-l-ihsani illa-l-ihsan) (Surah (Ar-Rahman: 60), neki ka badla neki hi hai. 

Un ke duniya ke aamal naik the to aakhirat mein sawab aur naik badla mila, azab se bache aur rahmat-e-Rabb se sarfaraz hue. Yeh Jahanum se door kar diye gaye ke is ki aahat tak nahi sunte, na dozakhiyon ka jalna woh sunte hain. Pul-e-Sirat par dozakhiyon ko zehreelay naag daste hain aur yeh wahan haye haye karte hain, jannati logon ke kaan bhi is dard-nak awaaz se na-aashna rahenge. Itna hi nahi ke khauf-o-dar se yeh alag ho gaye balki sath hi rahat-o-aram bhi hasil kar liya. Man-maani cheezein maujood, dawami ki rahat bhi hazir. 

Hadrat Ali (Raji Allahu Anhu) ne ek raat is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya: "Main aur Umar, Usman aur Zubair aur Talha aur Abdur-Rahman inhi logon mein se hain" ya Hadrat Sa'd ka naam liya (Raji Allahu Anhu). Itne mein namaz ki takbeer hui to Aap chadar gheestte aayat (Wa hum la yasma'oona hasiseha) padhte hue uth khare ho gaye. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya Hadrat Usman (Raji Allahu Anhu) aur un ke sathi aise hi hain. 

Ibn Abbas (Raji Allahu Anhu) farmate hain: Yehi log Awliyaullah hain, bijli se bhi zyada tezi ke sath Pul-e-Sirat se paar ho jayenge aur kafir wahin ghutnon ke bal gir padenge.

Allah Ta'ala ki mutthi mein tamam kainat yeh Roz-e-Qayamat ke din hoga jab hum aasman ko lapet lenge jaise farmaya ayat (Wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi al-ayah). In logon ne jaisi qadr Allah Ta'ala ki karni chahiye thi, jaana hi nahi. Tamam zameen Roz-e-Qayamat us ki mutthi mein hogi aur tamam aasman us ke dahine hath mein lapete hue honge. Woh pak aur bartar hai har cheez se jise log us ka shareek tehra rahe hain. Bukhari Sharif mein hai An-Hazrat ﷺ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala Roz-e-Qayamat zameeno ko mutthi mein le lega aur aasman us ke daayein hath mein honge. Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain satoin asmaano ko aur wahan ki kul makhlooq ko, satoin zameeno ko aur us ki kul kainat ko Allah Ta'ala apne dahine hath mein lapet lega woh us ke hath mein aise honge jaise raai ka dana. Sijil se murad kitab hai. Aur kaha gaya hai ke murad yahan ek farishta hai. Jab kisi ka istighfar chadhta hai toh woh kehta hai ise noor likh lo. Yeh farishta namah-e-aamal par muqarrar hai. Jab insan marjata hai toh us ki kitab ko aur kitabo ke sath lapet kar use Qayamat ke liye rakh deta hai. Kaha gaya hai ke yeh naam hai us sahabi ka jo Huzoor ﷺ ka katib-e-wahi tha. Lekin yeh riwayat sabit nahi aksar huffaz-e-hadith ne in sab ko mawzoo kaha hai khususan hamare ustad Hafiz Kabir Abul Hajjaj Mizzi Rahimahullah ne. Main ne is hadith ko ek alag kitab mein likha hai Imam Jafar bin Jarir ؒ ne bhi is hadith par bahut hi inkar kiya hai aur is ki khoob tardeed ki aur farmaya hai ke Sijil naam ka koi sahabi hai hi nahi. Huzoor ﷺ ke tamam katibo ke naam mashhoor-o-maroof hain kisi ka naam Sijil nahi. Fi al-waqi Imam Sahib ne sahih aur durust farmaya yeh badi wajah hai is hadith ke munkar hone ki. Balki yeh bhi yaad rahe ke jis ne is sahabi ka zikr kiya hai us ne isi hadith par etamad karke zikr kiya hai aur lughatan bhi yahi baat hai pas farman hai jis din hum aasman ko lapet lenge us tarah jaise likhi hui kitab lapeti jati hai. Lam yahan par ma'ani mein 'ala ke hai jaise taddahu lil-jabeen mein lam ma'ani mein 'ala hai. Lughat mein is ki aur nazeerin bhi hain. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh yaqinan ho kar rahega. Us din Allah Ta'ala naye sire se makhlooq ko pehle ki tarah paida karega. Jo ibtida par qadir tha woh a'adah par bhi us se ziyada qadir hai. Yeh Allah ka wada hai us ke wade atal hote hain, woh kabhi badalte nahi, na un mein tazad hota hai. Woh tamam cheezon par qadir hai woh use pura karke hi rahega. Huzoor ﷺ ne khade ho kar apne ek wa'z mein farmaya tum log Allah ke samne jama hone wale ho. Nange pair nange badan be-khatne jaise hum ne pehli bar paida kiya usi tarah dobara lautayenge yeh hamara wada hai jise hum pura karke rahenge. Al-Hadith (Bukhari). Sab cheezein nest-o-nabood ho jayengi phir banayi jayengi.

Sacha faisla Allah Ta'ala apne bando ko jis tarah akhirat mein dega usi tarah duniya mein bhi unhe mulk-o-maal deta hai, yeh Allah ka hatmi wada aur sacha faisla hai. Jaise farman ayat (Innal-arda lillahi yurisuhu man yashau min ibadihi wal-'aqibatu lil-muttaqin) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 128) zameen Allah ki hai jise chahta hai iska varis banata hai, anjam-kar parhezgaron ka hissa hai. Aur farman hai hum apne rusoolon ki aur aimandaron ki duniya mein aur akhirat mein madad farmate hain aur farman hai ke tum mein se iman daron aur naik logon se Allah ka wada hai ke woh unhe zameen mein ghalib banayega jaise ke unse aglon ko banaya aur unke liye unke deen ko qavi kar dega jis se woh khush hain. Aur farmaya ke yeh shar'iyyah aur qadriyyah kitabon mein marqoom hai, yaqinan ho kar hi rahega. Zaboor se murad baqool Saeed bin Jubair (Rahimahullah) Taurat, Injeel aur Quran hai. Mujahid kehte hain Zaboor se murad kitab hai baaz log kehte hain ke Zaboor us kitab ka naam hai jo Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) par utri thi. Zikr se murad yahan par Taurat hai. Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain Zikr se murad Quran hai, Saeed farmate hain Zikr woh hai jo asmanon mein hai yaani Allah ke paas ki Umm-ul-Kitab jo sab se pehli kitab hai yaani Lauh-e-Mahfooz. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Zaboor aur woh asmani kitabein jo paighambaron par nazil huin aur Zikr murad pehli kitab yaani Lauh-e-Mahfooz. Farmate hain Taurat, Zaboor aur Ilm-e-Ilahi mein pehle hi yeh faisla ho gaya tha ke Ummat-e-Muhammadi zameen ki badshah banegi aur naik ho kar jannat mein jayegi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke zameen se murad jannat ki zameen. Abu Dardah farmate hain saleh log hum hi hain. Murad is se ba-iman log hain is Quran mein jo Nabi-e-Akhiruz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utara gaya hai poori naseehat-o-kifayat hai unke liye jo hamare ibadat guzaar bande hain. Jo hamari mante hain apni khwahish ko hamare naam par qurban kar dete hain phir farmata hai ke hum ne apne is Nabi ko Rahmat-ul-Lil-Alameen bana kar bheja hai, pas is nemat ki shukr guzari karne wala dunya-o-akhirat mein shadman hai aur na-qadri karne wala dono jahan mein barbad-o-nashad hai. Jaise irshad hai ke kya tum ne unhe dekha jinhone nemat-e-Rabbani ki na-shakri ki aur apni kaum ko gharat kar diya. Is Quran ki nisbat farmaya ke yeh iman walon ke liye hidayat-o-shifa hai, be-iman behre andhe hain. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke ek mauqe par Ashab-e-Rasool (Razi Allahu Anhum) ne arz ki ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in kafiron ke liye bad-dua kijiye, Aap ne farmaya ke main laanat karne wala bana kar nahi bheja gaya balki rehmat bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Aur hadees mein hai Aap farmate hain main to sirf rehmat-o-hidayat hoon. Aur riwayat mein is ke sath yeh bhi hai ke mujhe ek kaum ki taraqi aur dusri ke tanazzul ke sath bheja gaya hai. Tabarani mein hai ke ae Qurayshion! Muhammad Yathrib mein chala gaya hai, apne taliye ke lashkar idhar udhar tumhari justuju mein bhej raha hai.

Jab Huzoor ﷺ ko yeh baatein pahunchin to Aap ne farmaya ke Allah ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai main hi unhein qatl-o-gharat karunga aur qaid kar ke phir ehsan kar ke chhoroonga main rahmat hoon mera bhejne wala Allah hai woh mujhe is duniya se na uthaye ga jab tak apne deen ko duniya par ghalib na kar de. Mere paanch naam hain Muhammad, Ahmad, Mahi, yani meri wajah se Allah kufr ko mita dega, Hashir is liye ke log mere qadmon par jama kiye jayenge aur Aqib. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ Madain mein the basa auqaat ahadise Rasool ka mazakrah raha karta tha ek din Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ Hazrat Salman ke paas aaye to Hazrat Salman ؓ ne farmaya اے Huzaifa ek din Rasool ﷺ ne apne khutbe mein farmaya ke jise main ne gusse mein bura bhala keh diya ho ya is par laanat kar di ho to samajh lo ke main bhi tum jaisa ek insan hi hoon tumhari tarah mujhe bhi gussa aa jata hai. Haan albatta main kyunke Rahmat-lil-Alamin hoon to meri dua hai ke Allah mere in alfaaz ko bhi un logon ke liye mojib-e-rahmat bana de. Rahi yeh baat ke kuffaar ke liye Aap rahmat kaise the? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ se isi ayat ki tafseer mein marwi hai ke momino ke liye to Aap duniya-o-akhirat mein rahmat the aur ghair momino ke liye Aap duniya mein rahmat the ke woh zameen mein dhunsaye jaane se, aasman se patthar barsaye jaane se bach gaye. Jaise ke agli ummaton ke munkiron par azaab aaye.)

Jald ya badir haq ghalib hoga Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukm deta hai ke aap mushrikeen se farmadein ke meri jaanib yahi wahi ki jaati hai ke sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ma'bud-e-barhaq hai tum sab bhi ise tasleem karlo. Aur agar tum meri baat pe yaqeen nahi karte toh hum tum juda hain tum hamare dushman ho hum tumhare. Jaise ayat mein hai ke agar yeh jhutlayen toh keh de ke mere liye mera amal hai aur tumhare liye tumhara amal hai tum mere aamal se bari ho aur main tumhare kartooton se bezaar hoon. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa imma takhafanna min qaumin khiyanatan fanbiz ilaihim 'ala sawa'in innallaha la yuhibbul-khainin) (Al-Anfal: 58) ya'ni agar tujhe kisi qaum se khiyanat-o-bad'ahdi ka andesha ho toh ahad tod dene ki unhein foran khabar de do. Isi tarah yahan bhi hai ke agar tum alhadgi ikhtiyar karo toh hamare tumhare talluqat munqata hain. Yaqeen mano ke jo wada tumse kiya jata hai woh poora hone wala toh zaroor hai ab khwah abhi ho khwah der se iska khud mujhe ilm nahi. Zahir-o-batin ka aalim Allah hi hai jo tum zahir karo aur jo chhupao use sab ka ilm hai. Bandon ke kul aamal zahir aur poshida us par ashkara hain chhota bada khula amal chhupa sab kuch woh jaanta hai. Mumkin hai ki iski taakhir bhi tumhari aazmaish ho aur tumhein tumhari zindagani tak nafa dena ho Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ko jo dua taleem hui thi ke aey Allah hum mein aur hamari qaum mein tu sachha faisla kar aur tu hi behtar faisla karne wala hai.
